title: Offshore Accountant
description:
We are a growing dental clinic looking for a reliable and detail-oriented offshore accountant/bookkeeper in the Philippines to assist with our day-to-day accounting for our business in Australia.



This is a simple, straightforward accounting role focused primarily on keeping our Xero accounts accurate and up to date.



Main Responsibilities

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts in Xero

Match transactions and payments correctly

Review and categorise transactions

Identify and investigate discrepancies

Keep Xero records accurate and organised

Ensure accounts are reconciled regularly

Assist with basic bookkeeping and accounting tasks as required

Communicate with our team regarding any transactions or discrepancies that need clarification



Requirements

Previous experience with Xero is essential

Experience in bookkeeping or accounting

Strong attention to detail

Good understanding of account reconciliation

Reliable and consistent with deadlines

Good written English

Able to work independently with minimal supervision

Experience working with Australian businesses is preferred but not essential

Experience in healthcare/dental accounting is a bonus but not required



About the Role

This is not a complex accounting position. We primarily need someone who can confidently work in Xero, reconcile our accounts accurately, and keep everything organised.

The role would suit someone who enjoys routine bookkeeping work and takes pride in getting the details right.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term ongoing position, rather than short-term or project-based work.



Hours

Initially, we expect approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the potential for additional hours as required.

The work is flexible, but tasks need to be completed accurately and on time.



To Apply

Please send us:

A brief introduction about yourself

Your previous bookkeeping/accounting experience

Your experience using Xero

How many years you have been using Xero

Your hourly rate

Your availability and preferred working hours

Your internet connection and computer setup

A brief example of your experience reconciling accounts in Xero

Please include the word "DENTAL" at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the entire job post.

We are looking for someone dependable, honest, detail-oriented and interested in building a long-term working relationship.

title: Real Estate Team and Exec Support/Well Rounded
description:
# Tenant Experience Specialist | Remote Property Management Support   Mon-Fri 8am-5pm Pacific Time



We are a small, established U.S. property management company looking for an **exceptionally reliable, well-rounded person** to join our team long-term.



This is not a call-center position, and it is not purely an administrative position. It is a varied role combining **resident communication, administrative support, organization, basic marketing/content creation, and day-to-day problem-solving.**



This position is long-term and requires engagement as the learning is progressive and takes time to become a contributing team member to gain independence.  The team you'd be working with is very engaging. 



### What You'll Do



You will be one of the primary points of contact for our tenants/residents and prospective residents while also supporting our property management team behind the scenes.  We pride ourselves on being responsive and having good relationships with tenants, clients/property owners, and vendors that we work with.



Responsibilities may include:



* Answering incoming calls and responding professionally to resident questions

* Writing clear, polished
s and resident communications

* Monitoring and coordinating maintenance requests and follow-up

* Assisting with leasing inquiries and scheduling

* Maintaining spreadsheets, records, documents and property information

* Working with **Excel/Google Sheets** for tracking and basic data organization

* Creating or editing materials in **Canva**

* Performing basic video editing in **CapCut**

* Assisting with property listings, photos, marketing and social media content

* Supporting vendor documentation and administrative processes

* Completing special projects and helping wherever needed

*Helping to maintain a positive front-facing position





### The Person We're Looking For



Consider this as a common scenario:  We need someone who can switch from a tenant phone call → interpret a spreadsheet → notice that two numbers don't reconcile → write a polished
 → figure out Canva → remember that something needs follow-up Thursday → recognize that the instructions they're following don't make sense.



**Attention to detail is imperative.** Property management involves money, leases, dates, addresses, resident information and legal deadlines. Small mistakes matter.



You should have:



* **Excellent written English** and strong verbal communication skills

* Moderate or better **Excel/Google Sheets** skills

* Experience with or confidence using **Canva and CapCut**

*Strong basic math skills  **Basic Accounting is a Plus**

* Strong general computer and technology skills

* Excellent organization and follow-through

* Good judgment and problem-solving ability

* The ability to learn new software and processes quickly

* A naturally helpful, professional communication style

* The confidence to ask questions when something isn't clear

* The ability to catch mistakes—not simply complete tasks

*ID score of 80+

*Prior remote night-work experience required



Property management experience is helpful, but **intelligence, judgment, reliability and willingness to learn are more important to us.**



### One Important Thing About This Position



There are times when our phones and resident communications are busy—and times when they are **very quiet**.



We need someone who can be just as productive during the quiet periods.

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Researcher - Running / Fitness Niche
description:
About the role



I'm growing a personal Instagram account in the running and fitness space — lifestyle-driven, authentic content rather than heavily produced videos.



I'm looking for someone to help me research what's working in the niche and turn my raw footage into Reels at a consistent volume.



This is two jobs in one, and I need both:



Research — you stay close to what's performing in running and fitness Reels and document it.

Editing — you take my footage and cut it into short-form Reels.



If you're strong at one and weak at the other, this probably isn't the right fit.



What you'll do

Spend focused time daily inside running and fitness content on Instagram, tracking what's performing and why.

Keep a shared research doc organized and current so we always have a running list of ideas to pull from.

Edit short-form vertical Reels from an organized library of my raw footage.

Write natural, native-sounding on-screen text. This matters a lot — a strong edit with a weak or stiff hook won't perform.

Deliver consistently at volume. This isn't one polished video a week.

Keep our tracker updated so we both know where every video stands.



You'll send me work for review, I'll approve or give notes, and we'll keep a steady loop going. Async is fine — I don't need you online at set hours, but I do need you responsive and consistent with deadlines.



What I'm looking for

Real experience editing short-form vertical video for Instagram Reels or TikTok. Portfolio required.

Fluent, natural written English — you'll be writing text that has to sound like a native speaker wrote it.

Comfort in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro. After Effects is a bonus, not a requirement.

A genuine feel for hooks, pacing, and retention. You can look at a Reel and explain why it held attention.

Organized and self-directed. Trackers and docs stay current without me chasing you.

Reliable communication. If something slips, you tell me before I have to ask.



Bonus points:



You run, or you're into fitness generally. You'll be watching this content daily — it helps if you actually enjoy it.

Experience helping grow an account from a small starting point, personal or client.

You already have a system for finding trending content and audio.



Details:



Pay based on experience. Tell me your rate. I'd rather pay well for someone genuinely good than hire cheap and redo the work.

Long-term intent. I'm looking to build something with someone over time, not fill a one-off gig.

Paid test project before any ongoing commitment, so we both know it's a fit.



How to apply:



Please include all of the following. Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed:



Your portfolio. If you have short-form vertical edits, lead with those.

One Instagram Reel from the running or fitness niche that you think performed well, and why. Two or three sentences.

Your rate and weekly availability.

Which editing software you use.





Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Creator Manager / UGC Coordinator
description:
I run a DTC ecommerce brand selling into the US market. Our growth engine is Meta ads, and we are investing heavily into UGC to feed it.



Not volume for the sake of volume. Plenty of brands pump out creator content nobody watches. We are building a library of genuinely good UGC, which means this job is mostly about judgment. Knowing the difference between content that will perform and content that just looks nice is the entire skill.



The model is product seeding. Creators get the product free in exchange for content. The ones who deliver something that actually performs get moved onto paid work with us, and that is where this gets interesting for you, because you will be the one d
 who graduates.



Right now we get around 20 new creator applications a day, and there are 150 sitting in the queue I have not worked through. Every one of those is a potential video for the library, and every day I do not get to them is content we do not have.



Here is the honest reason this seat exists. I am the founder. My time should be going into growth marketing, testing new angles, and scaling what already works. Instead a large chunk of it goes into filtering creator applications. That is work someone with good taste and a clear process will do better than me anyway, and I want to hand it over properly rather than keep half doing it.



This is a long term role. I am not looking for someone for one project. I want to train one person properly and keep them for years.



Why's this role is worth your time?



Most UGC coordination jobs are pure admin. Send the brief, chase the creator, upload the file, repeat. This is not that.



You will see the actual performance data on every video you approve. You will find out which of your picks made money and which ones died, usually within a few days. That feedback loop is the fastest way I know to learn what makes an ad work, and very few people get access to it this early in their career.



You will work directly with me and a small remote creative team across a few time zones. We test, we look at the numbers, and we double down on what works.



If you are good, this grows. More hours, more responsibility, more pay, and eventually input on the creative briefs themselves instead of just filtering against them.



What will you actually do?

Clear the 150 application backlog then keep the daily 20 from ever piling up again

Run our creator campaigns end to end, from posting the campaign to receiving the final files

Filter incoming creator applications and d
 who is worth sending product to

Chase deliverables. Seeding only works if people actually send content back, and a lot of them will not without follow up. This is a real part of the job

Review every piece of content that comes back against the creative brief. Approve, reject, or send back for revision

Flag the hooks and angles worth cutting into more variations, and explain why

Maintain the graduation list. Creators who deliver content that performs move from free product onto paid work, and you d
 who makes that jump

Track delivery rates and performance by creator, so we stop guessing about who is worth the shipping cost



Who I am looking for?

Taste matters more than years of experience here. You should be able to watch a UGC video and know within five seconds whether it will stop a scroll, and be able to explain why.



Beyond that:

Some experience talking to creators or influencers. You have done outreach before and it went fine

You can work without hand holding. I will build the process with you in the first week, then I want to stop checking

Solid written English. You will be messaging creators directly on my behalf

You have opinions and you will say them, including when you think a brief is weak



Please do not apply if you need approval on every small decision, or if you have never watched a UGC ad and thought "I would have cut that differently."



How to apply?



Start your application with the word SCROLL so I know you actually read this.



Then send me two things:



1. A short note on your experience working with creators, if you have any. If you have none, say so and tell me why you would be good at this anyway.



2. A Loom video, 3 minutes maximum. Find three UGC videos you would approve and three you would reject. They can be from any brand, they do not have to be from mine. Share your screen, play a few seconds of each, and talk me through the call.



Loom is free at 
. Set the video to anyone with the link so I can open it.



The Loom is the whole filter. It takes 20 minutes and it tells me more than a resume ever could: how you think, whether you can explain a decision, and how your English sounds, since you will be messaging creators as me.



I care far more about your reasoning on the rejects than the approvals. Anyone can point at a good video.



I am hiring one person. If you are not certain you are qualified but you know you have the eye for this, apply anyway.

title: Web Designer and Front End Developer
description:
# Web Designer & Front-End Developer — Shopify + AI Websites



**Remote — Philippines**

**Full-Time / Part-Time Considered**



## About Us



We are a growing web design agency creating modern, premium websites for businesses and brands.



Our workflow is heavily AI-assisted. I personally create many of our main website designs and interactive experiences using **Google AI Studio**, which generates the initial website/code.



I'm looking for a strong **Front-End Developer / Shopify Developer with good design sense** who can take those designs and turn them into fully functional, production-ready websites.



For some projects, you'll receive a complete design/code to implement. For simpler pages, you may also be expected to design and build them yourself while maintaining the existing website style.



---



## What You'll Do



### Google AI Studio → Shopify Implementation



This is a **core part of the role**.



Our typical workflow is:



**Google AI Studio design/code → Adapt for Shopify → Implement → Test → Refine → Final website**



You will be expected to:



* Work with AI-generated website code

* Understand and modify existing code

* Adapt/convert code for Shopify when necessary

* Implement custom designs into Shopify themes

* Build custom Shopify sections and templates

* Use Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript

* Connect Shopify products, collections and dynamic content

* Make websites fully responsive

* Debug and fix issues

* Recreate animations/interactions where technically possible

* Compare the Shopify version to the original design and refine it



**Visual accuracy is very important.**



The goal isn't simply to make the code work. The final Shopify website should look and behave as closely as possible to the original design.



You should be comfortable adjusting:



* Spacing

* Typography

* Sizing

* Positioning

* Layout

* Responsive behavior

* Animations

* Hover/scroll interactions

* Overall visual quality



---



## Shopify Skills — REQUIRED



You should have strong experience with:



* Shopify themes

* Shopify Liquid

* Custom sections/blocks

* Custom page templates

* HTML/CSS/JavaScript

* Product & collection pages

* Metafields

* Dynamic Shopify content

* Cart functionality

* Shopify apps/integrations

* Responsive development

* Theme debugging

* Custom Shopify designs



**We are NOT looking for someone who only installs or lightly edits existing Shopify themes.**



You should be comfortable implementing **custom designs and custom code.**



---



## Front-End & Design



You should have:



* Strong HTML/CSS/JavaScript skills

* Strong understanding of responsive design

* Good eye for typography, spacing and layout

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to maintain an existing visual style

* Ability to troubleshoot design/technical issues

* Ability to work independently



For simpler pages such as About, Contact, landing pages, etc., you may be expected to design and build the page yourself based on the requirements and existing website.



---



## Other Platforms



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* WordPress / WooCommerce

* Wix / Velo

* Webflow

* Framer

* React

* GSAP

* Three.js

* Advanced animations

* Parallax / scroll interactions

* 3D websites



You don't need to know everything.



**Strong front-end fundamentals and the ability to learn new platforms are more important.**



---



## AI-Assisted Development



We use tools such as:



* Google AI Studio

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Cursor

* Lovable

* Replit



You don't need to know all of them.



You should be comfortable with:



**Understanding AI code → Modifying it → Debugging it → Improving it → Implementing it**



You should NOT simply copy/paste AI-generated code without understanding how it works.



---



## Who We're Looking For



I'm looking for someone who can take **technical ownership**.



I handle:



* Creative direction

* Client acquisition

* Project management

* Overall website vision



You handle:



* Technical implementation

* Shopify development

* Front-end development

* Responsive behavior

* Debugging

* Technical problem solving

* Final implementation



I don't want someone who needs step-by-step coding instructions.



I want someone who can look at a design and say:



**"I understand what you're trying to achieve. Here's how I would build it."**



…and then make it work.



---



## Requirements



**Must Have:**



* Strong front-end development experience

* Strong HTML/CSS/JavaScript

* Strong Shopify experience

* Shopify Liquid

* Custom Shopify sections/themes

* Experience working with existing code

* Responsive development

* Strong problem-solving ability

* Good design sense

* Attention to detail

* Ability to work independently



**Strong Bonus:**



* Google AI Studio

* AI-assisted development

* GSAP

* Three.js

* React

* Webflow

* Framer

* WordPress/WooCommerce

* Wix/Velo

* Advanced animations / 3D websites



---



## Portfolio Required



Please send:



1. Portfolio

2. 3–5 websites you personally worked on

3. Shopify websites you've built/customized

4. Examples of custom Shopify sections/themes

5. Other platforms you know

6. AI development tools you've used

7. Monthly salary expectation

8. Availability



**Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**



Please clearly explain **what you personally worked on** for each project.





## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



**Portfolio:**

**Years of experience:**

**Shopify experience:**

**Shopify/Liquid experience:**

**Other platforms:**

**Front-end technologies:**

**AI tools you've used:**

**Salary expectation:**

**Availability:**



### Answer this question:



**If I give you a website created in Google AI Studio and ask you to recreate it as a Shopify website, what would your process be from start to finish?**



Please explain your answer in your own words.



**Generic applications will not be considered.**

title: Steel Estimator (Fulltime)
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Full-Time Steel Estimator with experience in miscellaneous and structural steel fabrication. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with precision, and can confidently manage multiple estimating projects from drawing review and quantity takeoff through estimate preparation.



This is a full-time remote opportunity for an experienced estimator who can support our client's growing estimating workload and become a reliable part of their team.



Our client uses Tekla Structures as part of their estimating workflow. Candidates with hands-on Tekla experience are highly valued, while candidates with basic Tekla knowledge and strong steel estimating experience are also welcome. The ideal candidate is technically capable, adaptable, detail-oriented, and willing to learn the client's specific systems and processes.



Core Responsibilities

Estimating & Project Analysis



• Review blueprints, construction drawings, fabrication drawings, specifications, and project documents to understand project scope and estimating requirements.

• Perform accurate quantity and material takeoffs for miscellaneous and structural steel projects.

• Prepare reliable estimates based on project quantities, materials, fabrication requirements, and other relevant project information.

• Interpret project requirements and identify factors that may impact pricing, fabrication, materials, or project scope.

• Review drawings for missing information, discrepancies, revisions, and areas requiring clarification.

• Identify potential risks, exclusions, and conditions that may affect the accuracy of estimates.



Tekla & Technical Workflow



• Work within the client's estimating systems and processes, including Tekla Structures.

• Utilize Tekla Structures and other technical tools to support estimating and project analysis.

• Apply strong estimating fundamentals while learning the client's specific Tekla-based workflow.

• Maintain accurate estimating information and ensure technical details are properly documented.



Project Coordination & Documentation



• Organize and maintain estimating files, takeoffs, project documents, and supporting information.

• Communicate questions, discrepancies, and potential project issues proactively.

• Coordinate with the client's estimating and project teams to clarify requirements and maintain project accuracy.

• Manage multiple estimating assignments while meeting established deadlines.

• Provide timely updates regarding project status, estimating progress, and potential challenges.



Required Qualifications & Skills



• Strong professional experience in steel estimating.

• Relevant experience in miscellaneous steel, structural steel, metal fabrication, construction, manufacturing, or related industries.

• Strong ability to perform accurate quantity and material takeoffs.

• Ability to read and interpret construction, structural, and fabrication drawings.

• Good understanding of steel fabrication and manufacturing processes.

• Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to estimate accuracy.

• Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Technically savvy and comfortable learning specialized estimating and modeling software.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team.

• Available for a dedicated full-time position.



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience in miscellaneous steel estimating.

• Experience in structural steel estimating or fabrication.

• Strong estimating experience.

• Experience supporting U.S.-based fabrication, manufacturing, or construction projects.

• Experience with other estimating, takeoff, CAD, or steel detailing software.

• Experience working with custom, complex, or large-scale steel fabrication projects.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with estimators, project managers, fabricators, and other stakeholders.



Work Schedule



• Full-Time

• Remote

• Dedicated full-time availability required

• Schedule will align with the client's business and project requirements



How to Apply



To apply, please submit:



• Updated Resume

• Your availability and expected hourly/monthly rate

• A 60–90 second self-introduction video sharing your steel estimating experience, relevant project experience, and why you are a great fit for this role

• Samples of previous work, such as takeoffs, estimates, or bid packages, if available. Please remove or redact any confidential information.

• Please indicate your level of experience with Tekla Structures and the specific Tekla tools or functions you have used.

This is NOT a cold calling or outbound sales position. Your primary responsibility will be monitoring incoming text conversations throughout your shift, responding quickly and professionally to interested prospects, and arranging good times for our sales team to call them.



**Primary Responsibilities**



• Monitor incoming conversations across 3 GoHighLevel accounts throughout your entire shift

• Respond to new prospect messages quickly, ideally within 2–5 minutes

• Monitor and organize leads, conversations, tags, appointments, and follow-ups

• Schedule and manage SMS drip campaigns

You will be communicating directly with American homeowners through text message. Your messages must have excellent grammar, spelling, comprehension, and natural conversational phrasing.



We are not looking for long or overly formal responses. You need to understand how Americans naturally communicate over text and be able to send short, friendly, professional responses.



Your spoken accent is NOT important for this position. Written communication is.

• Contacts and opportunities

• Calendars and appointments

• Workflows and automations

• Triggers and tags

• SMS campaigns and drip sequences

• Troubleshooting workflows

We already have extensive automations and systems in place, so you will not be starting from scratch. However, we want someone who understands GHL well enough to maintain these systems, build new automations, and suggest improvements.



**Schedule**



Ideal schedule:



7:00 AM–9:00 AM Pacific Time

2-hour break

11:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



Monday–Friday



This is an overnight/graveyard schedule in the Philippines. Please only apply if you are comfortable consistently working these hours.



**Pay**

There is opportunity for increased compensation over time for someone who becomes a reliable and valuable long-term member of our team.



**What We're Looking For**



• Previous GoHighLevel experience

• Excellent written English

• Fast typing and processing speed

• Strong attention to detail

• Comfortable managing multiple conversations at once

• Extremely responsive during working hours

• Good judgment when communicating with prospects

• Reliable internet and computer setup

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision

• Solar experience is a plus, but not required



**HOW TO APPLY**



Please include the following:



1. Briefly describe your experience with GoHighLevel.

2. Tell us which GHL features you have personally worked with, especially workflows and automations.

3. Confirm that you can consistently work the schedule listed above.

4. Answer the following exactly as you would respond to the prospect inside our CRM.. your goal is to set up a time for one of our phone specialists / apt setters to call them:



**Prospect #1:**

"At work right now"



**Prospect #2:**

"Yes, can you call me after 6?"



**Prospect #3:**

"How did you get my info?"



**Prospect #4:**

"Can you
 me the info? I don't like talking on the phone"



Do not use ChatGPT or another AI tool to write your answers. We want to see how YOU naturally communicate with prospects.



Please put **"GHL SOLAR"** at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job description.

Ruban Bleu Weddings & Events

Type: Independent contractor



===============================================



ABOUT RUBAN BLEU WEDDINGS & EVENTS



Ruban Bleu is a wedding and events planning company serving couples across the Dallas-Fort Worth area. We specialize in culturally inclusive celebrations, including Indian and South Asian, Nigerian, Ethiopian, East Asian, Mexican and Latin, Jewish, Middle Eastern, and African American weddings, along with LGBTQ+ weddings, destination weddings, and themed celebrations.



Our mission is to make wedding planning smooth, organized, and stress-free for couples who want a beautifully planned wedding without the luxury price tag.



===============================================



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a Wedding Planning Assistant to serve as our Executor and Auditor. This is the person who owns our project management system as the official record of every wedding, keeps client communication running on schedule, and verifies that the work our contracts promise is actually getting done.



Our operating principle is simple: every task has a doer, a system of record, and a verifier. You are the verifier. "I did it" is a claim. A logged action, a confirmation in hand, or a documented client notification is proof, and only proof closes a task.



This is a detail role for someone who is comfortable checking other people's work, asking direct follow-up questions, and reporting clearly to leadership. This role flags and reports issues. It does not chase or fix them.



The position is fully remote. Strong phone and written communication is essential, since you will be corresponding with clients weekly and verifying vendor communication.



===============================================



RESPONSIBILITIES



SYSTEM OF RECORD

* Build each wedding's task checklist from the signed contract within two days of booking

* Maintain the project management system as the accurate, current record for every active wedding

* Log the outcome of the weekly planner sync, including what was reviewed and what remains outstanding



CLIENT COMMUNICATION

* Draft, format, and send the weekly Friday recap
 to every couple with an active wedding

* Own that the recap actually goes out, on the same day, every week, including quiet weeks

* Send meeting recaps and action items following client calls



AUDITING AND VERIFICATION

* Run a weekly sweep of every active wedding and flag anything overdue, unchecked, or unverified in a standard reporting format

* Run milestone health reviews at 90, 60, and 30 days from each wedding, assigning a status of Green, Yellow, or Red

* Verify that vendor outreach actually occurred by checking
 and call records, rather than accepting that it was done

* Confirm each booked vendor is documented in all three required places

* Check contract scope against package and guest count at booking and again at guest count finalization, flagging any mismatch

* Escalate findings to leadership with the specific gap and a recommended action



CROSS-WEDDING LISTS

* Maintain the coordinator onboarding and HR tracking list

* Maintain the lead pipeline check



===============================================



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write a clean, professional client
 without heavy editing

* Comfortable and clear on the phone. Customer service, call center, hospitality, front desk, or receptionist experience is a strong plus

* Exceptionally detail-oriented, with the discipline to verify rather than assume

* Comfortable respectfully flagging incomplete work and asking follow-up questions of teammates

* Highly organized and able to manage recurring weekly deadlines without reminders

* Comfortable learning new software and project management platforms

* Reliable and responsive during standard business hours, with some flexibility during wedding season

* Prior experience in weddings, events, hospitality, project coordination, or administrative support preferred



===============================================



WHY JOIN US



You will be part of a small, collaborative team that values clear communication, cultural sensitivity, and doing right by every couple we serve. This role sits at the center of our operation and works directly with the owner, the Operations Manager, and our lead planners.

The role is to manage and optimize the accounts payable / receivable process, ensuring timely invoice processing and maintaining accurate financial records in Excel, Xero and Cargowise.  High attention to detail is essential, as you will be ensuring financials are accurate and up to date. You will be responsible for monitoring and reporting on outstanding debts, collection issues in collaboration with customers and internal teams, while developing strategies to minimize overdue accounts. 



This role is ideal for a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a remote environment and values process improvement and accuracy. We are looking for someone who is reliable, disciplined, proactive, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work as part of a supportive and professional team.



Key Responsibilities:

Invoicing and Billing:

• Accurately enter supplier invoices into Excel, Xero and Cargowise

• Ensure invoices comply with relevant tax requirements (e.g. GST treatment, ABN details)

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within accounts payable and finance processes.



Receivables Management:

• Monitor the accounts receivable ledger and reconcile customer accounts

• Allocate incoming payments against invoices accurately and in a timely manner

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between payments received and amounts invoiced



Debtor Management:

• Follow up on overdue accounts via phone,
, and written correspondence

• Weekly reporting of aged debtors including tracking debt collection activity.

• Reconciliation and Reporting



Administrative Support:

• Maintain customer/client master data within Xero accounting system

• Assist with ad hoc finance tasks as required

• Prepare and create bank files for weekly and monthly payment runs.

• Assist with month-end tasks, reporting, and reconciliation activities.



Requirements:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Minimum of 2-3+ years’ experience in an Accounts Payable or similar finance role

• Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint and Google suite

• Proven experience using Xero (essential)

• High level organisational and time management skills

• Experience with Australian GST regulations and compliance

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision or direction

• Reliable, disciplined, and proactive work ethic

• High attention to detail and data accuracy in system work

• Clear communicator with a professional, team-first attitude



Equipment Needed:

• Desktop or Laptop under 3 years old

• Dual monitor – 2 x Screens required

• Core I5 or Ryzen 5 & above

• Min 8GB RAM

• Min 500GB Hard Drive

• Microsoft windows genuine version

• Fibre Internet – Minimum 100MBps & above

• Backup Internet – Second pre-paid ‘dongle’ style

• Backup Power – UPS or Generator



Wage: PHP 30,000 – PHP 45,000 per month with government mandated benefits based on experience and skills



Benefits:

• Full time work from home role

• Day shift working 8:30am – 5:00pm Monday to Friday Australian business hours 

• No weekend work

• Holiday & sick leave

• Australian national public holidays

• Government benefits Pagibig, SSS & Phil Health and HMO

• 13th Month pay

title: PROJECT MANAGER / EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT
description:
===============================================================

        PROJECT MANAGER / EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

        Full-Time  |  Remote  |  Independent Contractor

===============================================================



*** AI GENERATED ANSWERS WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DECLINED ***



We use AI every day here, so we know what it sounds like. Use it

to think, not to answer for you. Applications with AI written

responses will be rejected without review.



===============================================================



We're looking for an experienced project manager and executive

assistant to keep our projects moving, our systems current, and

our leadership supported.



This is not an entry-level position. You'll work independently

across multiple active projects and support more than one

executive, so we need someone who already knows how to do this

work and doesn't need to be managed closely. We move fast and we

don't have time to train the basics.



You need to be genuinely strong with technology. We run on a

stack of connected tools and we use AI daily as part of how the

work gets done. If software slows you down, or if AI tools make

you uneasy, this is not the right fit. We're looking for someone

who picks up a new platform on their own, figures out how to

make it work better, and uses AI well without taking its output

at face value.



Our team is distributed across several countries and time zones,

and part of this role is keeping work moving when the people

involved are not online at the same time.





===============================================================

  SCHEDULE AND PAY

===============================================================



Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time, with a

1 hour unpaid lunch. 40 hours per week. Availability during

those hours is required.



$1,500 per month, $750 paid twice monthly on the 1st and the

15th, as an independent contractor.





===============================================================

  TIME OFF AND BENEFITS

===============================================================



Sick and personal time is covered under PTO after 6 months of

service. Full-time contractors get 24 paid hours per year, used

in blocks of up to one 6-hour shift at a time. Part-time gets 12

paid hours per year, up to one 3-hour shift at a time. Requests

should be submitted at least 24 hours in advance or the time may

be unpaid.



Paid vacation starts after 1 year of service. Full-time

contractors receive 30 paid hours per year. Minimum use is 12

hours, or two shifts, with 30-day notice and approval.



Bereavement leave is accommodated for the death of an immediate

family member, including spouse or domestic partner, child,

parent, sibling, or in-law. That time is deducted from available

PTO. PTO may also be requested for the loss of an extended

family member.



Holidays follow the assigned client's holiday schedule and are

unpaid.



Religious observance is accommodated. That time is unpaid and

should be requested two weeks ahead.



Bonuses: $50 on your birthday, $100 at your one-year

anniversary, and an end-of-year bonus of $200 for full-time or

$100 for part-time. Bonuses are subject to the eligibility and

discretionary terms in the handbook.





===============================================================

  BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITIES

===============================================================



----- Project management and coordination ---------------------



·  Keep projects on track and make sure tasks actually get done



·  Build and maintain production schedules from established

   scopes and timelines, including working backward from dates

   that can't move



·  Track deadlines, meetings, deliverables, and internal review

   dates across the portfolio



·  Drive multi-stage initiatives from plan to completion,

   holding owners to sequencing and dependencies



·  Follow up with team members, vendors, and contractors to keep

   work moving



·  Identify stalled work and unblock it before it shows up as a

   missed date



·  Maintain organized project files and documentation for each

   engagement





----- Executive and administrative support --------------------



·  Provide executive assistant support to leadership, including

   calendar and scheduling coordination across international

   time zones



·  Manage and route
, flag what needs attention, and keep

   nothing from slipping



·  Coordinate travel and prepare materials for meetings, calls,

   and client sessions



·  Handle document preparation and general administrative work

   as needed





----- Systems and tools ---------------------------------------



·  Work fluently across project management, CRM, e-commerce,

   communication, and document tools, and keep them in sync with

   each other



·  Learn new platforms quickly without hand-holding, including

   tools the team has not used before



·  Use AI tools daily to research, draft, synthesize, and

   organize, and verify that output before it moves forward



·  Spot where a process is manual or breaking and propose a

   better way to run it





----- Billing and operations ----------------------------------



·  Support accounts receivable and payable, invoicing, and

   billing coordination



·  Maintain and update CRM and project management systems so

   records stay accurate



·  Coordinate with vendors and contractors on documentation,

   onboarding, and payment



·  Track vendor and production lead times and factor them into

   schedules



·  Monitor project and client budgets and keep tracking current



·  Support inventory and e-commerce record accuracy, including

   keeping product data and counts current across systems





----- Document production and quality control -----------------



·  Proofread proposals, reports, presentations, and other

   documents for grammar, formatting, consistency, and accuracy



·  Check documents against source materials and templates, and

   confirm names, titles, dates, and details



·  Maintain version control and prepare documents for final

   review



·  Coordinate review cycles across contributors and close them

   out on schedule





----- Research and business development -----------------------



·  Research RFPs, RFQs, and other opportunities aligned with our

   services



·  Conduct preliminary research on prospective clients,

   partners, and organizations



·  Prepare background briefs ahead of meetings so leadership

   walks in informed



·  Track opportunities, deadlines, requirements, and status in

   an organized system



·  Gather background for go or no-go decisions and help assemble

   proposal components



·  Track business licensing renewals, filing deadlines, and

   other compliance requirements





----- Team coordination ---------------------------------------



·  Attend team and project meetings prepared and up to speed



·  Build agendas ahead of meetings, take notes, document

   decisions and assignments, and update tracking systems

   afterward



·  Produce a consistent written status update by workstream

   covering what shipped, what slipped, what's at risk, and what

   needs a decision



·  Delegate to and review the work of remote support staff,

   including scoping assignments and holding deadlines



·  Follow up on action items and flag deadlines, gaps, or issues

   before they become problems





===============================================================

  PERSONAL AND HOUSEHOLD RESPONSIBILITIES

===============================================================



----- Inbox and communication ---------------------------------



·  Review and organize personal
 and work toward inbox zero



·  Check digital mailboxes and flag anything that needs

   attention



·  Track follow-ups and maintain clear task lists



·  Handle personal and family information with discretion





----- Family and calendar coordination ------------------------



·  Maintain the family calendar and shared scheduling app



·  Track the children's school, activities, appointments, and

   other commitments



·  Manage the babysitter's schedule from the live calendar

   events



·  Create weekly toddler agendas for the nanny or sitter



·  Keep the spouse updated on important schedule changes



·  Schedule family appointments and handle confirmations





----- Household management ------------------------------------



·  Coordinate recurring services such as cleaning, water

   delivery, and lawn care



·  Place household and online orders as needed



·  Coordinate home maintenance and small errands



·  Track vehicle registration, inspection, and other compliance

   dates





----- Meals and groceries -------------------------------------



·  Create weekly meal plans



·  Place grocery orders through delivery services



·  Update the recipe app as needed



·  Research family-friendly activities and weekend plans





----- Personal finances and records ---------------------------



·  Track and categorize personal expenses in personal finance

   software



·  Monitor bills, due dates, and recurring payments



·  Maintain the monthly household budget



·  Prepare weekly financial reports



·  Process babysitter payroll every two weeks



·  Organize and maintain family documents in a digital records

   system





----- Medical and administrative support ----------------------



·  Track monthly prescription refills



·  Schedule and coordinate family medical and dental

   appointments



·  Review insurance and provider records and confirm information

   is current



·  Track personal licensing renewals and filing deadlines





----- Occasional projects -------------------------------------



·  Research homeownership and housing assistance programs at the

   state and local level



·  Make approved settlement calls and send credit-related

   correspondence



·  Complete and maintain the family profile sheet



·  Set up accounts and enrollment items for an adult child,

   including college accounts



·  Research jobs and college or culinary programs as needed



·  Gather registration and inspection dates for household

   vehicles



·  Assist with driver's license renewal



·  Handle family memberships and registrations



·  Assist with other personal, household, family, or

   small-business administrative projects as they come up





===============================================================

  WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

===============================================================



·  Direct, hands-on experience with advanced project management

   and executive support



·  Roughly 3 or more years in project coordination, executive

   support, consulting, professional services, or a similar

   environment



·  Highly tech savvy, with real fluency across business software

   and a track record of learning new systems fast



·  Active, comfortable use of AI tools in daily work, plus the

   judgment to check what they produce



·  Experience coordinating across time zones and with

   international teams



·  Exceptional organization and attention to detail



·  Strong research, writing, and proofreading skills



·  Advanced spreadsheet skills and comfort managing large

   amounts of information



·  Comfortable moving between business projects and personal or

   household tasks in the same day



·  Proactive and self-directed, someone we don't have to chase

   or remind



·  Careful with confidential business, personal, family, and

   financial information



·  Willing to ask when approval is needed rather than guessing



·  Reliable technology and internet for remote work



·  Available to start immediately



===============================================================



Apply here:

title: Full-Time WFH Content Performance and Feedback Manager  — $1,000–$1,200/month + Bonuses
description:

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Youtube Ai Video Editor
description:
I am looking for a skilled and reliable YouTube video editor to work on a drama storytelling channel focused on emotional, romantic, family, betrayal, revenge, and inspirational stories.



The videos are usually long-form story videos, and the editor will be responsible for turning the provided script, voice-over, and visual assets into an engaging finished YouTube video.



The ideal editor should understand how to keep viewers watching through strong pacing, emotional visuals, smooth transitions, sound effects, background music, and good visual storytelling.



Responsibilities include:



* Editing long-form YouTube drama/story videos.

* Matching visuals closely with the narration and events in the story.

* Using appropriate images, AI-generated visuals, stock footage, or provided assets.

I am looking for someone who understands YouTube audience retention and knows that storytelling videos need frequent visual changes and strong emotional pacing to keep viewers engaged.



Experience editing YouTube storytelling, African/Nigerian drama, movie recap, documentary, celebrity story, or similar narrative content is a major advantage.

title: Marketing Strategist & Media Buyer — Meta Ads (Perth agency, full time, remote)
description:
We run Meta and Google lead gen for Australian businesses in coaching, health, trades, construction, finance and hospitality. We're looking for one person to take full ownership of a set of client accounts: work out what to say, write it, get it produced, run it, and report on what happened.



Right now the founder is doing this job. We want to hand it over properly, not hand over pieces of it.



Who we're looking for



Someone who has personally run Meta lead gen accounts and made the calls on them. You've sat with a client account that was underperforming, worked out the real reason, changed the offer or the angle, and watched the cost per lead move. You think about the message first and the settings second.



If you'd describe yourself as a designer, an editor, or a graphic artist, this isn't your role. If you'd describe yourself as a media buyer who only ever ran what someone else wrote, it's a stretch but tell us anyway.



What the job is, day to day



Research the market and the competition. Ad Library, what offers are running, what the niche is saturated with, what nobody is saying

Build the account strategy: offer, audience, funnel, creative direction, testing plan

Write it. Hooks, primary text, headlines, video scripts

Brief our editor and check what comes back

Run the account in Ads Manager. Structure, budgets, launching, scaling, killing

Read the results weekly and d
 the next test

Short written update per account so we know where things stand



What we need you to actually be good at



Diagnosing an underperforming account, specifically. Not "test more creatives"

Writing hooks and offers that don't sound like everyone else in the niche

Competitor and market research that produces angles, not screenshots

Running Meta campaigns end to end without supervision



Pay: $2,000 AUD per month, full time. Reviewed at three months, with room above this for the right person.



To apply, send:



One Meta account you've run. What the problem was, what you changed, what happened. Three or four sentences. Numbers if you have them.

Two hooks you wrote for it, and why those.

Confirmation you can screen share in Ads Manager on a call and walk us through a live or recent account.



Applications without number 3 won't be read. We check.

title: Sales Engineer – B2B SaaS Cybersecurity (Full-Cycle, US Pacific Hours)
description:
Job Title: Sales Engineer – B2B SaaS Cybersecurity (Full-Cycle, US Pacific Hours)

Type: Full-time, remote (Philippines)

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Pacific Time (about 12:00 – 8:00 AM Manila during US daylight time, 1:00 – 9:00 AM in winter). This is a graveyard shift PHT.

Compensation: USD 1,000 – 1,800/month base + uncapped commission: 10% of first-year contract value on closed Enterprise deals and 15% on Educator deals, paid as the customer's payments are collected, with a 90-day clawback on refunds.



About Nullgen

Nullgen AI Blocker is a browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari that stops people typing or pasting into AI prompt boxes – ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, and tools that launched last week – while the rest of the page keeps working. Detection runs on the device, so prompt text and keystrokes never leave the browser. Nullgen does not read or collect what anyone types, which is the privacy story our buyers care about most.



The free extension protects a single browser. Nullgen Pro adds the management layer that organizations buy: zero-touch force-install through Intune, Jamf, Kandji, Google Workspace, or Group Policy; allow/deny policies for approved AI tools; access requests that route to named approvers; and one dashboard of users, devices, requests, and policies. The management platform runs on AWS. Schools and companies start with a 30-day trial – no credit card – and convert to per-seat pricing.



The Role

You are our first sales hire and you own the pipeline end to end: outbound, qualification, live demos, procurement, close. Your buyers are US enterprise IT and security leaders (CISOs, IT directors, security engineers) and K-12 district technology leaders (CTOs, CIOs, Directors of Technology), plus the instructional leaders they buy alongside. You work directly with the founder.



This needs a rare mix: outbound hustle and enough technical fluency to explain how on-device detection differs from a web filter or DLP, walk an IT director through an MDM deployment, and handle privacy and security objections on live video calls.



One more thing to know before you apply: this is an early-stage company, and the job is not only sales. When the pipeline is quiet or the founder is running a growth experiment, you will flex into marketing work – finding and joining the online conversations where IT leaders and school technology directors already talk about AI in the workplace and the classroom (Reddit, LinkedIn, X, industry forums), replying with something genuinely useful, drafting outreach and short content, and testing guerrilla tactics to see what brings in trials. If you only want to work leads that someone else generates, this is not the right role. If you like owning the whole top of the funnel, it is.



What you will do

- Own outbound: run and optimize high-volume cold
 campaigns (copy, deliverability, sequencing, testing).

- Qualify replies and inbound trial signups, and book live demos.

- Lead demo calls with IT directors, CISOs, and district technology leaders; demonstrate the extension, the dashboard, and deployment; handle security and privacy objections.

- Run pilots and procurement: quotes, purchase orders, vendor forms, and the longer buying cycles of school districts.

- Complete security and privacy questionnaires with the founder. We describe exactly what the product does and does not do, and we do not claim certifications we do not hold.

- Keep the pipeline honest in HubSpot: stages, next steps, call notes, forecast.

- Flex into marketing when needed: community and social prospecting, guerrilla marketing experiments, outreach copy, and short content, working from the founder's playbook and reporting what worked.

- Feed what you hear from buyers back into product and marketing.



Required

- 2+ years managing a B2B SaaS pipeline in HubSpot or a similar CRM, with deals you closed yourself.

- 2+ years running high-volume cold
 in Instantly.ai (or Smartlead / lemlist), including warm-up, deliverability, and copy testing.

- Fluent, natural spoken and written English; comfortable leading technical video calls with US executives and writing public replies that do not read like a sales pitch.

- Enough technical depth to learn our architecture and deployment story in your first two weeks and explain it without a script.

- Comfortable wearing more than one hat: sales first, marketing when the week calls for it.

- Reliable availability on the Pacific schedule above, a quiet space for video calls, a webcam, and stable internet with a backup.



Bonus

- You have sold to US IT / security teams or to K-12 school districts.

- You have touched MDM or browser management (Intune, Jamf, Google Admin, Group Policy).

- You have done community-led or social selling: LinkedIn, Reddit, X, or niche forums, with results you can point to.

- You have worked with LinkedIn prospecting tools (Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay).



How to apply

We receive a high volume of applications and only review the ones that follow these instructions exactly.



1. Try the product first. Install the free Nullgen extension from nullgen.ai, open any AI assistant, and try to type.

2. The audio test. Include a link to a 60-second voice or video recording (Vocaroo or Loom). Introduce yourself, then explain to me – as if I were a school district technology director – why blocking the prompt box on the device is different from blocking ChatGPT on the network.

3. The subject line. The subject line of your application must be exactly: Nullgen Enterprise Sales 2026. Applications without it are deleted unread.

You will support our Corporate Sales Coordinator by following up with companies, agencies, planners, schools and organizations that have already contacted us. Corporate opportunities often involve busy decision-makers, multiple stakeholders and proposals requiring several follow-ups.



Your role is to keep these opportunities moving and ensure valuable leads do not become stale because a reminder, response or next step was missed.



This is not a traditional cold-calling role. You will primarily communicate with organizations that have already contacted Snaptique or received information from us.



Your Responsibilities



- Manage new, active and stale corporate leads

- Follow up with clients by telephone,
 and text

- Follow up on quotes and proposals awaiting a decision

- Re-engage organizations that stopped responding

description:
We're a creative strategy agency. Our clients are DTC brands who run ads on Meta and Google, and you'd write the copy on those ads. These run with real budget behind them and get judged on results.



We're looking for independent, self-starting people who can write ads that actually sell. This role is 100% remote and we mostly work async, so you need to be able to work without your hand held. Our team is small, spread across the world, and amazing at what they do.



You can see the kind of work we do at 
.



What you'd do

- Write headlines and body copy for static ads, using a brief to guide you

- Anywhere from 3-5 copy variations per concept

- Write short UGC scripts, 15 to 45 seconds, that a real person can say out loud

- Take revisions from our internal QC and from clients, and care enough about the first version that there aren't many revisions



What you need

- 3+ years writing copy for paid social ads, specifically Meta

- Native or near-native written English. The whole job is writing

- Samples of real ads you've written. Better if you know which ones performed and why

- You know how to write for different awareness stages

- Experience working in a remote agency



Nice to have

- Experience working in ClickUp

- Experience with health, wellness or personal care brands, where claims have to be careful



You are perfect if:

- You will look for something to do if your desk clears instead of waiting to be told what to do

- You have a deep commitment to quality and take pride in your work

- You don't need perfect instructions and environments, you can make it work



What we offer

- A genuinely flexible schedule. Work the hours that suit you. There's one team call a week you can plan around, and we need you reachable each working day. Past that, nobody is watching the clock

- No set number of leave days. Take time off when you need it, just give us notice and make sure your work is covered. The one thing that doesn't work is going quiet, so we do need you around the rest of the time

- Philippine regular holidays, paid

- We track time to understand what our work costs us, not to check up on you



The details

20 hours a week to start, $800/month. Full time is possible if we work well together, and the rate goes up with it. Our team is small enough that whoever takes this seat shapes how we write ads, not just what gets written.



To apply

- Send 3 ads you've written, with the copy pasted in

title: Revenue Cycle Management Specialist – Physical Therapy
description:
Prompt Healthcare EMR Experience Required



TruWell Physical Therapy is looking for an experienced Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist to help manage billing and accounts receivable for our growing physical therapy practice.



We are specifically looking for someone with strong medical billing experience and hands-on experience using Prompt Healthcare EMR.



Responsibilities



* Manage the full revenue cycle from claim submission through payment

* Review claims for accuracy before submission

* Submit and track insurance claims

* Work insurance rejections and denials

* Follow up on unpaid and underpaid claims

* Manage Accounts Receivable (A/R) aging

* Correct and resubmit claims when necessary

* Post and reconcile insurance payments and ERAs

* Identify billing trends and recurring claim issues

* Verify claim status with insurance companies

* Assist with insurance eligibility and authorization issues when needed

* Maintain accurate notes and follow-up documentation in Prompt

* Provide regular updates on outstanding claims, denials, and collections

* Help improve billing processes and reduce outstanding A/R



Qualifications



Required:



* Experience with Prompt Healthcare EMR

* Medical billing / Revenue Cycle Management experience

* Experience working with U.S. health insurance claims

* Knowledge of claim submission, denials, EOBs/ERAs, payment posting, and A/R follow-up

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Comfortable contacting insurance companies

* Able to work independently and follow claims through to resolution



Preferred:



* Physical therapy or outpatient rehabilitation billing experience

* Experience with Medicare and commercial insurance

* Experience with prior authorizations

* Experience investigating underpayments and insurance denials



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the revenue cycle, not someone who simply submits claims.



The right person will actively investigate unpaid claims, determine why claims are not being paid, take the necessary corrective action, and continue following up until the account is resolved.



Accuracy, organization, communication, and follow-through are extremely important in this position.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of medical billing/RCM experience do you have?

2. Describe your experience using Prompt Healthcare EMR.

3. Have you handled billing for physical therapy or outpatient rehabilitation practices?

4. What parts of the revenue cycle have you personally managed?

5. What is your experience with A/R follow-up and insurance denials?

6. What hours are you available to work in U.S. Eastern Time?

7. What is your desired hourly rate?

 

Video Introduction Required



Please submit a 1–3 minute video introduction** with your application.



In your video, please briefly:



* Introduce yourself

* Describe your medical billing and RCM experience

* Explain your experience with Prompt Healthcare EMR

* Describe your experience handling denials and A/R follow-up

* Tell us why you believe you would be a good fit for this position



Applications submitted without a video introduction will not be considered.



Please begin your written application with the words *PROMPT RCM” so we know you read the entire job posting.



I especially like requiring them to talk about Prompt, denials, and A/R in the video because it makes it much harder for someone to submit a generic application.

title: AI Video Content Creator / Virtual Assistant
description:
We are an e-commerce company looking for a creative and dependable AI Product Video Creator / Virtual Assistant to join our team and help us produce high-quality short-form product content at scale.



This position will focus primarily on using DaVinci with Seedance 2.0 Fast to transform existing product images into realistic, engaging AI-generated videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social media and e-commerce platforms.



We will provide the products, images, general concepts, and creative direction. Your job will be to turn those assets into polished AI-generated videos that make our products look interesting, realistic, and visually compelling.



What You'll Be Doing



• Creating AI-generated product videos using DaVinci / Seedance 2.0 Fast

• Turning static product photos into engaging short-form videos

• Writing, testing, and refining prompts to achieve realistic results

• Developing different concepts and scenes around the same product

• Reviewing AI generations and identifying the strongest outputs

• Regenerating and refining content when results don't meet our standards

• Following established creative direction while also contributing new ideas

• Producing content consistently and at volume

• Organizing completed videos and maintaining an efficient production workflow



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is creative, technically comfortable, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in AI-generated content.



Previous experience with AI image-to-video or text-to-video generation is strongly preferred.



Experience with DaVinci / Seedance is a plus, but it is not necessarily required if you already have strong experience with other AI video generation platforms and are confident learning a new workflow.



You should be comfortable experimenting. AI video generation often requires trying different prompts, camera movements, scenes, and approaches before getting the right result.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have experience creating AI-generated videos

• Understand prompting and how small prompt changes affect generations

• Have a good eye for realistic, visually appealing content

• Understand TikTok, Reels, and short-form social media content

• Can follow detailed creative instructions

• Can work independently without constant supervision

• Are organized and able to produce a high volume of content

• Can identify obvious AI artifacts, unrealistic movement, or poor generations

• Are willing to learn and improve as AI video technology evolves



Long-Term Opportunity



We are building a significant AI content operation and expect our video production volume to grow considerably.



This is not intended to be a one-time project. We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team and grow with the position as we expand our content production.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

Examples of AI-generated videos or other relevant creative work you've produced

A portfolio, if available

Your resume or a summary of your previous work experience

The AI video/image tools you have experience using

Your current work availability

The earliest date you would be available to start



Please also include the phrase "Seedance" somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire job posting.



We look forward to seeing your work!
