title: Media Buyer - Meta
description:
Facebook / Meta Ads Media Buyer — Lead Generation



JT Media is a marketing agency that helps healthcare companies recruit new job candidates and generate qualified private-pay home care clients through digital advertising.



We are looking for an experienced
 / Meta Ads Media Buyer to manage campaigns across multiple client accounts, develop and test new advertising angles, and consistently improve lead quality and cost per lead.



Home Care Experience Is Highly Preferred



If you have previously managed Meta Ads specifically for non-medical home care agencies, please make this clear at the beginning of your application and include examples of your results.



Direct experience generating caregiver applicants, private-pay home care leads, or other types of leads for non-medical home care agencies is a major advantage and may qualify you for increased compensation.



What We're Looking For



We are NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to launch
 campaigns and make basic optimizations.



We want a media buyer who understands direct-response marketing to cold audiences and knows how to systematically find new ways to generate qualified leads.



You should be comfortable researching an unfamiliar market, understanding the target customer, identifying their problems and motivations, developing new angles and offers, creating ads around those ideas, testing them, analyzing the results, and continuously improving performance.



You should genuinely enjoy the process of researching, creating, testing, analyzing, and finding winners.



Your Primary Responsibilities



Media Buying & Campaign Management



Manage Meta advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts. Launch campaigns, monitor performance, optimize budgets and targeting, troubleshoot problems, and work to consistently improve lead quality and cost per lead.



Cold Traffic Marketing



Develop advertising specifically designed to convert people who have never heard of the client before. You should understand how messaging, offers, creative, targeting, and funnels work together when advertising to cold audiences.



Market & Customer Research



Research the industries and markets we advertise in to deeply understand the target customer.



Identify customer personas, pain points, motivations, objections, desires, and triggers that can be turned into effective advertising.



Angles & Offer Development



Continuously search for new ways to position our clients' services.



Develop and test new hooks, angles, messaging, offers, and concepts rather than relying indefinitely on existing winning ads.



Creative Testing



Build structured creative testing strategies and use AI tools to develop new static ad creatives and variations.



You should understand why you're testing something, what variable you're testing, and what the results tell you—not simply create random variations.



Audience & Funnel Strategy



Build and manage appropriate audiences, including lookalike and retargeting audiences, and understand how targeting and funnels should change based on the stage of the customer journey.



Performance Analysis



Analyze campaign and creative performance to determine what is working, what isn't, and what should be tested next.



We want someone who can turn advertising data into actionable decisions.



Reporting



Provide clear updates on campaign performance, creative tests, lead costs, results, learnings, and upcoming tests so our team always understands what is happening within our accounts.



Team Collaboration



Communicate consistently through Microsoft Teams, execute strategies developed with leadership, and proactively contribute your own ideas for improving campaign performance.



Ideal Candidate



You:



Have proven experience managing
 / Meta Ads and can provide case studies or actual results.

Understand how to generate leads from cold traffic.

Understand direct-response advertising and lead generation.

Know how to research a market and deeply understand the target customer.

Know how to develop and test new advertising angles, hooks, offers, messaging, and creatives.

Understand how to structure tests and use performance data to determine what to test next.

Have strong knowledge of lookalike audiences, retargeting audiences, funnels, and Meta campaign structure.

Have experience creating static advertising creatives using AI tools.

Have strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Have experience using Microsoft Teams or similar communication platforms.

Are highly responsive during working hours.

Have exceptional attention to detail.

Have a reliable internet connection and computer.



Strongly Preferred: Previous experience running Meta Ads for non-medical home care agencies, particularly caregiver recruitment and/or private-pay client acquisition.



Experience with healthcare, recruitment, or other lead-generation campaigns is also valuable.



Schedule



Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time



As JT Media continues to grow, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation.



Payment Structure



$250/week, paid weekly



Candidates with significant, proven non-medical home care Meta Ads experience may qualify for higher compensation.



How to Apply



Please
 or message us with:



Your resume in PDF format.

A short introduction explaining why you believe you're a strong fit for this position.

Examples, screenshots, or case studies showing results from Meta Ads campaigns you've personally managed.

A brief explanation of the types of businesses, offers, and audiences you've advertised to.

Any experience you've had advertising for non-medical home care agencies. Please include specific results whenever possible.

Relevant professional references we can contact (optional, but preferred).

A screenshot of your internet speed test.

Your preferred days and times for an interview, including your timezone.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the word "MANGO" so we know you've read the entire job description and understand the position.



Qualified candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.

title: Wedding Lead Nurture & Sales Support Coordinator
description:
Wedding Lead Nurture & Sales Support Coordinator



Starting Salary: PHP 25,000 per month

Position: Full-time, long-term remote role

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 12:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m. Toronto time



About the Role



Snaptique Photo Booths is looking for a warm, organized and persistent Wedding Lead Nurture & Sales Support Coordinator.



You will support our Wedding Sales Coordinator by following up with couples who have already contacted us. Many couples are interested but require additional reminders, reassurance or time before making a decision. Your job is to ensure these opportunities receive consistent attention and do not become stale because a follow-up was missed.



This is not a traditional cold-calling role. You will primarily communicate with couples who have already inquired or received information from Snaptique.



Your Responsibilities



- Manage new, active and stale wedding leads

- Follow up with couples by telephone,
 and text

- Follow up on quotes awaiting a decision

- Re-engage couples who stopped responding

- Identify inquiries that have not received a quote

- Ask questions to understand each couple’s wedding plans and needs

- Answer routine questions about our services and booking process

- Schedule follow-ups around the couple’s planning timeline

- Keep accurate CRM notes, statuses and follow-up dates

- Ensure every assigned lead has a clear next action

- Identify duplicate, unqualified, expired or lost opportunities

- Help clean and qualify our existing wedding-lead backlog

- Prevent active leads from becoming stale

- Recognize when a couple is ready to return to the Wedding Sales Coordinator

- Provide clear handoff notes for sales-ready opportunities

- Report on leads contacted, reactivated and returned for closing



Telephone Communication



This position requires regular outbound calls to prospective clients in Canada.



Excellent professional spoken and written English is required. You must sound clear, confident, friendly and natural when speaking with couples by telephone or video call.



You must be comfortable calling a couple when a conversation would be more effective than another
 or text.



Clear Ownership



You own the follow-up process for your assigned wedding leads.



Every assigned lead must have:



- A correct status

- Complete and useful notes

- A clearly defined next action

- A scheduled follow-up date

- A final outcome when it is no longer active



The Wedding Sales Coordinator remains responsible for detailed recommendations, pricing, proposal changes, negotiation and closing. When a couple becomes engaged and sales-ready, you will return the opportunity with complete notes and a clear summary.



Requirements



- Excellent professional spoken and written English

- Confident and personable on telephone and video calls

- Warm, patient and reassuring communication style

- Strong organization and follow-up skills

- Comfortable working through a high volume of leads

- Persistent without making couples feel pressured

- Strong attention to details, dates and communication history

- Experience using a CRM or ability to learn one quickly

- Consistent about documenting conversations and next steps

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

- Quiet workspace suitable for professional client calls

- Quality headset with clear audio

- Reliable attendance during the required Toronto-time schedule

- Ability to work independently and communicate with a remote team



Wedding, hospitality, customer service, appointment-setting, lead-nurturing or sales-support experience is an advantage.



Working Hours



The required schedule is **Monday through Friday, 12:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m. Toronto time**.



This is an overnight schedule in the Philippines. Toronto observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine hours will change by one hour during the year. Applicants must be comfortable maintaining the stated Toronto-time schedule.



How Success Will Be Measured



- Leads contacted on time

- Quotes followed up consistently

- Reduction in wedding leads becoming stale

- Stale leads successfully re-engaged

- Accuracy of CRM notes and statuses

- Percentage of leads with a scheduled next action

- Qualified opportunities returned to the Wedding Sales Coordinator

- Bookings recovered through thoughtful follow-up

- Quality and professionalism of client communication



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience

2. Your experience with client calls, lead follow-up or appointment setting

3. The CRM systems you have used

4. Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 12:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m. Toronto time

5. A link to a 60–90 second video or voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you would follow up with a couple who received a quote but stopped responding

6. The word **CONFETTI** in your subject line so we know you read the complete posting



Applications without a voice or video introduction will not be considered.

title: Senior Creator Affiliate & Social Media Growth Manager - Shopify DTC Brand

Compensation: Starting at $500 USD per week, paid weekly, plus a negotiable, scalable monthly performance-based revenue share tied to verified revenue generated through the affiliate program.



About 



HappyCluck is a U.S.-based e-commerce brand for backyard chicken keepers. We sell thoughtful, transparent products and create practical educational resources that help customers support healthier, happier backyard flocks and better egg quality.



You will work directly on the growth of 
: [
](
)

We are now expanding beyond Amazon and building Shopify and TikTok into meaningful long-term sales channels. The Shopify store is fully built, products are live, and we are ready to begin immediately.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or general social-media role. We are looking for a senior, highly organized growth operator who can independently build and run a creator-affiliate program from the ground up, manage social media, create repeatable systems, and report directly to the founder.



The objective is to build a professional creator-partnership ecosystem: a network of affiliate creators, ambassadors, UGC creators, and community partners who authentically reach backyard chicken keepers and generate measurable traffic, content, subscribers, and sales.



What you will be responsible for



- Build and operate HappyCluck’s creator-affiliate program from scratch using Shopify Collabs and other approved tools

- Recruit, qualify, contact, onboard, and retain relevant U.S.-based creators, affiliates, ambassadors, and UGC creators

- Focus on creators in backyard chickens, homesteading, small farms, poultry, rural/family lifestyle, animal care, natural living, and related niches

- Build and maintain a creator database/CRM with creator contacts, platforms, follower data, engagement notes, outreach history, codes, links, kit status, content status, sales, commissions, and follow-up tasks

- Write personalized outreach and follow-up messages; we do not want generic bulk spam

- Evaluate creators based on real engagement, niche relevance, audience quality, content ability, brand safety, and likelihood of driving sales

- Onboard creators with affiliate links, discount codes, product education, approved messaging, FTC disclosure requirements, content ideas, and clear expectations

- Coordinate, track, and follow up on product kits sent to creators

- Build toward a disciplined program that sends approximately 50–100 creator kits per month after the initial ramp-up

- Develop repeat relationships with the best creators, not just one-time gifting campaigns

- Create ambassador tiers, creator incentives, recurring campaigns, and retention systems for top performers

- Secure creator content and obtain written paid-ad usage rights when needed

- Track creator performance, attributed orders, revenue, commissions, refunds, top content, and top partners

- Improve the program every month by scaling what works and removing weak creators or weak offers



Social media responsibilities



- Manage HappyCluck’s organic social media on Instagram, TikTok,
, Pinterest, YouTube Shorts, and other approved channels

- Create and maintain a monthly social-content calendar

- Create, edit, repurpose, schedule, and publish short-form videos, images, captions, stories, and educational content

- Turn creator content, customer reviews, product education, blog content, founder ideas, and chicken-keeping questions into strong social posts

- Develop recurring content formats, hooks, creator briefs, content pillars, and visual templates

- Track what content drives views, engagement, clicks, creator applications, and sales

- Maintain an organized library of content, editable files, published links, creator rights, top-performing hooks, and reusable assets



Requirements



- At least 3–5 years of direct experience in creator marketing, influencer marketing, affiliate management, Shopify/DTC e-commerce, UGC, or social-media growth

- Proven experience building or materially growing creator, influencer, affiliate, ambassador, product-seeding, referral, or UGC programs for real consumer brands

- Experience recruiting and managing creators from outreach through onboarding, product delivery, content creation, tracking, and retention

- Shopify experience is required; Shopify Collabs experience is strongly preferred

- Experience with tools such as Refersion, UpPromote, GoAffPro, 
, Awin, ShareASale, GRIN, Aspire, CreatorIQ, or similar platforms is a plus

- Experience with physical consumer brands is required; DTC, wellness, pet, food, supplements, agriculture, home, beauty, or lifestyle experience is preferred

- Fluent written and spoken English is required

- You must be able to write natural, persuasive outreach and social content for a U.S. audience

- Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest,
, and creator-led short-form content

- Strong reporting, spreadsheet, CRM, organization, and project-management skills

- You must be proactive, highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to make smart daily decisions without constant instruction

- Reliable computer, fast internet, backup internet or power plan, and ability to work U.S. Pacific Time hours



AI and software



You must be highly comfortable with AI and willing to use it as part of your daily workflow.



- Claude for research, planning, creator briefs, outreach improvement, reporting, SOPs, and workflows

- Higgsfield for AI-assisted short-form visual and video content

- ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar AI research/content tools

- Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, Premiere Pro, or similar editing tools

- Google Workspace, Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, ClickUp, Asana, Trello, HubSpot, or similar tools

- Shopify, Shopify Collabs, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Business tools, Instagram, Pinterest, YouTube Studio, and social scheduling tools



We will provide access to the software and systems needed to succeed.



Brand standards



HappyCluck serves an animal-wellness and backyard-chicken audience. Accuracy and customer trust matter.



- Follow approved brand and product messaging

- Do not make unsupported medical, treatment, cure, prevention, diagnostic, veterinary, or disease-related claims

- Ensure creators use approved messaging and appropriate FTC disclosure language

- Flag anything questionable for review before publishing

- Protect the brand through useful, transparent, high-quality communication



Compensation and growth opportunity



- Starting compensation is $500 USD per week, paid weekly

- Compensation is negotiable for an exceptional candidate with proven, directly relevant results

- You will also earn a negotiable, scalable monthly percentage of verified affiliate-attributed net revenue generated through the program you build and manage

- The more you successfully recruit, activate, retain, and develop high-quality creators, the more you can earn

- Revenue share will be calculated only on completed, trackable affiliate sales after discounts, refunds, returns, cancellations, chargebacks, fraud, taxes, and shipping

- Performance terms will be agreed upon in writing after we review experience, references, and the paid test

- This is a long-term opportunity for the right person, with real room to grow as the program grows



How to apply



Please include all of the following:



- Resume/CV

- A short cover letter explaining why you are a strong fit

- A 3–5 minute Loom video in fluent English explaining:

  - A creator, affiliate, influencer, ambassador, product-seeding, or UGC program you built or managed

  - The brand/category, your exact responsibilities, tools used, and measurable results

  - How you would build HappyCluck’s program in the first 30 days

- Portfolio, LinkedIn profile, campaign examples, social accounts managed, outreach examples, dashboards, or other proof of work

- Two professional references from prior clients, employers, founders, or brands you have worked with

- Confirmation that you can work full-time during U.S. Pacific Time business hours

- Your earliest available start date

- Your requested weekly rate if you are seeking more than $500/week, with a brief explanation of why

- Your location, internet speed, backup internet/power plan, and available equipment



Please also answer this question:



“If you had to recruit 100 highly relevant U.S.-based creator affiliates for a Shopify brand in the backyard-chicken category, where would you find them, how would you qualify them, and what would your first outreach message say?”



In the first line of your application, write:



HappyCluck Creator Growth Manager — I read the full job post.



Applications without a Loom video, direct proof of experience, and professional references will not be considered.

title: SEO AND AEO SPECIALIST
description:
We are a UK property management company hiring a dedicated SEO and AEO specialist to own search visibility across organic search, local search and AI search.



The website is already built. Service pages, location pages, accommodation listings, booking system and payments are all in place. This is not a build role. Your job is to make what exists rank, get found, get cited by AI assistants, and generate enquiries.



We serve two audiences through one website: landlords seeking property management, and guests booking accommodation. Both need to be found.



You will implement on page and technical SEO changes directly in WordPress and work with a developer for larger builds.



FIRST 90 DAYS



You begin with a full assessment of where the site stands, then a prioritised plan agreed with the Director.



1. Technical SEO audit of both WordPress installations: indexation, crawl health, redirects, canonicals, duplicate content, architecture, internal linking, schema, Core Web Vitals

2. Content audit of every page: what ranks, what is invisible, what is thin or duplicated across locations, what to merge, rewrite or remove

3. Local SEO audit: Google Business Profile, citations and NAP consistency, map pack positions

4. AEO baseline: how we appear, or do not, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews

5. Competitor benchmark: who ranks and who gets cited in our categories and areas, and why

6. Keyword and topic research producing a prioritised content plan

7. Reporting baseline in Search Console and GA4



Output: a written plan with priorities, expected impact and timeframes, approved before execution.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Technical SEO

Fix indexation, crawl, sitemap and robots issues. Fix canonicals, duplicates, 404s and redirect chains. Manage site architecture and internal linking. Implement and validate schema (LocalBusiness, Organization, Service, FAQ, Review, Product, Offer, breadcrumbs). Improve Core Web Vitals with the developer, without removing conversion elements.



Content SEO and blogs

Own the content calendar. Research topics by search demand, competitor gaps and buyer questions. Write or oversee blog articles, guides, FAQs and location content matched to search intent. Rewrite existing pages to rank, and differentiate location pages so no two read as duplicates. Optimise titles, meta, headings, images and internal links on everything published.



Local SEO and Google Business Profile

Manage the GBP in full: categories, services, descriptions, photos, posts, Q and A, review strategy. Maintain NAP and citation consistency. Implement local schema and maps. Build local keyword strategy for service plus location and near me queries. Improve map pack positions and report monthly.



AEO and AI search

Structure content so AI assistants can extract and cite it. Build entity consistency across the web. Manage structured data, llms.txt and crawler access. Build third party mentions and citations. Track AI visibility and share of voice against competitors. Target featured snippets, People Also Ask and AI Overviews.



Conversion support

Find pages with traffic but no enquiries and diagnose why. Recommend changes supported by data, for approval before implementation.



Tracking and reporting

Maintain GTM and GA4 so forms, calls, WhatsApp clicks, bookings and calendar actions are tracked accurately. Own Search Console. Produce a monthly report: rankings, traffic, local positions, AI visibility, enquiries by source, next month priorities.



WordPress implementation

Implement on page, schema, redirect and content changes in WordPress and Elementor. Publish and optimise content pages. Coordinate with the developer on templates, performance and larger builds.



HOW WE WORK



Design specifications are final. Where a page design or template is supplied, it is not altered without written approval.



Proposed changes to any approved page are submitted in writing with the reason and expected effect, and approved before being made.



Work is complete when it is live, indexed where intended, and functioning. Drafts are not reported as complete.



Delays, blockers and errors are raised as soon as known.



Written weekly summary every Friday: what went live, what is in progress, what is blocked.



Daily video call with camera on. Under 60 minutes response time during working hours.



This is an exclusive full time role. No other employment or freelance work in SEO, content, web development or digital marketing during the contract.



WHAT WE MEASURE



Qualified enquiries from organic and local search, month over month

Rankings on priority keywords in target locations

Map pack positions

How often we are named and cited by AI assistants

Organic traffic to priority pages

Content published against the calendar and how it performs

Indexation health and error counts in Search Console

Accuracy of conversion tracking



REQUIREMENTS



Essential

3 or more years in SEO with results you can evidence

Strong technical SEO, able to audit and implement fixes

Proven local SEO including GBP and multi location strategy

Content SEO: research, briefing, writing or editing, optimisation

Working knowledge of AEO and AI search visibility, or a clear plan to develop it fast

Hands on WordPress and Elementor at the level needed to implement SEO changes and publish content without help

Search Console, GTM and GA4 experience

Fluent written English suitable for publishing

Good documentation habits



Desirable

Property, hospitality, travel or local service lead generation experience

Digital PR and link acquisition

Looker Studio

MotoPress Hotel Booking familiarity

GoHighLevel familiarity

Screaming Frog, Ahrefs or Semrush at an advanced level

Content operations with AI writing tools under editorial control



All paid tools are provided, including Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Elementor Pro.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications missing any of the following will not be reviewed.



1. Your SEO experience: years, types of businesses, your specific role

2. Three SEO results you personally achieved: situation, what you did, measurable outcome. Screenshots from Search Console, Ahrefs or GA4 preferred

3. Written answer: a service business operates in twelve towns and wants to rank in all of them. How do you build and rank those pages without duplicate content, and what timeframe do you expect?

4. Written answer: how would you get a local service business named and cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews? Be specific about what you would actually do

5. Written answer: you inherit a site with 200 pages built by someone else. What do you do in your first two weeks?

6. Written answer: describe a time a client or manager asked you to change something you disagreed with, and what you did

7. Two writing samples: one blog article and one service or location page you wrote or substantially rewrote, with the ranking or traffic result if known

8. Tools you use

9. Confirm you are available 10:00 to 19:00 UK time, Monday to Friday, with no other current work commitments



Process: application review, video interview including a live screen share audit of one page, paid task for shortlisted candidates, offer.



Independent contractor agreement under the laws of England and Wales. Three month probation. Performance and compensation reviewed every six months.

title: Remote Appointment Setter & Customer Success Coordinator
description:
Remote Appointment Setter & Customer Success Coordinator



Company: Gulf Coast Nightlights

Location: Remote (Preference for Southwest Florida residents)

Job Type: Flexible | Full-Time Compensation



Join a Fast-Growing, Family-Oriented Company



At Gulf Coast Nightlights, we design and install premium landscape lighting, lanai lighting, and architectural lighting for homeowners throughout Southwest Florida.



We're a young, fast-growing company that's passionate about creating incredible customer experiences and building a team that genuinely enjoys working together. We believe work should be rewarding, flexible, and fun, and we treat our team like family.



We're looking for someone who is dependable, personable, and highly responsive to help us manage incoming leads from our online advertising. Your primary responsibility will be communicating with homeowners, qualifying them, and scheduling estimates for our sales team.



What You'll Do



* Respond immediately to new online leads (our goal is **within 2 minutes**)

* Answer inbound phone calls and text messages

* Qualify homeowners using our qualification process

* Schedule free in-home lighting consultations

* Organize appointments efficiently to create the best driving routes for our estimator

* Maintain accurate customer information in our CRM

* Create an outstanding first impression of our company

* Communicate professionally while building rapport with prospective customers



What Makes This Position Unique



This isn't a traditional customer service position where you're sitting at a desk waiting for work.



Instead, you'll simply need to remain available during our business hours:



Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Saturday & Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM



When a new lead comes in, we expect you to respond immediately.



Most days involve short bursts of activity throughout the day, giving you plenty of flexibility between calls and messages.



We compensate this position as though it's a full-time role because we value your availability and responsiveness. In return, we expect reliability and a commitment to contacting every new lead as quickly as possible.



Who This Role Is Perfect For



This position is ideal for someone with a flexible schedule who wants excellent earning potential without spending the entire day at a desk. It can be a great fit for a college student taking classes online, a virtual assistant, a nanny with downtime, or anyone working from home who can remain available during our business hours.



If you enjoy talking with people, staying organized, and working independently while still being part of a supportive team, you'll likely love this role.



Who We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely responsive and dependable

* Friendly, charismatic, and confident on the phone

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Proactive and able to work independently

* Excellent at building rapport with homeowners

* Comfortable asking qualifying questions and identifying quality leads

* Able to schedule appointments efficiently and optimize routes

* Comfortable using a computer, smartphone, and CRM software

* Comfortable appearing in social media videos as the company grows

* Someone who understands that **speed-to-lead is our #1 priority**



Requirements



* Reliable computer

* Reliable smartphone

* High-speed internet connection

* Quiet place to answer calls

* Excellent communication skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Ability to respond to new leads within approximately **2 minutes** during business hours



Growth Opportunity



This position is designed to grow with the right person.



As Gulf Coast Nightlights continues expanding, we'd love for this role to evolve into much more than appointment setting. If you enjoy marketing, social media, customer experience, or business operations, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities.



Potential future opportunities include:



* Marketing & Social Media

* Becoming one of the faces of Gulf Coast Nightlights through videos and online content

* Customer Success Management

* Office & Administrative Management

* Operations Leadership



With growth comes increased compensation, performance bonuses, benefits, and long-term career opportunities.



Our Culture



We're building more than a lighting company—we're building a team.



We genuinely care about the people we work with and believe in supporting each other both professionally and personally. We celebrate wins together, help each other grow, and strive to create a workplace where everyone feels valued.



If you're local, we'd love for you to become part of the team beyond just work. Whether it's grabbing lunch, celebrating milestones, volunteering, or team outings, we want to build real relationships with the people who help us grow our business.



When you join Gulf Coast Nightlights, you're joining a company that wants to invest in your success just as much as our own.



Compensation



Competitive full-time compensation with exceptional flexibility.



As the company grows, there are opportunities for increased pay, bonuses, benefits, and advancement into leadership roles.



Ready to Join Our Team?



We're not just looking to fill a position—we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



If you're dependable, organized, love talking with people, and want a flexible work-from-home opportunity with a company that genuinely values its team, we'd love to meet you.



As Gulf Coast Nightlights continues to grow across Southwest Florida, you'll have the opportunity to grow right alongside us, with increased responsibilities, higher earning potential, and future leadership opportunities.



If this sounds like the perfect fit, click "Apply Now" and tell us:



* Why you'd be a great fit for this role

* What your current schedule looks like

* Why you'd excel in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment



We're reviewing applications as they come in and plan to hire quickly, so don't wait—we look forward to meeting you!

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Rep
description:
RED | Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Shopify)



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an exceptional Customer Service Representative to join our team.



This isn't just another customer service job.



We're looking for someone who is driven, adaptable, proactive, and genuinely excited to grow with a company long-term.

We value attitude, work ethic, and the willingness to learn just as much as experience.



If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new systems, and continuously improving, we'd love to hear from you.





Important



We need someone who wants to build a long-term career with us. While we understand that many virtual assistants work with multiple clients, preference will be given to applicants who can fully commit to our team but we can still accept those applicants with other part time jobs as long as they declare it and they can promise that they can give full focus during their clocked in hours with us. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for people who want to grow with us: not just fill available hours. 



If you're dependable, eager to learn, and consistently perform at a high level, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and long-term growth within the company.





Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

* Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

* Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

* Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

* Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

* Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

* Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

* Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught. A strong work ethic and great attitude are much harder to teach.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Loop Subscriptions

* Checkout Champ

* Ecommerce Customer Cupport

* Subscription-based businesses

* Gorgias, Commslayer, Richpanel, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Front, or similar helpdesk platforms



If you don't have experience with every tool listed above, that's okay. We provide training for the right candidate.



Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

* Resolving customer concerns efficiently.

* Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, subscriptions, and product questions.

* Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

* Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.



Compensation & Growth



* Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

* New hires will begin on a part-time trial period

* High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40-48 hours/week)

* Performance bonuses and opportunities for career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company.

Preference will be given to applicants who are able to make our team their primary work commitment.





Our Hiring Process



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn and grow.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note: The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge.

Only candidates who successfully pass this stage will move on to paid training.



Requirements



* At least 18 years old.

* Fluent in written English.

* Strong grammar and communication skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Able to work independently.

* Eager to learn and continuously improve.

How to Apply

title: Python Data Scraper / Web Scraping Expert (Part-Time to Full-Time)
description:
Position: Part-Time (A few days per week, with potential to transition to Full-Time)

Starting Rate: $7.00 - $8.00 USD / hour (Performance-based increases available)

Location: Remote (Philippines)



We are seeking a highly experienced Python Data Scraper to join our remote team on a part-time basis. Extract, clean, and structure large datasets accurately and rapidly.



Collaborate daily with our American lead programmer to understand specific project requirements and deliverables.



Troubleshoot and bypass anti-scraping mechanisms as they arise.

Independent Infrastructure: You must have your own robust setup, including access to virtual machines (VMs), proxies, and the necessary hardware/software architecture to execute fast and highly accurate scrapes.



Exceptional English Communication: You must speak, read, and write English fluently. The ability to clearly understand complex technical requirements, ask the right questions, and communicate roadblocks is strictly required for this role.



Attention to Detail: A strong commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.



Availability: Able to commit to a few days a week with a schedule that allows for reasonable overlap with US time zones for meetings and collaboration.



Why Work With Us?

Competitive Starting Pay: $7.00 - $8.00 per hour, which is well above average for part-time remote roles, with direct opportunities for raises based on the quality of your work.



Growth Potential: We want to hire for the long term. Prove your skills part-time, and we will gladly transition you to a full-time role.



Creative Freedom: We value innovation. If you know a better, faster way to get the job done, we want to hear it and implement it.



How to Apply & Technical Screening

title: Amazon PPC ,SEO, and Listing Optimization Specialist
description:
We are hiring an experienced Amazon specialist who can connect PPC, SEO, and listing optimization. This role is responsible for finding performance opportunities, making or recommending changes, and monitoring whether those changes improve results.



This is not an entry-level role or a copywriting-only position. Strong writing matters, but we are primarily looking for someone with hands-on Amazon advertising, SEO, data analysis, and listing optimization experience.



About Zoniverse



Zoniverse is an Amazon management and growth agency that works with established brands. Our team manages advertising, SEO, listing optimization, catalog operations, reporting, and account strategy. We are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership of recurring performance work across multiple client accounts.



How the Role Works



PPC, SEO, and listing optimization affect one another. PPC data can reveal valuable search terms, weak traffic, and conversion problems. SEO data can reveal ranking gaps, indexing issues, and keywords that need more support. Those findings should influence main images, image stacks, titles, bullets, A+ Content, backend terms, and advertising decisions.



You will be expected to explain what should change, why it should change, which data supports the recommendation, and how the result should be measured.



Primary Responsibilities



Amazon PPC



Build and manage Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns.



Conduct search-term analysis and identify keyword, product-targeting, and negative-targeting opportunities.



Adjust bids and budgets based on campaign objectives, conversion, ACOS, ROAS, placement, and available data.



Monitor campaign performance and document the reason for meaningful changes.



Use advertising data to identify SEO and listing optimization opportunities.



Amazon SEO



Conduct keyword research and map priority search terms to individual products.



Monitor organic keyword rank, indexation, search visibility, and competitor movement over time.



Use Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, search-term reports, and rank-tracking data to identify opportunities.



Investigate why important keywords are not ranking or improving.



Recommend and monitor changes intended to improve organic visibility and sales.



Listing Optimization



Evaluate main images and secondary image stacks using CTR, conversion, customer intent, competitor positioning, and product benefits.



Create clear creative briefs for main images, image stacks, A+ Content, and Premium A+ Content.



Write and optimize titles, bullets, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ Content.



Identify customer questions, objections, benefits, and use cases that the listing should address.



Recommend tests and measure listing changes against a defined baseline.



Separate traffic problems from targeting, click-through-rate, conversion, and organic-ranking problems.



Workflow and Communication



Manage work across multiple brands and ASINs without losing account-specific context.



Maintain clear notes, change records, baselines, and follow-up dates.



Update assigned tasks and communicate findings, completed work, risks, and next steps clearly.



Collaborate with brand managers, designers, and other team members.



Mandatory Requirements



At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization within Seller Central.



Direct experience creating and optimizing Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns.



Experience with keyword research, search-term analysis, organic-rank monitoring, and indexation checks.



Ability to interpret PPC, Search Query Performance, Brand Analytics, keyword-ranking, CTR, and conversion data.



Experience turning performance data into specific changes or recommendations for main images, image stacks, titles, bullets, A+ Content, and backend terms.



Ability to establish a baseline and monitor whether PPC, SEO, or listing changes improved performance.



Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads Console, Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, and a tool such as Helium 10.



Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.



Strong written English and the ability to explain decisions clearly.



Ability to write and edit accurate, conversion-focused Amazon copy. AI may support the writing process, but you must be able to evaluate and improve its output.



Experience working across multiple products, ASINs, or brands at the same time.



Willingness to complete a practical skills assessment if shortlisted.



Preferred Experience



Previous experience working for an Amazon agency or managing multiple Seller Central accounts.



Experience with Sponsored Display, Sponsored Brands Video, bulk operations, and Amazon advertising reports.



Experience creating image briefs, A+ Content strategy, or Manage Your Experiments tests.



Experience using ClickUp or a similar project-management system.



How to Apply



Begin your application with the phrase SEARCH FLYWHEEL so we know you read the full posting. Applications that do not follow the instructions below may not be reviewed.



Provide your resume and a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile.



State how many years you have directly managed Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization.



Describe the number and types of Amazon brands or accounts you have managed at the same time.



Share one specific example where PPC or SEO data caused you to recommend a listing change. Explain the data, the change, and the measured result. You may hide confidential brand information.



Share one example of an Amazon PPC problem you diagnosed and the action you took.



List the Amazon and third-party tools you have used regularly.



Selection Process



Application review



Initial interview



Practical Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization assessment



Final interview



We are looking for someone who can study the data, make a sound recommendation, execute carefully, and return to verify the result.

title: Agency Account Manager
description:
Clickvoyant- a fil-am owned business, is looking for an experienced Agency Account Manager to own the health, growth, and success of our client relationships.



This person is the watchdog for the client inside Clickvoyant.



Your job is to make sure our clients are getting what they were promised, receiving work on time, seeing clear value from our partnership, and never wondering what is happening with their account.



You will sit between the client and our internal delivery teams, including project management, analytics, CRO, development, paid media, and creative. You are responsible for keeping communication moving, identifying problems before the client has to raise them, and making sure the work we deliver connects back to the client's business goals.



This is not simply a relationship-management role. We are looking for someone who understands how agencies operate, can speak intelligently about digital marketing and website development, and knows how to identify opportunities to retain and grow accounts.



What You'll Own

Client Relationship & Communication

Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned Clickvoyant clients.

Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and understand their business priorities, concerns, and goals.

Make sure clients always know what is being worked on, what has been delivered, what is coming next, and where decisions are needed.

Respond quickly and professionally to client questions and concerns.

Proactively follow up when a client goes quiet or when information is needed to keep work moving.

Identify signs of dissatisfaction, confusion, or risk before they become account problems.

Make clients feel supported, informed, and confident in Clickvoyant's work.

Client Intake & Onboarding

Lead or support new client intake and onboarding.

Make sure client goals, KPIs, priorities, technical requirements, stakeholders, and expectations are documented clearly.

Translate client needs into actionable requirements for internal teams.

Confirm that access, analytics, platforms, websites, reporting, creative assets, and other dependencies are collected early.

Establish clear expectations around communication, timelines, deliverables, and success metrics.

Delivery Oversight

Act as the client's advocate internally and make sure commitments are being met.

Monitor account progress across project management and delivery teams.

Follow up with project managers when deliverables, updates, or next steps are unclear or late.

Escalate risks before deadlines are missed.

Make sure work is not simply completed, but completed in a way that creates measurable value for the client.

Maintain visibility into outstanding decisions, blockers, dependencies, and deliverables across every account.



You are not expected to personally project-manage every task. You are expected to know when something is falling through the cracks and make sure someone picks it up.



Account Growth

Understand each client's business well enough to identify opportunities where Clickvoyant can provide additional value.

Work with leadership and delivery teams to develop account expansion opportunities.

Identify opportunities for additional services, testing, analytics, development, paid media, CRO, strategy, or related work.

Help create the business case for account expansion using client goals, performance data, and identified opportunities.

Participate in renewal and upsell conversations.

Maintain a forward-looking growth plan for each account.



The goal is not to sell clients services they don't need. The goal is to recognize where additional Clickvoyant work can materially improve their business.



Retention & Account Health

Own overall account health and identify retention risks early.

Regularly assess whether clients understand the value Clickvoyant is providing.

Make sure important wins, insights, results, and contributions are communicated clearly to client stakeholders.

Identify accounts where value is unclear and work with the team to correct the issue.

Surface risks involving scope, communication, performance, timeline, expectations, or stakeholder relationships.

Support renewal planning well before contracts expire.

What Success Looks Like



A successful Account Manager at Clickvoyant:



Clients rarely have to ask, "What's happening with this?"

Deadlines do not quietly slip without someone noticing.

Project managers are held accountable for communication and delivery.

Client concerns are surfaced and addressed early.

Clients understand the value Clickvoyant is creating.

Renewals are planned instead of being surprises.

Expansion opportunities are identified naturally through client needs.

Leadership has a clear view of account health, risk, retention, and revenue opportunities.

Clients see Clickvoyant as a proactive strategic partner rather than another vendor.

Required Experience

3+ years of agency account management or client services experience.

Previous experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously in a marketing, digital, creative, ecommerce, development, or performance agency environment.

Strong understanding of digital marketing and website development.

Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams such as developers, marketers, designers, analysts, strategists, or project managers.

Proven ability to manage client expectations, difficult conversations, deadlines, and changing priorities.

Experience identifying account growth, renewal, or upsell opportunities.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to understand performance data and translate it into a clear client story.

Comfortable holding internal teams accountable while maintaining strong working relationships.

Strongly Preferred



Experience in one or more of the following is a major plus:



Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Ecommerce

A/B testing and experimentation

Analytics and GA4

Shopify

Paid media

Social media marketing

Website design or development

UX/UI

Digital strategy

Who You Are



You're proactive.



You don't wait until a client complains to investigate why something hasn't been delivered.



You're commercially minded.



You understand that great account management means protecting the relationship while also identifying opportunities to grow it.



You're comfortable asking questions.



If a project manager hasn't provided an update, you follow up. If a deliverable seems late, you investigate. If a client sounds unhappy, you don't pretend you didn't notice.



You're client-obsessed without becoming a professional order-taker.



You advocate for the client's goals while helping them understand what will actually produce results.



You're organized enough to manage multiple moving accounts without losing track of commitments.



Most importantly, you believe an agency should always be able to answer three questions about every client:



Are we delivering what we promised?

Are we creating measurable value?

What should we be doing next to help this client grow?



If those answers aren't clear, your job is to make them clear.



To apply, fill out this application.

title: PPC Ad Specialist (Google Ads + Local Service Ads)
description:
PPC Ad Specialist (Google Ads + Local Service Ads)



Company: LIFT Auto Repair Marketing

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Type: Full-time

Salary: $2,000 USD/month

Schedule: Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm MST (US Mountain Time)





About LIFT



LIFT is a US-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with auto repair shops. We manage Google Ads and Local Service Ads campaigns for 130+ shops across the United States. Our PPC team is small (5 specialists), fully remote, and runs on clear communication and ownership. We move fast, follow structured processes, and take responsibility for our work without being asked.



This is a hands-on execution role with room to grow. We promote based on results and reliability. If you're the kind of person who gets better every month and takes initiative without being prompted, you'll do well here.





The Role



You'll manage a portfolio of 25-35 auto repair shop advertising accounts. You'll be inside Google Ads and LSA dashboards daily: optimizing campaigns, reviewing lead quality through call recordings, managing budgets, adding negative keywords, and building new campaigns from scratch during client onboarding.



You'll work alongside 4 other PPC specialists and report directly to the Head of PPC.



This is NOT a "set it and forget it" position. If you prefer to check in on accounts once a week and file a report, this is not the right fit.





What You'll Actually Be Doing



Campaign Management (Daily/Weekly):

- Monitor and adjust campaign budgets to keep spend on pace with monthly targets

- Proactively identify opportunities to increase budgets based on client goals and performance data

- Review search terms and add negatives to eliminate wasted spend (solid grasp of negative keyword strategy and match types is expected)

- Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts for lead quality

- Check conversion tracking and flag/fix any issues

- Run performance health checks on CPA, CTR, CVR, and CPC

- Review and act on Google's optimization recommendations (only the ones that actually help)

- Test new ad copy variations every 60 days

- Manage geographic and ad scheduling targeting based on performance data

- Log all activity for every account you touch



What You'll Deliver

- Campaigns that hit budget pacing targets without overspending or underspending

- Clean, well-structured new account builds using LIFT's onboarding templates (Google Ads + LSA)

- Negative keyword lists that eliminate wasted spend across your entire portfolio

- Proactive flags when something is wrong (tracking issues, billing problems, underperforming campaigns) before it becomes a crisis

- Clear, professional communication in ClickUp tasks and Slack every working day





What This Role Is Not



Be honest with yourself before applying:

- If you need to be told which account to work on next, this isn't for you. You'll manage 25-35 accounts and need to prioritize independently.

- If you go quiet on Slack for hours without notice, this won't work. We don't expect instant replies, but going dark is a problem.

- If you cut corners on checklists because you "already know what to do," you'll create problems for the team. We have structured processes for a reason.

- If you wait for problems to be assigned to you instead of finding them yourself, you won't succeed here.





What We're Looking For



Required:

- 2+ years hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns (Search required; Display/YouTube a plus)

- Familiarity with Google Local Service Ads (LSA)

- Solid understanding of conversion tracking (Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4)

- Comfortable working in Google Sheets (formulas, data manipulation)

- Strong English communication (written). You'll be commenting on tasks, responding to Account Managers, and documenting your work daily.

- Reliable internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps) and a quiet workspace

- Full-time schedule availability

- Self-motivated. You'll work independently most of the day. If you need constant supervision, this isn't the right fit.



Strongly Preferred:

- Experience with call tracking platforms (i.e. WhatConverts, CallRail)

- Experience in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

- Experience with PPC budget pacing tools (AdPulse or similar)

- Google Ads Search certification

- Understanding of how landing pages impact ad performance, including A/B testing concepts

- Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools





How You Can Succeed Here:

- You take ownership. If something is wrong, you fix it or escalate it. You don't wait to be asked.

- You communicate proactively. If a task is blocked, you say so immediately with what you need to unblock it.

- You follow the process. We have structured templates and checklists for a reason. Cutting steps creates problems downstream.

- You're responsive on Slack during working hours. We don't expect instant replies to everything, but going dark for hours without notice is a problem.

- You manage your time well. You'll have 25-35 accounts in your portfolio. You need to prioritize without being told which one to work on next.

- You spot opportunities, not just problems. If a client's campaigns are performing well and there's room to scale, you flag it.

- You're curious. When something doesn't make sense, you dig in and figure it out before asking someone else to solve it for you.



Tools You'll Use



Google Ads (daily), Google LSA dashboard (daily), ClickUp (task management, daily), Slack (team communication, daily), WhatConverts (call tracking), AdPulse (budget pacing), Google Sheets (reporting, data), Google Tag Manager / GA4 (tracking setup), Bitwarden (credential management)



Compensation & Growth



$2,000 USD/month, paid monthly



Top performers earn expanded responsibilities, higher-value account portfolios, and compensation increases based on results. We're building a team that grows with us.



How to Apply



IMPORTANT: Start your application message with the phrase "LIFT PPC Specialist Application" so we know you've actually read this entire post.



Please include in your application:

- Your name

- Your

- Your relevant Google Ads experience (how many accounts, what industries, how long)

- Whether you have experience with Local Service Ads specifically (LSAs)

- Your English proficiency level (conversational, professional, native/bilingual)

- Your available working hours in Philippine time

- A brief description of a campaign optimization you made that improved results (what was the problem, what did you do, what happened)



We review every application. If your experience matches, we'll reach out with next steps.

title: Urgent Hiring: Senior Integrations & Platform Engineer
description:
Important Notice to Applicants:



Please note that we are only contacting and communicating with candidates through OnlineJobsPH. Any applications or direct contact made outside of these channels, including
s, social media messages, direct messages to our CEO, or messages sent to our general company
, will not be considered and will be automatically declined.



About the Company:



We are a private U.S.-based company operating across multiple departments that support legal, staffing, and client-service operations. Our teams collaborate in dynamic, fast-paced environments focused on innovation, integrity, and client success.



In this role, you’ll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, making a real impact in operational, legal, and client-focused projects—all from the comfort of your home. Details about our company structure and associated teams will be introduced during the interview process.



About the Role:



We are building an AI-enabled intake and conversion platform for law firms. Our human and AI agents engage prospective clients, complete intake workflows, and help firms convert qualified prospects into signed clients. 



That only works if information moves reliably between our platform, our clients' systems, and the partners that supply leads. You will design and build that integration platform — production APIs, event-driven services, and CRM connectors — leading technical discovery yourself and turning recurring requirements into reusable capabilities rather than one-off scripts. 



What You Will Build:



Client APIs and Event Delivery 



Build secure, documented APIs and a reliable webhook platform that deliver intake, lead, and conversion outcomes to client systems. 



Own delivery mechanics and API standards: subscriptions, authentication, webhook signing, retries, idempotency, replay, versioning, and the documentation and testing tools customers need to self-serve. 



Inbound Lead and Partner Integrations



Build services that securely accept leads and potential cases from external vendors on behalf of hundreds of law-firm clients, built on a canonical intake model and an adapter framework that normalizes new partners without duplicating core logic. 



Handle validation, deduplication, attribution, consent and source tracking, and tenant routing, and build monitoring and reconciliation tools that make missing or misrouted leads visible and recoverable. 



CRM Connectors and Custom Client Work



Turn recurring client requirements into reusable, configurable connectors — installable packages, managed integrations, and embedded workflows — with secure OAuth or API-key onboarding. 



Design configurable field mapping, routing rules, and synchronization behavior so a new firm can be connected without an engineer, and own connector deployment, versioning, and support. 



Lead technical discovery with law firms, CRM administrators, and vendors; deliver custom integrations as paid engagements when a connector is not appropriate; and fold reusable components back into the platform. 



Platform, Reliability, and Security:



Design multi-tenant, event-driven services with strong isolation of customer data and credentials, and own them from design through deployment, monitoring, and i
 response. 



Design for third-party rate limits, outages, schema changes, and duplicate events, backed by structured observability, automated contract and integration testing, and replay tools. 



Protect sensitive lead, caller, and case data through least-privilege access, secure secret storage, credential rotation, tenant-aware authorization, and configurable retention. 





Required Experience:



Typically 5 or more years of software engineering experience, including ownership of backend, platform, or integration systems. 



Hands-on experience designing and operating customer-facing APIs, webhooks, or integration platforms in production. 



Strong proficiency in a modern backend language (TypeScript/Node.js, Python, Java, Go, or C#) plus strong SQL and relational data modeling. 



Deep understanding of event-driven systems, distributed-system failure modes, and API authentication patterns including OAuth 2.0, API keys, JWTs, and signed requests. 



Experience designing reliable integration behavior — retries, idempotency, rate limiting, replay, reconciliation, and schema evolution — backed by automated contract and integration testing. 



Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and operating services in AWS, Azure, or GCP using containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. 



Experience working directly with customers and partners on discovery and launch, translating messy business processes into maintainable software, and a self-directed approach to ambiguous problems. 



Preferred Experience:



Integrations with CRM, case-management, or lead-management platforms such as Salesforce, Litify, HubSpot, Filevine, Clio, or Lawmatics. 



Salesforce work involving Apex, REST APIs, Platform Events, Flow, or managed packages, or publishing installable apps, marketplace connectors, or SDKs. 



Legal technology, law-firm operations, legal intake, or professional-services delivery, including billable client engagements. 



SFTP, batch imports, change-data capture, or streaming platforms, and familiarity with MCP or secure data interfaces for AI agents. 



Depth in one or two platforms, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar APIs and data models quickly, matters more than familiarity with all of them. 



What Success Looks Like:



Clients and partners exchange standardized outcomes and leads through reliable, documented interfaces instead of manual work. 



Integration failures are visible, diagnosable, and recoverable. 



New vendors and CRM systems are added through reusable adapters and configuration, so onboarding each new client, CRM, or lead source takes less time.



How to Apply



Please send your application ONLY to 



Make sure your subject line begins with:



“Sr. Integrations and Platform Engineer – [Your Name]”



This helps us correctly identify your application and confirms that you’ve read the full job description carefully.

title: Video Editor (Part-Time, 20–30 hrs/week) for Australian Fashion Brand | Short-Form Social & Ad Content
description:
About us:

We're Moolk, an Australian women's fashion ecommerce brand. We design clothing that works for mums who are breastfeeding, without looking like "breastfeeding clothing." We've been in business for 10 years. We release a new collection every month, and we sell mostly through Instagram and
 ads plus our organic communities and
 lists.



We're looking for one video editor to join us long-term, part-time, starting at 20–30 hours per week.



What the job actually is:

We film a lot of raw footage: try-ons, model shoots, behind-the-scenes clips, phone videos, customer content. Right now most of it sits unused because nobody has time to cut it.



Your job is to go through that footage and turn it into short videos we can use as ads and organic social posts.



Here is our current meta ads library so you can understand the type of video edits we expect to receive: www.
/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=AU&is_targeted_country=false&media_type=all&search_type=page&sort_data[direction]=desc&sort_data[mode]=total_impressions&view_all_page_id=
A typical task looks like this:

We drop raw footage into a shared Google Drive folder, along with a short brief (the product, the vibe, and one or two reference videos).

You watch all of it and pull out the best moments.

You cut those into a 15 to 30 second 9x16 video with clean pacing, music where appropriate, and correct colour and exposure.

You upload it for review with a short note on what you were going for.

We give feedback. You revise. We publish.



We're aiming for roughly 8 to 15 finished videos per week once you're up to speed, including simple variations of videos that are already working (swapping the opening clip, changing the order, trimming the length, new 3-sec hooks).



What we need from you:

Real experience editing short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Meta ads). Please show us examples of your work.

An eye for pacing. You can tell the difference between a cut that holds attention and one that drags.

Proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut Pro. We're not fussy about which, as long as your output is clean.

Reliable internet fast enough to download and upload multi-gigabyte video files daily.

A computer that can handle 4K footage without you losing half a day to rendering.

Written English good enough to read a brief and ask a clarifying question when something isn't clear.

Availability for at least 3 hours of overlap with Australian Eastern Time (Philippines is 2 to 3 hours behind us, so a normal Manila workday already overlaps well).



Nice to have, not required:

Experience editing for a fashion, beauty or lifestyle brand.

Experience with Meta ad formats specifically and understanding hooks, thumb-stop and retention rates to create strategic videos that convert.



Long term opportunity:

We want to train the right person up and have them become part of our team. Over the next 6 to 12 months, we'd like whoever takes this role to move from "simple video edits" to end-to-end strategic video creation, creating finished meta-ready videos with text hook overlays, music and captions. This growth will come with more responsibility and more pay. 



The details:

20–30 hours per week to start, with a view to increasing.

Paid Philippine public holidays and 13th month pay after your first full year.

Long-term role. We're hiring one person, not building a bench.



How to apply:

Please do all four of these. Applications that skip any of them won't be read.



Start your message with the words MOOLK VIDEO EDITOR so we know you've read this.

Send links to 2 or 3 short-form videos you personally edited. For each one, write one sentence on what you were trying to achieve with the edit.

Tell us how many hours per week you're realistically available and what your working hours are in Manila time.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid test edit: real footage, a real brief, and about 2 hours of work, paid at your normal rate.
