Prosper is hiring an experienced Outbound Appointment Setter for its solar, home energy savings, and Prosper Shield programs. This is a full-time production role for a proven phone-sales professional—not an entry-level role and not a place to learn outbound calling from scratch.



You must already know how to take a warm homeowner lead, build immediate trust, ask smart qualifying questions, handle real objections, and set a high-quality appointment for a closer. We need someone who can step into a disciplined system and perform quickly with minimal handholding.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call warm, opted-in homeowners during U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday

- Work inside our GoHighLevel power dialer and CRM using a proven process

- Run discovery, establish interest, qualify accurately, handle objections, and set appointments that show up ready for the closer

- Keep complete, clean notes, dispositions, and follow-up activity inside GoHighLevel

- Protect the customer experience and lead quality while maintaining reliable daily activity



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- At least 3 years of successful outbound appointment-setting, SDR, live-transfer, telemarketing, or phone-sales experience in U.S.-facing campaigns

- A track record of setting qualified appointments consistently—not merely making calls or taking inbound support tickets

- Strong experience with a CRM and power dialer; GoHighLevel experience is a major advantage

- Able to explain the campaigns you have worked, the audiences you called, your typical appointment volume, and how you protected appointment quality

- Clear, confident, easy-to-understand English; neutral or American accent strongly preferred

- Strong discovery, listening, objection-handling, and follow-up discipline

- Full-time availability aligned with U.S. business hours, 40 hours per week

- Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet work environment



THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE

Do not apply if you need basic calling training, have never set qualified appointments, cannot work full-time U.S. business hours, or are looking only for part-time or administrative work. We provide the workflow, standards, and performance feedback; you bring the proven calling skill and professional judgment.



WHY PROSPER

- Warm, opted-in leads—no list building or random cold outreach

- Clear systems and accountability for people who already know how to perform

- A serious growth path for strong producers: Setter to Senior Setter, Closer, Coach, or Team Leader

- We care about lead quality and customer experience, not just activity volume



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short note that includes:

1. Your years of direct outbound appointment-setting experience

2. The U.S.-facing campaigns or industries you have worked

3. Your normal appointment-setting volume and one example of overcoming an objection to set a qualified appointment

4. The CRM and dialers you have used

5. Confirmation that you are available for 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours



Prosper hires carefully. We select based on demonstrated skill, relevant experience, ownership, and interview performance. A formal offer will be provided after the interview process.

title: AI Video Ad Editor — Meta/Facebook Performance Ads (AI-Generated Creative Only)
description:
We're looking for a highly skilled AI video ad creator to produce high-converting
/Meta ads built entirely from AI-generated assets. Instagram and TikTok experience is a strong plus.



This is not an entry-level role. If you don't have proven experience producing AI-generated paid social ads with portfolio proof, please do not apply.



Role Overview



You will generate, direct, and assemble AI video and image assets into scroll-stopping
 ads with sharp pacing, clean cuts, and strong hooks within the first 3 seconds. Every ad is AI-produced — no live shoots, no filmed UGC, no talent. You'll prompt and iterate AI clips until they're on-brand and believable, then generate and sync AI voiceovers in ElevenLabs, matching tone, emotion, and rhythm to the visuals.



Expect ongoing work producing multiple ad variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions every week.



What You'll Do

Generate AI video and image assets using tools like Sora, Veo, Kling, Runway, Midjourney, Higgsfield, Seedance, or equivalent.

Write and iterate prompts until output is usable — consistent characters, consistent products, clean hands and faces, no obvious AI artifacts.

Cut AI-generated clips into polished, high-converting short-form ad creatives for Meta.

Generate and sync AI voiceovers in ElevenLabs, choosing the right voice, emotion, and pacing for each script.

Add captions/subtitles, hooks, transitions, sound effects, and optimized pacing for paid social.

Composite real product shots into AI scenes where required so the product stays accurate.

Produce multiple variations, cutdowns, and retargeting versions based on performance and feedback.

Follow creative briefs and direction closely while maintaining consistent quality and speed.

Required Skills & Experience



This is an AI performance-creative role, not a generic video editor position.



You must:



Have proven experience producing fully AI-generated ads for Meta/Facebook — not just organic content, not just editing filmed footage.

Be fluent in current AI video generation tools and know the strengths and failure modes of each. You should be able to tell us which tool you'd reach for and why.

Be strong at prompting: shot framing, camera movement, lighting, character consistency across shots, and product accuracy.

Know how to fix or hide AI artifacts — warped hands, morphing text, unstable faces, flickering — through reroll, masking, cutting, or compositing.

Have hands-on experience with ElevenLabs for AI voiceover generation (voice selection, emotion tuning, and clean audio output).

Be confident with clipping, pacing, and timing for paid social — especially strong hooks in the first 3 seconds and high retention through the first 30 seconds.

Be highly proficient in CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, or After Effects.

Be comfortable with captions/subtitles, sound design, b-roll layering, upscaling, and basic motion graphics.

Have a strong understanding of what actually performs inside Meta Ads Manager (creatives, hooks, formats that drive results).

Have experience with short-form ad formats: AI avatar/UGC-style ads, voiceover ads, and product/demo ads.

Be able to meet daily deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly in English.

Reliable internet, a capable editing setup, and the ability to handle ongoing work are non-negotiable.

Application Requirements (Strict)



To be considered, your proposal must include all of the following:



Direct links to AI-generated
/Meta ads you personally created — not team projects, not generic reels, not filmed content.

Names of past clients or brands you've worked with, plus case studies or results if available.

A short note on your workflow:

Which AI generation tools you use and why

How you keep characters and products consistent across shots

How you handle AI artifacts and failed generations

How you approach hooks, pacing, and retention

How you integrate ElevenLabs voiceovers into your edits



Applications without work samples, or without clear AI ad experience for Meta, will be rejected immediately. Do not apply if you are not specialized in AI-generated paid social creative.



Trial Period (Paid)



Before moving to full-time, there will be a paid 2-week trial to evaluate:



Skill level and creative quality

Speed and consistency

Ability to follow directions and implement feedback



Trial terms:



Pay during trial: 8 USD per completed video/ad

Training, examples, and feedback will be provided

Only candidates who pass the trial will be considered for the full-time role

Full-Time Role Details (After Trial)

Weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

Scripts are sent every weekday

Videos must be completed and delivered before the following day

Task-based work (no fixed hours, but daily deliverables are required)

Payment: 212 USD per week, paid every Sunday

Performance bonus: 150 USD for any "winning ad" that performs well in paid campaigns



This is a long-term, stable role for the right creator.



Responsibilities

Generate and edit short-form AI voiceover ads for Meta 
 & Instagram), with TikTok as a plus.

Sync AI visuals tightly to ElevenLabs-generated voiceovers (access will be provided).

Create custom AI b-roll and scenes to match each script, using provided product assets for accuracy.

Add attention-grabbing hooks, captions, transitions, and sound design optimized for paid social.

Follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and iterative feedback closely.

Maintain consistent quality while hitting fast turnarounds.

Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who:



Creates for performance and conversions first, not just aesthetics.

Treats AI tools as a production pipeline, not a novelty — and knows how to get usable output fast.

Understands hooks, pacing, and retention in a paid social context.

Wants a stable, long-term position with predictable weekly work.

Is motivated by performance-based bonuses and "winning ads."

Can grow with the brand and contribute ideas to improve creatives over time.

title: Sourcing and Research Assistant
description:
PART-TIME LEAD RESEARCH & CRM ASSISTANT

Business Acquisitions | 10 Hours per Week | Mid to Long-Term Opportunity



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a small U.S.-based investment and acquisition group seeking a reliable, detail-oriented research assistant to support our outreach to privately owned businesses, intermediaries, and capital providers.



Your primary responsibility will be to find companies that meet specific acquisition criteria, identify their owners or decision-makers, and maintain accurate records in HubSpot.



You will also help us stay organized by reviewing outstanding follow-ups, identifying incomplete records, and flagging items that require action.



This is initially a research and organization role—not a cold-calling or sales position.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Company and Contact Research



* Build targeted lists of businesses within specified industries and geographic areas.

* Determine whether each company genuinely meets our criteria.

* Identify company owners, presidents, or other relevant decision-makers.

* Find and verify websites,
 addresses, telephone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and other useful information.

* Record the sources supporting your research.

* Identify potentially attractive businesses and explain why they stand out.



HubSpot and Pipeline Organization



* Create and update company and contact records in HubSpot.

* Check for duplicates before creating new records.

* Keep required fields, research notes, and sourcing information complete.

* Identify records missing contact information or a clear next step.

* Review overdue and upcoming HubSpot tasks.

* Prepare a short weekly list of items requiring the principal’s attention.



Task and Workflow Support



* Use Google Workspace and Google Chat to communicate, share work, and track assigned tasks.

* Follow written search criteria and documented procedures.

* Ask questions when a company’s qualification is uncertain.

* Help improve research procedures as recurring problems or better methods are identified.



EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT



The initial expectation is approximately 30–40 thoroughly researched, qualified, non-duplicate companies per week. The exact number will depend on the depth and difficulty of the assigned search.



Each completed company record should generally include:



* Company name

* Website

* Location

* Description of services

* Evidence that it meets the search criteria

* Owner or decision-maker

* Title

*
 address, when available

* Telephone number

* LinkedIn profile, when available

* Source links

* Relevant notes or uncertainties



You will also provide a concise weekly summary showing:



* Companies researched and qualified

* HubSpot records created or updated

* Missing information or unresolved questions

* Overdue follow-ups

* Items requiring action from the principal

* Work prepared for the following week



QUALIFICATIONS



Required:



* Strong online research and investigative skills

* Excellent written English

* Careful attention to detail

* Strong Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel skills

* Ability to follow detailed criteria while exercising sound judgment

* Ability to distinguish relevant companies from superficially similar businesses

* Consistent communication and dependable follow-through

* Stable computer and internet connection

* Willingness to protect confidential business information

* Interest in a stable, long-term working relationship



Preferred:



* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM

* Experience with lead generation, market research, company research, or contact enrichment

* Familiarity with LinkedIn and business databases

* Experience researching privately owned U.S. businesses

* Familiarity with tools used to verify professional
 addresses



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



* Approximately 10 hours per week

* Paid weekly

* Flexible working hours

* One scheduled weekly check-in during U.S. Eastern Time

* Initial 30-day paid trial

* Opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities based on performance and business needs



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid research exercise of approximately two hours. The exercise will evaluate research accuracy, judgment, organization, and ability to follow instructions.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “Blue Ridge Research” so we know you read the entire posting.



Please include:



1. A short description of your relevant research or list-building experience.

2. Your experience using HubSpot or another CRM.

3. An anonymized example of a business-research or lead-generation spreadsheet, if available.

4. A description of how you would verify that a company actually repairs or services medical equipment rather than merely selling or distributing it. Please limit your answer to 150 words.

5. Your normal working hours and time zone.

6. Confirmation that you can consistently provide approximately 10 hours per week for $400 USD per month.



We value accuracy, judgment, and reliability more than application length. Please do not submit a long generic cover letter.

title: Appointment Recovery Specialist (SDR / Outbound Caller) — Rebook No-Shows & Cancellations
description:
RF Consultants is a U.S.-based consulting firm that helps individuals and business owners repair their credit profiles and access business funding. We generate a high volume of consultation bookings every week — and a meaningful percentage of those prospects don't show up or cancel before the call.



Those people still want help. They got busy, they got nervous, or life happened. Your job is to get them back on the calendar.



What You'll Actually Be Doing



This is not cold calling from a purchased list. Every person you contact has already raised their hand, filled out our form, and booked time with us. You're following up on warm, interested leads who dropped off.



Day to day:



Work a daily list of no-showed and cancelled appointments pulled from our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Call, text, and
 these leads until you reach them or they're properly disqualified

Handle the common objections: "I got busy," "I'm not ready," "I already found someone else," "How much does this cost?"

Rebook them directly onto a closer's calendar

Send confirmation and reminder touches so the rebooked appointment actually shows

Log every attempt, outcome, and note in the CRM — clean data is non-negotiable

Report daily on dials, contacts, rebooks, and shows



Expect roughly [60–100] dials per day plus text and
 follow-up.



Who We're Looking For



Required:



Fluent, neutral English with a clear phone voice — U.S. prospects should be comfortable talking to you

1+ years of outbound calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience with U.S. customers

Genuinely comfortable on the phone and unbothered by rejection or voi
 after voi

Reliable computer, noise-cancelling headset, quiet workspace, and stable internet (minimum 20 Mbps, with a backup connection)

Organized and consistent — you follow the cadence and update the CRM every single time

Available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



Nice to have:



Experience in credit repair, financial services, insurance, or debt/lending

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel

A track record you can point to with actual numbers



Important: You will never give credit, legal, or financial advice, and you will never promise a specific result, score increase, or funding amount. Your only job is to get the prospect back on the calendar with one of our consultants. We train you on exactly what you can and cannot say, and we hold that line strictly.



What We Offer

Warm leads only — no list-scraping, no dialing strangers

Scripts, objection frameworks, and call recordings to learn from

Base pay plus performance bonus, paid [twice monthly / monthly] via [payment method]

Long-term role with a growing U.S. company, not a short-term project

Direct feedback and coaching — we want you to get better, and we pay more when you do

How to Apply



Applications without all three items below will not be reviewed.



Put "REBOOK — [Your First Name]" in the subject line.

Attach a short resume or summary of your outbound calling experience, including your best numbers (dials/day, connect rate, set rate, show rate).

Record a 60–90 second voice sample (Vocaroo, Loom, or an MP3 link) role-playing this scenario:



You're calling Maria. She booked a free credit consultation with CRF Consultants for Tuesday at 2pm and didn't show up. This is your second attempt reaching her. She picks up and sounds rushed. Get her back on the calendar.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
The Company:



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. 



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. 



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. 



Position Overview:

The SDR is a full-cycle sales role responsible for opening new doors for MPHQ — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and converting outbound conversations into qualified opportunities and closed business. You will prospect into US provider offices, navigate to decision-makers, understand their compliance needs, position the Company's value, handle objections, and close business. 



Success means consistent activity, strong conversion, disciplined pipeline management, and month-over-month quota attainment. You are a seller, not a script reader — comfortable creating conversations from cold outreach, asking strong discovery questions, listening before recommending, handling rejection, and asking for the close. 



Key Responsibilities:



Outbound Prospecting

• Make high-volume outbound calls into assigned US provider-office lists using targeted data and approved calling cadences. 

• Navigate gatekeepers and reach office managers, practice administrators, owners, and other decision-makers professionally. 

• Execute multi-touch outreach across calls and approved sales-engagement channels so viable accounts are not abandoned after a single attempt. 

• Prioritize accounts and activities based on ICP, likelihood to engage, and pipeline potential. 



Consultative Selling

• Open calls as conversations, not pitches, and earn the prospect's attention through relevant questions. 

• Understand how the practice manages compliance today, who they use, what it costs, and where the pain points are. 

• Translate compliance and waste requirements into clear, practical language for busy healthcare decision-makers. 

• Recommend solutions based on the prospect's needs and be transparent when Accordant is not the right fit. 

• Build relationships that create future opportunities even when the initial answer is no. 



Selling & Closing

• Position Accordant Capital, MedPro & MP1 Solutions around cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability based on what matters to the prospect. 

• Handle price, incumbent-vendor, timing, and other objections without unnecessarily discounting value. 

• Present promotional and incentive-based offers accurately and consistently. 

• Carry qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle to signed agreement, escalating larger or more complex deals according to the defined path. 

• Meet or exceed monthly targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customers, and revenue. 



Pipeline & CRM Discipline

• Respond to inbound leads quickly and qualify them against agreed criteria when assigned. 

• Keep accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, and next steps current in the CRM the same day. 

• Own and prioritize your pipeline based on likelihood to close and expected value. 

• Complete follow-up according to the defined cadence and maintain accurate opportunity stages and close dates. 



Coaching & Team Contribution

• Participate fully in team huddles, call coaching, role plays, and call reviews. 

• Apply coaching feedback immediately and demonstrate measurable improvement. 

• Share effective discovery questions, objection responses, talk tracks, and prospect insights with the team. 

• Represent Accordant Capital professionally in every customer interaction and support occasional client-facing events or networking activities as needed. 



Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years in outbound B2B sales or another quota-carrying, phone-based sales role. 

• Demonstrated success with high-volume outbound cold calling and net-new account acquisition. 

• Demonstrated closing experience — not solely appointment setting or lead qualification. 

• Comfort with consultative selling: asks strong questions, listens actively, diagnoses needs, and recommends appropriately. 

• Strong spoken and written English with a warm, confident, professional phone presence for a US audience. 

• Experience using a CRM and sales-engagement or sequencing tools; Salesforce, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel experience preferred. 

• Comfort with dialers and call-recording/coaching tools such as Gong or equivalent. 

• Resilience, coachability, and ability to perform consistently in a rejection-heavy, quota-driven environment. 

• Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST). 



Nice-to-Have:

• Experience selling into US non-acute healthcare practices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, or similar. 

• Experience selling compliance, medical waste, insurance, SaaS, BPO, or other recurring B2B services. 

• Experience with Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Gong, or comparable sales technology. 

• Experience working under tiered incentive or commission plans. 

• Existing familiarity with US healthcare practice management or compliance environments. 



Compensation & Benefits:

• Base pay starts at $1000/month based on experience

• Plus potential performance incentives tied to qualified opportunities generated and new customers closed. Incentives are discretionary and may be provided, adjusted, or removed by the Company as it deems necessary; details will be stated in the employment contract. 

• Full-time, permanent work-from-home. 

• Monday–Friday, full overlap with US business hours (CST) to align with US provider-office calling windows. 

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Reliable remote work setup with a stable, high-speed internet connection.

• Noise-canceling headset for a professional, US-facing phone presence.

• Backup power and backup internet connection.

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home.

• Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST).

In your video, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following: 

• What is your outbound sales/cold-calling experience? Please include your years of experience and the type of roles you've handled (e.g., SDR, BDR, telesales, appointment setting, full-cycle closing). 



• Have you carried and consistently met a sales quota? Briefly share the quota structure and your typical attainment. 



• How many years have you worked in a work-from-home/remote setup supporting a US-based team or US clients?

title: Brand Protection Specialist
description:
Brand Protection Specialist — Full-Time 



We're a fast-growing US ecommerce brand. Our products and our marketing get copied constantly — some of it word-for-word & download our exact video ads to put up on their own. We already have a legal partner who files the takedowns. What we don't have is someone hunting the copycats down in the first place.



That's this job. You find them, you build the evidence file, you hand it to our legal partner, and you make sure it actually gets taken down.



What you'll do every day:



- Search the internet for stores, listings, and ads copying our product pages, our copy, our images and our offers

- Check each one carefully and d
 whether it's actually actionable

- Build an evidence file for the ones that are: save the full page, screenshot it, pull the exact sentences they copied from us, archive it on the Wayback Machine

- Submit the file to our legal partner (Bustem)

- Chase every case through to resolution. Track what's been filed, what's been actioned, what's gone quiet, and follow up. A submitted case nobody follows up on is a case that doesn't get taken down

- Keep one tracker showing every copycat found, its status, and the outcome



You'll be good at this if you



✅ Are obsessive about detail and finish what you start

✅ Write clear English. You'll be writing findings a lawyer reads

✅ Are comfortable being told "this one isn't actionable" and moving on

✅ Chase things. A lot of this job is noticing something has gone quiet and following up



This isn't for you if you need to be told what to do each day, if "close enough" feels fine, or if you'd rather hit a number than be right.



Where it goes



This role also GROWS. Once copycat hunting is running smoothly it expands into the rest of brand protection — monitoring reviews, Trustpilot, fake accounts and impersonators across social media pages. We want someone who'll own that whole area, not just fill a task list.



Pay



✅ $500 per month, paid on time, every time

✅ Plus a bounty of $5/successful takedown you submitted

✅ Reviewed again at 90 days



To apply, send us:



- Find us one real example of an online store that has copied another store's product page copy. Any brands, any industry. Send the two URLs and quote three specific sentences that appear on both pages, word-for-word.

- In one or two sentences: why is that example actionable, and what would make it not actionable?

- Anything you've done before involving detailed research or investigation.



No CV needed. Applications without part 1 completed won't be read.

title: Client Retention & Prospecting Coordinator
description:
JWS CUSTOMER SERVICE & LEAD GENERATION VA Full-Time | Long-Term

Opportunity | U.S. Insurance Agency



ABOUT JWS



JWS is an independent U.S. insurance agency helping individuals,

families, business owners, and employers make sense of health insurance,

Medicare, employee benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, and

other protection and retirement needs.



We are a relationship-driven agency. We don’t want our clients to feel

like they’re calling an 800 number or being pushed through a call

center.



We are growing and looking for someone who wants to become an important

long-term part of our company.



THE MISSION



Your job is simple to describe:



Protect the clients we already have and help create qualified

conversations for our agency owner.



This is NOT a traditional administrative VA position where you wait for

someone to give you tasks.



You will work from a defined system that includes client retention,

prospect research, outbound follow-up, appointment setting, CRM

management, and referral-partner outreach.



You will be measured on activity, follow-through, accuracy,

conversations created, and qualified appointments scheduled.



You are NOT expected to sell insurance or provide insurance advice.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



EXISTING CLIENT RETENTION



-   Contact existing clients by phone, text, and
 using approved

    scripts and workflows

-   Help make sure clients receive important renewal and enrollment

    communications

-   Schedule client review appointments

-   Follow up with clients who have not responded

-   Collect requested non-advisory information before appointments

-   Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows

-   Keep accurate notes in our CRM

-   Identify clients who may need additional help and route them to a

    licensed agent

-   Make sure no client is forgotten because a follow-up was missed



PROSPECT RESEARCH & LEAD GENERATION



An important part of this position is helping us build our own prospect

pipeline rather than simply waiting for leads.



This includes:



-   Researching businesses and potential clients that match criteria we

    provide

-   Identifying business owners and appropriate decision-makers

-   Finding and verifying available business contact information

-   Researching potential referral partners such as CPAs, payroll

    professionals, P&C insurance agents, HR consultants, attorneys,

    financial professionals, and other business advisors

-   Entering clean and accurate prospect information into our CRM

-   Identifying useful information or business events that may create a

    legitimate reason for outreach

-   Maintaining a continuously replenished prospecting queue



OUTREACH & APPOINTMENT SETTING



-   Make outbound calls to approved prospect lists

-   Send approved
 and text follow-ups

-   Follow scripts while still sounding like a real human being

-   Ask basic qualification questions

-   Identify interest and potential need

-   Schedule qualified appointments directly on the agency calendar

-   Follow up persistently but professionally

-   Reschedule missed appointments

-   Maintain accurate CRM status and notes after every interaction



You do not sell or recommend insurance products. Your job is to create

the opportunity and schedule the appropriate conversation with the

licensed agent.



REFERRAL PARTNER OUTREACH



-   Research potential professional referral partners

-   Make initial outreach using our process

-   Schedule introductory conversations for the agency owner

-   Maintain regular follow-up

-   Track which relationships produce introductions and referrals



CRM & PIPELINE OWNERSHIP



We use GoHighLevel.



You will help ensure:



-   Every active prospect has a current status

-   Every person requiring follow-up has a next action and date

-   Appointments are correctly scheduled

-   Contact information and notes are accurate

-   Dead leads are properly categorized

-   No promising prospect disappears because someone forgot to follow up

-   Weekly activity and results can be easily measured



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We care more about finding the right person than an impressive resume.



You should be:



-   Extremely comfortable speaking with Americans by phone

-   Fluent in spoken and written English

-   Warm, confident, and conversational

-   Persistent without being aggressive

-   Comfortable hearing “no”

-   Highly organized

-   Curious and good at online research

-   Able to follow a system consistently

-   Comfortable being measured by numbers and results

-   Willing to ask questions instead of guessing

-   Able to recognize when something should be escalated

-   Interested in improving scripts and processes based on results

-   Interested in a long-term position rather than a temporary freelance

    project



EXPERIENCE WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE



Experience in any of the following is valuable:



-   U.S. insurance

-   Health insurance

-   Medicare

-   Life insurance

-   Employee benefits

-   B2B appointment setting

-   Cold calling

-   Lead generation

-   Customer retention

-   GoHighLevel

-   CRM management

-   Prospect research

-   Working with U.S. business owners



Insurance experience is helpful but not required.



Strong communication, ownership, persistence, judgment, and ability to

learn are more important.



WORK SCHEDULE



This is intended to become a full-time, long-term position.



We may begin with a short paid training and ramp-up period at reduced

hours, but our goal is approximately 40 hours per week for the right

person.



A significant portion of your working schedule must overlap with normal

U.S. Pacific Time business hours because phone calls and client

conversations are an important part of this role.



We are looking for someone who wants JWS to become their primary

long-term professional commitment, not simply another small freelance

account.



This position can grow in responsibility and compensation as the company

grows and you demonstrate results.



COMPENSATION



Up to $8 USD per hour depending on experience, demonstrated skills,

communication ability, and performance.



When applying, please tell us your desired hourly rate in USD.



We are looking for the best combination of ability, reliability,

communication, initiative, and value, rather than simply the lowest

hourly rate.



Strong performance can lead to increased responsibility, compensation,

and performance incentives.



TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



-   Reliable high-speed internet

-   A quality computer

-   A quality headset/microphone

-   A quiet, professional workspace

-   Reliable backup internet

-   A plan for power outages

-   Ability to work effectively with web-based CRM, phone,
,

    calendar, and research tools



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send a generic cover letter.



Start your application with the words:



MAKE SENSE



Then answer the following questions:



1.  Tell us about your experience making outbound phone calls or setting

    appointments for U.S. businesses.



2.  Tell us about any insurance, financial-services, healthcare, or B2B

    experience you have.



3.  Imagine you were given a list of 100 businesses and asked to

    identify the owner or benefits decision-maker, find accurate contact

    information, contact them, and track the results. Explain how you

    would approach the project.



4.  Tell us about a time you had to repeatedly follow up with someone

    before getting a response. What did you do?



5.  What U.S. Pacific Time hours can you consistently work?



6.  What is your desired hourly rate in USD?



VOICE/VIDEO REQUIREMENT



Please include a 60-90 second video or voice recording with your

application.



In your recording, pretend you are calling an existing JWS client named

Sarah.



Sarah has not responded to two previous messages asking her to schedule

an insurance review.



Leave Sarah a friendly voi
 encouraging her to call back or

schedule an appointment.



Do not write or read a complicated sales pitch.



We want to hear how you naturally communicate with a client.



ONE FINAL QUESTION



At the very end of your application, answer this question:



If you finished all of the follow-up calls and tasks assigned to you for

the day two hours early, what would you do with the remaining two hours?



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be

considered.



We’re looking for someone who wants to help build something, take

ownership of their responsibilities, and grow with us over the long

term.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



This is an ops role with an outreach front end. You source creators, sign them, walk them through onboarding and warm-up, keep them posting on schedule, and make sure they get paid, across several client campaigns at once. When a campaign needs 10 or more creators posting a video a day, you are the person who knows at any moment who posted, who did not, and who is stuck.



Everything runs through 
. The best fit here is a strong ops person who is also good with people: fast, accurate, organized, and fine with strategy changing mid-contract.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and discovery. Find creators on discovery platforms using filters like US-based, niche, and account performance, and check whether their existing content formats match what we are actually trying to produce. Also watch TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram directly for viral formats and rising talent.

- Outreach. First contact via DM,
, or 
, pitch the opportunity, and run the relationship from there.

- Negotiation. Most UGC creators land on one of two standard rates, so day to day this is simple. On micro-influencer campaigns you will negotiate real deals creator by creator: rates, deliverables, usage.

- Onboarding and warm-up. Guide creators through onboarding in 
, including our bot-guided flow. Review warm-up videos and confirm creators are warming their accounts correctly before they post campaign content.

- Content review. Check creator content in 
 against campaign requirements, including that every video uses the right campaign hashtag so it gets tracked. Flag what needs redoing and explain why.

- Posting ops and reporting. Keep daily posting on track across every active campaign and maintain clean reporting on who posted, who did not, and who needs a nudge. Current and accurate, not reconstructed at the end of the week.

- Creator support. Be the first line for creator questions and unblock people fast. Advice has to be right and it has to be quick, since a correct answer six hours late still costs us a post.

- Payments. Run creator payouts on payment platforms like Grade and track what has been paid against what is owed.

- Spreadsheets and process. Work in our existing Google Sheets templates: updating them, fixing errors, keeping campaign data clean. If you can make our sheets run better, even better.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong ops instincts. You hold a lot of moving pieces without dropping any and always know the current state of a campaign.

- You know creator ops language (CPM, base pay, tiered bonuses, caps, deliverables) or can pick it up fast.

- You understand how social platforms actually work: hashtags and tracking, algorithms, formats, why a short-form video lands.

- Comfortable in 
. Servers, roles, channels, threads, tickets, bots.

- Great written communicator. Casual is fine, formal is not required, but it has to be clear, quick, and obviously competent with both creators and the team.

- Software-native. You use a lot of apps, pick up new ones fast on mobile and web (a PC for desktop apps helps), notice UI and UX details, and can take clean screenshots to build walkthroughs that guide a creator through an app they have never opened.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets.

- Adaptable. We work with early-stage startups where strategy gets built as contracts progress.



NICE TO HAVE

- Creator ops, influencer marketing, talent management, or community management experience

- Experience running creator payouts or working with payment platforms

- Advanced Sheets skills (formulas, automation, Apps Script) and an eye for improving process

- Familiarity with our niches: gaming, mobile consumer apps, crypto and trading

- You have created or edited short-form content yourself



THE BAR



You should be able to walk the full creator lifecycle start to finish, from sourcing to outreach to rate agreement to 
 onboarding to warm-up to posting with the right hashtag to tracking to payout, and know where any given creator sits in it at any moment.

title: Virtual RN Clinical Operations & Quality Manager – Medicare Home Health
description:
Position Overview



Penn Home Health Care is seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team as a Virtual RN Clinical Operations & Quality Manager – Medicare Home Health.



This is not an entry-level RN or general healthcare virtual assistant position.



We are specifically seeking a candidate with hands-on experience working with a U.S. Medicare-certified home health agency, including strong working knowledge of Axxess, OASIS, Plans of Care, physician orders, Medicare documentation requirements, clinical record review, and quality assurance.



The Virtual RN Clinical Operations & Quality Manager will work remotely from the Philippines and support the Administrator and designated clinical leadership of Penn Home Health Care.



This position does not serve as the agency's designated regulatory Director of Nursing (DON). Instead, the role provides significant clinical operations, documentation, quality assurance, compliance, and workflow support for the agency's Medicare home health operations.



The successful candidate should be able to work within Axxess with minimal training and independently identify documentation, workflow, and compliance issues requiring follow-up or escalation.



Key Responsibilities



Medicare Home Health Clinical Operations



• Support the Administrator and designated clinical leadership with day-to-day Medicare home health clinical operations.

• Coordinate and monitor clinical workflows from referral and admission through discharge.

• Monitor Start of Care (SOC), Resumption of Care (ROC), recertification, transfer, and discharge processes.

• Review clinical records for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely completion.

• Monitor Plans of Care and related clinical documentation.

• Review and track physician orders, outstanding signatures, certifications, and other required documentation.

• Identify incomplete, inconsistent, overdue, or potentially non-compliant clinical documentation.

• Coordinate follow-up with appropriate clinical staff regarding documentation deficiencies.

• Assist with patient care coordination and clinical workflow tracking.

• Escalate significant clinical or compliance concerns to the Administrator or designated clinical leadership.



Axxess



The successful candidate must have hands-on Axxess experience and be comfortable performing clinical and operational functions within the system.



Responsibilities may include:



• Reviewing patient charts and clinical documentation.

• Monitoring outstanding and incomplete documentation.

• Reviewing Plans of Care and physician orders.

• Tracking clinical workflow and documentation status.

• Identifying documentation deficiencies.

• Monitoring required signatures and outstanding orders.

• Supporting clinical staff with Axxess-related workflows.

• Generating or reviewing reports used for clinical operations, compliance, and quality monitoring.



Candidates should be able to work in Axxess with minimal training.



OASIS & Clinical Documentation



• Review OASIS documentation for completeness, consistency, and potential documentation concerns.

• Understand Medicare home health documentation requirements associated with SOC, ROC, recertification, transfer, and discharge.

• Review clinical documentation against the patient's Plan of Care.

• Identify inconsistencies between assessments, orders, Plans of Care, visit documentation, and other clinical records.

• Assist with documentation follow-up and correction processes.

• Support timely completion of required clinical documentation.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

• Perform routine clinical chart audits and documentation reviews.

• Assist with Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities.

• Identify recurring documentation and workflow deficiencies.

• Track corrective actions and follow-up items.

• Assist with internal audits and compliance monitoring.

• Support preparation for Medicare, state, accreditation, or other regulatory surveys and audits as directed.

• Help maintain clinical policies, procedures, audit tools, trackers, and quality documentation.

• Assist leadership in monitoring compliance with applicable Medicare home health requirements.

• Provide reports and findings to the Administrator and designated clinical leadership.



Staff Coordination & Clinical Support



• Communicate with nurses, therapists, clinicians, and administrative staff regarding documentation and workflow issues.

• Assist with clinical staff orientation and training related to documentation, workflows, and agency procedures.

• Participate in virtual case conferences and clinical meetings as assigned.

• Assist with staff competency, education, and quality-improvement initiatives.

• Maintain professional communication with agency leadership and clinical personnel.

• Follow up consistently on outstanding clinical and compliance items.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must have:



• Registered Nurse (RN) background.

• Actual experience working with a U.S. Medicare-certified home health agency.

• Strong, hands-on Axxess Home Health experience.

• Working knowledge of Medicare home health requirements and workflows.

• Experience with OASIS.

• Experience with SOC, ROC, recertification, transfer, and discharge workflows.

• Experience reviewing or managing Plans of Care and physician orders.

• Experience with clinical documentation review and quality assurance.

• Understanding of Medicare clinical documentation and compliance requirements.

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify documentation inconsistencies.

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

• Strong computer and technology skills.



Required Technology Experience



Candidates must be proficient with:



• Axxess Home Health

• Microsoft Teams

• Microsoft 365

• Outlook

• Word

• Excel

• OneDrive / SharePoint

• Video conferencing and other remote collaboration tools



Strongly Preferred Qualifications



Preference will be given to candidates with:



• USRN licensure or previous U.S. nursing experience.

• Several years of U.S. Medicare-certified home health experience.

• Advanced Axxess experience.

• Strong OASIS review or QA experience.

• QAPI/CQI experience.

• Clinical chart auditing experience.

• Medicare survey or audit preparation experience.

• Home health supervisory or clinical leadership experience.

• Experience training or supervising clinical staff.

• Experience identifying and correcting documentation deficiencies.

• Strong knowledge of Medicare home health compliance requirements.



What We Are Looking For



We are not simply looking for an RN with general healthcare experience.



We need someone who already understands the operations of a U.S. Medicare-certified home health agency and can contribute with minimal training.



The ideal candidate is:



• Experienced with Medicare home health.

• Highly proficient in Axxess.

• Knowledgeable about OASIS and home health documentation.

• Detail-oriented and highly organized.

• Comfortable auditing clinical records.

• Able to identify documentation and compliance concerns.

• Proactive about following up on outstanding items.

• Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based leadership and clinical staff.

• Able to manage multiple priorities independently.

• Dependable, responsive, and accountable.

• Comfortable working in a structured remote environment.



Work Expectations



This is a full-time virtual position supporting a U.S.-based home health agency.



Candidates must have:



• Reliable high-speed internet.

• Reliable computer equipment.

• Professional and private home workspace.

• Reliable communication through Microsoft Teams,
, and phone.

• Ability to work the schedule established by Penn Home Health Care, including required overlap with U.S. business hours.

• Ability to maintain strict patient confidentiality and comply with applicable privacy, security, and agency requirements.



Compensation



$8–$12 USD per hour, based on qualifications and experience.



Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience with:



• U.S. Medicare-certified home health

• Axxess

• OASIS

• Plans of Care and physician orders

• QAPI and audits

• Medicare compliance

• Clinical leadership



Exceptional candidates with extensive Medicare home health, Axxess, OASIS/QA, compliance, and clinical leadership experience may be considered above the posted range.

- Brief craft: briefs that ship, specs, references, do/don't, hook variants, success criteria.

The mentality we are hiring for

You figure it out. You are a perfectionist about output. Your attention to detail is uncomfortable. You are relentlessly curious. You own the outcome. You operate independently.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
🚀 Remote Appointment Setter 

We are looking for disciplined, sharp communicators to join our outbound appointment-setting team.

This is a flexible remote role built for someone who wants to develop real sales skills, work from their phone, and earn based on performance without committing to a traditional full-time job.



🌍 What You Get

• 100% Remote: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection.

• Flexible Schedule: The core daily workflow usually takes around 30–40 minutes, depending on reply volume.

• Qualified Leads Provided: Your focus is setting appointments, not spending your time manually sourcing prospects.

• Complete Training: Scripts, SOPs, AI Looms, objection-handling resources and step-by-step training are provided.

• Real Skill Development: Build practical ability in sales psychology, prospect communication, follow-up and appointment setting.

• Growth Opportunities: Strong performers can be considered for future opportunities in Setting Management, training, closing and additional acquisition channels such as LinkedIn.

• Performance Upside: There is no fixed income cap, and strong performance may also unlock additional incentives.



💰 Compensation

You earn $300 USD for every client that closes from an appointment you generated. Monthly earnings can start at $300 with one closed client.



Examples:

• 1 closed client = $300

• 2 closed clients = $600

• 4 closed clients = $1,200



For reference, one closed client in a month equals $300 in monthly compensation, with additional upside based on performance.

Payments are made monthly.



COMPENSATION NOTE:

Compensation follows the performance structure outlined above. Please make sure this format matches what you are looking for before applying. It's 300$ per month



📱 Your Daily Workflow



Your work is simple and focused:



• Review the qualified leads assigned to you.

• Send the assigned outreach volume, typically around 20 DMs per day.

• Reply to active conversations and complete follow-ups.

• Send or request AI Looms when required.

• Move interested qualified prospects toward Calendly and an appointment.

• Keep your tracking accurate and up to date.



Once active, the core work usually takes around 30–40 minutes per day. Reply volume can make some days lighter or heavier.



🌅 How You Start



Depending on the Instagram account available to you, you will follow one of two onboarding paths:



• Existing Account Path: If you have an established personal Instagram account that is approved for outreach, you can begin at a very low DM volume and ramp up gradually.

• Warm-Up Path: If a new or dedicated account is required, you will complete a 21-day Instagram warm-up before full outreach. Successful completion earns a one-time $20 Warm-Up Completion Payment.



✅ Who We Are Looking For



• Strong written English.

• Reliable internet connection and access to Instagram from your phone.

• Consistency. You can complete a small daily workload without needing to be chased.

• Coachability. You can follow a process, apply feedback and ask questions when something is genuinely unclear.

• Clear communication. If something blocks your work, you raise it early.

• Comfort with performance-based compensation and variable results.

• A competitive, improvement-focused attitude.



🚫 Do Not Apply If



• You require a fixed salary, hourly wage or guaranteed daily pay.

• You are uncomfortable with earning based on closed clients.

• You are looking for a traditional full-time employee position.

• You are not willing to complete consistent daily outreach and follow-ups.

• You regularly disappear, ignore messages related to active work, or need repeated chasing to complete basic tasks.

• You are unwilling to follow the training and process before making your own changes.



📈 Opportunity



This role is intentionally small in daily time commitment, but the upside is not limited to the daily task itself.



Strong setters can earn more through performance, receive additional incentives, test new outbound systems, and be considered for expanded roles as the company grows.



You will also gain direct experience inside a real outbound acquisition system instead of simply doing repetitive admin work.



📩 How To Apply



Start your application with the words: SETTER ROLE



Then answer these five questions:



1. Why does a performance-based appointment-setting roleappeal to you?

2. Confirm the compensation structure in your own words.

3. Are you comfortable completing around 30–40 minutes of focused work per day and sending the assigned outreach consistently?

4. Do you currently have an established personal Instagram account that you actively use? If yes, briefly describe it.



Applications that do not clearly confirm the compensation structure will not be considered.



We are onboarding the next group of setters now. If the structure above fits what you are looking for, apply.

title: Follow Up Boss Builder (Must Show a Loom Inside an Account You Built) — Property Management CRM, Expert Rates, Fixed Bid
description:
We are a Dallas–Fort Worth property management company that has been in business since 2002 and manages a large portfolio of single-family rentals. Our leads are landlords and real estate investors, not home buyers. We are moving our owner-lead follow-up from LeadSimple to Follow Up Boss, and our FUB account is currently empty.



We are not looking for a VA who has used FUB. We are looking for the person who has built FUB accounts from zero for real estate teams, several times, and can prove it in five minutes. We pay expert rates for that person. If that is not you, please do not apply — the proof requirement below will screen you out and we would rather not waste your time.



Hard requirements

• You have personally built at least 3 Follow Up Boss accounts from scratch (not administered an account someone else built).

• You can record a Loom, inside a FUB account you built, walking through the Action Plans, Smart Lists, lead routing, and integrations you set up. This is required to apply.

• You have done at least one CRM-to-FUB migration (LeadSimple, kvCORE, BoomTown, Lofty/Chime, Sierra, LionDesk, etc.).

• You have set up FUB Calling/texting and taken a brokerage through A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration.

• You have connected non-native lead sources to FUB with Zapier or Make and webhooks (website forms at minimum).

• Written English is clear. You will work directly with the owner and the sales team and overlap 3–4 hours a day with US Central time.



Do not apply if

• Your CRM experience is GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho and you plan to "learn FUB quickly." We have a stack of those applications already.

• You cannot record the Loom described above.

• You are an agency or recruiter.



What you will build (6–8 weeks)

1. Migrate LeadSimple contacts into FUB — cleaned, de-duplicated, with stages, tags, sources, assigned agents and notes preserved.

2. Connect every lead source with correct Source attribution: WordPress/Gravity Forms (via Zapier or webhook, not
 parsing), BiggerPockets, Google Business Profile, Zillow and rental listing sites, landing pages, inbound office calls.

3. First-to-claim lead routing with team alerts and automatic re-assignment if nobody claims a lead in 5 minutes. Speed to lead is our #1 priority.

4. FUB Calling and texting for the team, A2P 10DLC registration, Google Workspace / Microsoft 365
 sync, call recording and voi
 drop where available.

5. Action Plans and Smart Lists for owner leads at every stage (new, no response, warm, long-term nurture, past client/referral). We supply the copy; you build timing, triggers, and exit conditions.

6. Users, permissions, a property-management pipeline (not buyer/seller), ponds, and reporting dashboards: lead volume by source, response time, conversion.

7. Short Loom training videos for agents and a written setup document.

After the build, we would like to keep you on a monthly retainer (roughly 5–10 hours) to maintain the system, add campaigns, and onboard agents. Strong performers get first call on automation work across our other companies.



Pay

Expert rates. Tell us your hourly rate, or give a fixed bid for the seven items above. We choose on proof and fit, not on the lowest number. Shortlisted candidates do a paid 1-hour live session configuring routing, an Action Plan, and a Smart List in our test account.



How to apply (all four required — incomplete applications are not read)

1. Loom link. 3–5 minutes, recorded inside a Follow Up Boss account you built (blur client names). Show us the Action Plans, a Smart List, the lead routing settings, and one integration. Talk us through why you set it up that way.

2. List the FUB accounts you built from scratch: team or brokerage type, agent count, year, and what CRM they came from. One line each.

3. Two short answers: (a) Describe a specific problem you hit in a past FUB migration or integration and exactly how you fixed it. (b) How would you do the 5-minute unclaimed-lead fallback in FUB — what is native and what needs Zapier or the API?

4. Your rate or fixed bid, your timeline, and the words "owner leads" as the first line of your reply.

We reply to every complete application within 3 business days.

title: Hiring: Senior Voice and Chat AI Engineer
description:
Important Notice to Applicants:



Please note that we are only contacting and communicating with candidates through OnlineJobsPH. Any applications or direct contact made outside of these channels, including
s, social media messages, direct messages to our CEO, or messages sent to our general company
, will not be considered and will be automatically declined.



About the Company:



We are a private U.S.-based company operating across multiple departments that support legal, staffing, and client-service operations. Our teams collaborate in dynamic, fast-paced environments focused on innovation, integrity, and client success.



In this role, you’ll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, making a real impact in operational, legal, and client-focused projects—all from the comfort of your home. Details about our company structure and associated teams will be introduced during the interview process



About the Role 



We're building a multi-tenant AI receptionist and case intake platform for law firms. It answers inbound calls over SIP, whether they originate on the PSTN or from the firm's own SIP infrastructure. Each call loads that firm's tenant config and runs the right intake workflow, collecting and confirming structured case details. It applies the firm's qualification and routing rules without giving legal advice. From there it books consultations, warm-transfers to staff, or creates follow-up tasks. Intake records, transcripts, summaries, and recordings go to firm staff through controlled access. 



We are looking for a highly autonomous Senior Voice AI Engineer to build this from the ground up and deliver a pilot-ready MVP within 90 days. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role: you will own architecture, technology decisions, implementation, deployment, testing, and technical operation, working directly with stakeholders who provide product direction, domain input, and rapid feedback rather than a detailed specification. The MVP channel is inbound voice with no outbound dialing, but design the conversation and workflow layer so web chat and other text-based channels can reuse the same tenant rules, integrations, and guardrails. This is applied product engineering, not AI research. 



What You Will Own 



Voice and Conversation Engineering 



Build and optimize the real-time voice pipeline — LiveKit Agents, Strands, or another well-justified architecture — with streaming STT, LLM, and TTS or speech-to-speech models, tuned for perceived latency, transcription accuracy, and naturalness. 



Implement voice activity detection, endpointing, turn-taking, barge-in, interruption recovery, silence handling, and conversation repair for noisy lines, accents, incomplete answers, long pauses, and caller corrections. 



Build deterministic workflow and state management — reliable tool calling, validation, retries, timeouts, idempotency, failure recovery — so critical intake actions never depend on prompt behavior alone. 



Telephony:



- Configure inbound numbers, SIP trunks, dispatch rules, call routing, DTMF, and human transfers with providers such as LiveKit, Twilio, Telnyx, or Bandwidth. 



- Handle dropped calls, provider failures, after-hours routing, duplicate calls, spam, and wrong numbers, with monitoring for call quality, transfer success, and provider performance. 



- Multi-Tenant Product Architecture 



- Design secure tenant isolation across data, prompts, workflows, integrations, credentials, recordings, and reporting. 



- Build a reusable configuration model — practice areas, questions, qualification criteria, disclosures, transfer destinations, calendars, languages, business rules — versioned so production behavior can be reproduced and audited, and so scaling from pilot to many firms is configuration rather than custom implementation. 



Integrations and Data:



- Build APIs and webhooks for calendars, CRMs, and legal case-management platforms such as Clio, Filevine, Lawmatics, Litify, or MyCase, with queues, retries, reconciliation, and audit trails. 



- Convert conversations into validated, structured intake records and safely store call metadata, transcripts, summaries, recordings, tool activity, and outcomes. 



Safety, Security, and Reliability:



- Implement guardrails against legal advice, promised outcomes, an implied attorney-client relationship, or operation outside approved workflows, existing clients, sensitive matters, unsupported practice areas, and callers who need a human. 



- Build configurable disclosures and recording controls per firm and jurisdiction; protect caller data through encryption, least-privilege access, secret management, retention controls, audit logging, and review of model and vendor data-handling policies; and run production monitoring, alerting, tracing, and i
 response. 



Testing and Evaluation:



Build automated conversation tests and regression suites covering interruptions, silence, noisy audio, accents, ambiguous or invalid answers, provider failures, and unexpected caller behavior. 



Set measurable standards for intake completeness, field accuracy, tool-call and transfer success, latency, safety violations, and cost per call; review real calls to improve prompts, workflow logic, models, and provider selection; and keep a repeatable process for safely deploying changes. 



Required Experience:



5+ years of professional software engineering — the scope and quality of what you have shipped matters more than the number. 



Hands-on experience building and launching at least one real-time, phone-based voice AI agent in production or a serious customer pilot. Demos alone are not sufficient. 



Strong Python: asynchronous programming, streaming systems, API development, and production debugging. 



LiveKit Agents or a comparable real-time voice framework (Pipecat, Vapi, Retell, or a custom WebRTC/WebSocket implementation), integrating STT, LLM, TTS, or speech-to-speech models from multiple providers. 



Practical telephony experience — SIP, PSTN providers, call routing, DTMF, transfers, codecs — with deep understanding of latency, voice activity detection, endpointing, turn-taking, barge-in, and streaming tool execution. 



Dependable agent workflows with explicit state, structured outputs, and deterministic business rules; multi-tenant SaaS with strong data isolation; cloud deployment and operations (containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring); and clear communication of technical tradeoffs to a non-specialist. 



Preferred Experience:



Production LiveKit (Agents, Cloud, or self-hosted), Strands Agents, Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or Nova Sonic. 



OpenAI Realtime, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, or similar providers. 



Web chat or omnichannel conversational systems, multilingual voice, and legal technology, healthcare, financial services, or another privacy-sensitive industry. 



A computer science degree is not required; demonstrated production work, technical judgment, and ownership matter more. 



What Success Looks Like 



Within 90 days, pilot law firms can route inbound calls to a production voice agent that: 



Conducts a natural, professional intake conversation and accurately captures the information the firm needs. 



Follows tenant-specific rules and disclosures, completes approved actions reliably, transfers callers to a human when appropriate, and avoids legal advice and unsupported claims. 



Produces useful structured records and summaries, can be monitored, evaluated, debugged, and improved, and supports additional firms primarily through configuration rather than custom development.



How to Apply



Please send your application ONLY to 



Make sure your subject line begins with:



“Sr. Ai Voice and Chat Engineer – [Your Name]”



This helps us correctly identify your application and confirms that you’ve read the full job description carefully.

title: Social Media Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a skilled **Social Media Video Editor** to work with our creative team on an ongoing basis.



We’ll start with freelance/project-based work, with the opportunity for this to **grow into a consistent part-time or full-time position** for the right person.



This is **not an entry-level editing position**. You should be at least an intermediate-level editor who understands pacing, storytelling, music, sound design, graphics, and what makes social content hold someone’s attention.



## What You’ll Be Editing



You’ll primarily work on:



* Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head and educational content

* Short-form videos created from longer-form content

* Promotional and marketing videos

* B-roll-driven edits

* Occasional longer-form YouTube/video content



We’re looking for someone who can take raw footage and turn it into a finished piece—not simply follow a template.



## What We're Looking For



You must:



* Be **fluent in written and spoken English**

* Have at least **intermediate-level professional video editing skills**

* Have strong experience editing short-form social media content

* Understand pacing, hooks, retention and visual storytelling

* Know when and how to use B-roll to support what is being said

* Be comfortable with captions, motion graphics, transitions, music and sound design

* Have a strong sense of timing and attention to detail

* Understand how to make content feel professional without over-editing it

* Be able to follow an established brand/style while also bringing creative ideas to the edit

* Be organized and able to meet deadlines consistently

* Communicate clearly and respond well to feedback



Experience with **Adobe Premiere Pro is strongly preferred.** After Effects experience is a plus.



## Our Editing Style



We are **not** looking for someone whose editing style relies heavily on flashy transitions, constant zooms, excessive graphics or effects.



Good editing should support the person, story and message.



Sometimes that means adding visual energy, B-roll, graphics, music or sound design. Other times it means knowing when to keep things simple and let the content breathe.



We want an editor who understands the difference.



## Opportunity to Grow



This position will begin with **freelance/project-based assignments** so we can get to know each other's working styles.



For someone who consistently delivers great work, communicates well and is reliable, there is an opportunity to grow into a **regular part-time or full-time position with consistent weekly work.**



We’re interested in finding someone we can work with long-term—not just someone for a few projects.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. A link to your portfolio.

3. **Three examples of social media videos that you personally edited.**

4. The editing software you use.

5. Your current availability and preferred working hours.

6. Your expected hourly or project-based rate in USD.



**Please do not apply without examples of your work.**



We care about editing ability, but **reliability, communication, creative judgment and consistency are equally important.** If you do great work and are easy to work with, there is plenty of opportunity for the role to grow.

Qualify potential customers

Schedule product demonstrations or sales meetings

Follow up consistently with interested prospects

What We're Looking For

Strong verbal communication skills

Comfortable making cold calls throughout the day

Confident speaking with business owners and potential customers

Ability to handle rejection and continue prospecting

Self-motivated and able to work independently from home

Reliable and punctual

Organized with strong follow-up skills

Comfortable learning scripts, software, and CRM systems

Goal-oriented and motivated by performance-based compensation

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, lead generation, inside sales, insurance, restaurant operations, or software sales is preferred but not required for the right candidate.

Restaurant or food-service experience is a plus, especially for the restaurant software portion of the position.

Compensation

This position offers:

Hourly Base Pay + Commission

s

- Philippines-based candidates only

- Must be available during U.S. business hours

- Moderate phone responsibilities combined with administrative and property management work



Compensation and Benefits:



- ₱40,000 per month

- Annual compensation reviews with the potential for pay increases based on performance, client satisfaction, and company growth

- Paid training

- Stable, long-term employment

- Opportunities for professional growth

The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who understands real estate operations, takes ownership of responsibilities, and is committed to delivering excellent service to tenants while keeping the company’s back-office operations running smoothly.
