title: Full-time Bookkeeper
description:
Who We Are -



Hello; my name is Casandra Armstrong, and I am the President of Resilient Pro Group LLC. We are an accounting and tax firm based out of Phoenix, AZ (United States).



We are a small, but growing company and are experiencing quite a bit of growth. This has pushed the need for us to hire you, our newest team member.



We help small businesses, just like ours, maintain, manage, and grow their businesses by ensuring accurate financials, processing payroll for their employees, tax preparation and strategy. We ensure we can take as much off the owner’s plate as possible while building trust within our working relationships.



You’re probably wondering if you would be our first Filipino team member?



Actually, no. We currently have 4 team members who are from the Philippines like yourself. We have 2 bookkeeping specialists, a tax specialist, and an administrative specialist that are based in the Philippines as well. In addition to them, our operations manager is US based.



If you’re wondering what you would be doing?



The job title is Bookkeeping Specialist. I am looking for someone who can perform detailed bookkeeping for several small business clients. Your primary duties as a bookkeeper would include document processing, data entry, account reconciliation, ledger management, and financial report processing while understanding the business structure and needs. We are QuickBooks based, so a QuickBooks background is required. However, we will also train on processes.





So, why should you join us over anyone and everyone else?



If you would like…

1) a steady pay check with the chance for bonuses based on performance,

2) the opportunity to work from home without a boss breathing down your neck,

3) a team environment where you work with others to share the work, and

4 ) if you want to work for a stable, growing U.S. firm,

…then this is a job you will enjoy and excel at.





How to know if you’re qualified for this opportunity?



We are looking for someone who has bookkeeping experience, complete understanding of debits and credits, assets and liabilities, inter-company transfers, problem solving skills, fluent in English speaking and writing with the experience of speaking directly with US clients, and most importantly someone who can work with little to no direction and meet deadlines. We do not expect you to know it all as we will train you in your position with everything you need to know about our clients and our field for you to be able to excel at your job.



I do need you to be a good leader- someone who can effectively manage him or herself at the job as well as manage others; someone who has extensive attention to detail, can manage and meet deadlines, follow processes and provide ideas for enhanced processes, problem solve and troubleshoot on their own with little to no direction, be able to effectively resolve issues with upset clients. Intermediate bookkeeping/accounting experience, and QuickBooks experience is required.



I also cannot teach you to have a good attitude and to be self-motivated. These are things you must demonstrate in the interview process.



A successful applicant must be able to demonstrate:



* A can do attitude, and the ability to work without constant supervision

* Be able to speak in conversational English and write in passable English as well

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Dropbox, QuickBooks, and general ability to use windows based software

* Have or be willing to obtain Internet fast enough to allow for virtual meeting such as zoom and VOIP phone calls without degradation

* Working microphone and Internet video camera

* Workstation with 2 monitors



So, what are the working hours?



As I stated before, our company is based in Phoenix, Arizona so we would require you to work during the US business hours, Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:30pm Arizona Time



What about pay?



We are serious about hiring someone and are looking to fill this position ASAP. I also want this to be a real job that can meet your financial needs. Therefore, pay is negotiable but know I want you to be happy and satisfied working here, and a good pay scale is part of that.



What about the 13th Month?



Wondering if we pay the 13th month? Unfortunately, we do not. However, we do offer other benefits such as pay time off, holiday pay, and sick time for Full-Time positions. These benefits begin to accrue after your 90 days probation period of a full-time position.



What happens next?



Since our jobs are so popular we generally get deluged with applicants. So, I have designed a multi-part interview process to make the process as simple and efficient for all parties.



The first part of the interview process is designed to examine your English-speaking & writing skills, personality type, internet speed and ability to follow directions. Please realize the initial application process will take a time commitment on your part of roughly 10-20 minutes. Since this job is intended to be well paying, I hope this time commitment is acceptable to you. Please be advised that those who submit incomplete applications will be passed over.



If you make it through this first round, we will talk via video chat to answer any questions you may have as well as get to know you better. If this goes well, I will invite you to meet some other team members, as well as call your references to see if there is still a good fit.



We will then ultimately hire someone.





How to Apply



Therefore, to submit your application for the job, please complete all of the following and
 them to me at the reply to
 address: 
 Please send me all the following to applications at resilientpros dot com

a. Your resume

b. Link to your onlinejobs.ph profile and,

c. Names with your relationship for 3 people I can contact whom would say good things about working with you. This could be a priest, former employer, bank manager, school teacher, but no more than 1 of these people can be a family member.



2. Please also complete the tests at the following link and provide a copy of your results:


/leveltest/grammar_level_test.htm


/disc-personality-test/


/tools/speed-test/work-from-home-speed



Please be advised that incomplete applications will be ignored. I know this sounds harsh, but this is a detailed job, and I need to know you can follow directions.

The Company

Anomaly CPA is virtual CPA firm based out of Boston, MA providing tax, accounting and advisory services to our clients.  



The Position

The Accountant will work directly with the Accounting Project Manager or Senior Accountant to provide accounting services to our clients.  This includes monthly accounting engagements and special projects. Below are some of the job responsibilities for this position:



- The Accountant will generally be the assigned as the preparer on client accounts and must adhere to the accounting workflow process including: client review checklist, coding, account reconciliation and producing of financial statements

 within 8 business hours and meet virtually with clients for meetings when needed. 

- Attend virtual team meetings weekly.  

- Assist in special accounting or tax related projects.

- Provide other services as the needs arise.



This role is full-time.



The Requirements

We expect the person who fills this position to have the following skills and abilities:

- Flexible: The work that is performed will change and won’t be the same day-to-day. You will need to be able to adjust on the fly.

- Responsible: This position would mean that you would be working from home with minimal supervision. While you get to work on your schedule, you will be responsible for meeting agreed upon deadlines and time frames for performing the work. Someone who is self-motivated is a plus for this position.

- Work Independently: You will, for the most part, be working alone.  You will need to be comfortable working in that type of environment.

- Tech Savvy: All of the applications we use are cloud-based, and there are a lot of them.  You will need to be able to pick up and work with multiple applications and understand how different applications talk and work with each other.  On the adoption curve, we are definitely early adopters and you will need to be one as well.

- Attention to Detail: Accounting and taxes are inherently detail intensive.  Beyond that, work we do for clients or internally requires the data and information to be correct.  Small errors can lead to big problems. You need to make sure that your completed work is generally right the first time.

- Understand the confidential nature of the work being performed: The nature of this business is that we will be handling a lot of confidential information. We have security measures in place for this information, however, human error can make our security measures meaningless. You will be responsible for ensuring that the confidential information that you touch remains secure.

- Quick Learner: We expect that you will be able to pick things up quickly and be willing to learn new things.

title: HIRING: AI VIDEO EDITOR → CREATIVE STRATEGIST | $300K → $1M/MONTH BRAND, STILL CLIMBING
description:
$2,000–$4,000/month base + uncapped commission as a % of ad spend on your winning ads · Remote · Full-time



We're a DTC brand that went from $300K months to $1M months, fast. That didn't happen by a
. We know exactly who buys, why they buy, and what an ad has to say to them to turn into a winner. The avatar is figured out, the data is clean, and it's all yours from day one.



What we don't have is enough hands that can take that and turn it into 6–10 finished ads a week. That's the seat.



I'm not looking for a freelancer to hand tasks to. I'm looking for someone who wants to be in the business with us, sees the brand's growth as their own growth, and treats every winning ad like it's paying their rent. Because it will.



What you'll do

- Ship 6–10 direct-response video ads per week for Meta, from briefs built on our proven avatar and data

- Use AI for a lot: AI UGC, AI avatars and talking heads, AI b-roll, hybrid AI and real footage, whatever wins

- Build hooks, angles and iterations, not just execute someone else's script

- Match every visual to the line it sits under. Most editors grab B-roll that's vaguely on-topic and the ad dies

- Iterate fast off performance data. We go through what won, what died, and why, every week

- Push the format forward. New AI tools drop every month and I want you testing them before anyone else



Why this seat is different

You'll see your numbers every day. You get a tracking sheet that refreshes daily with the performance of every ad you made: spend, hook rate, hold rate, ROAS. You always know where you stand and exactly what your bonus is doing. No guessing, no waiting for a monthly report.



Uncapped commission on ad spend. Your bonus is a percentage of the spend your winning ads carry. KPI agreed up front. A winner keeps paying you for as long as it keeps spending. No ceiling on it.



The avatar is done. We know who she is, what she believes, and what stops her scroll. You don't have to guess who you're talking to, you have to make ads that hit her. Fast.



We invest in you. You get the ecomtalent course paid for, every AI tool you need on our accounts, and if you find a new tool that makes you faster or better, tell me and we'll get it. We're always open to suggestions.



Direct access. No manager, no ticket queue. Me, the data, and you.



Where this goes

Editor → Junior Creative Strategist → Creative Strategist → Senior Creative Strategist.



Every step is a pay rise, based on performance, not time. If you start thinking about why an ad works, not just how to cut it, and you start writing your own scripts, you'll get there fast. It's earned, not automatic, and how fast you get there is on you.



You'll thrive here if

- You already live in AI video tools and get excited when a new model drops

- You think in hooks, pacing and retention, not filters and transitions

- You take blunt feedback and come back with a better cut the same day

- You're hungry. You screenshot ads you scroll past and have real opinions on why a hook works

- You want ownership, not a task list. You want to grow with the brand, not pass through it



Don't apply if

- You edit for looks, not conversions

- You've never run direct-response creative that spent real money

- You're anti-AI or "AI is a tool I use sometimes"

- You're a freelancer looking to stack another client

- You need everything spelled out before you can produce

- You go quiet when a deadline slips

None of those people last here.



The offer

- $2,000–$4,000/month base depending on where you're at

- Uncapped commission as a % of ad spend on every ad that hits our KPI, tracked daily in your sheet

- ecomtalent course, all AI tools and subscriptions paid

- Base reviewed and moved up as you produce winners and step into strategy



How to apply

Fill out the form below. It takes about 10 minutes.



👉 
 



Send your portfolio, your best AI-generated ad work, and a short note on which AI tools you actually use and why. Tell me about an ad you made that won and why you think it won. Don't send me a copy-paste application. Tell me why YOU want this seat specifically.

title: Chargeback Specialist
description:
The role



Own chargebacks end to end — prevention, response, recovery, and reporting. Today this work is split across the CS team and several tools. You'll be the single owner: every dispute has one person accountable for it from the first alert to the final win/loss, plus the reporting that tells us where they came from.



What you'll own



Prevention



Work the daily dispute-alert queue: triage every incoming alert, d
 refund vs. fight, clear the review backlog within SLA

Catch pre-dispute signals in the support inbox and reach the customer before they call their bank

Flag repeat abusers and high-risk order patterns



Response & recovery



Build evidence packs for every dispute: order and fulfillment proof, delivery confirmation, customer comms, product/policy documentation

Submit and track responses across all our payment processors — each has its own rules and deadlines; you'll know them cold

Audit what our third-party recovery tooling actually wins vs. what we could win in-house

Never miss a deadline. A dispute lost on a missed date is the one failure mode this role can't have.



Reporting & root cause



Weekly chargeback report: volume, reason codes, win rate, dollars at risk, dollars recovered

Monthly dispute report with root-cause breakdown — shipping, product expectation, subscription confusion, friendly fraud

Feed findings back into CS macros, policy, and the checkout experience so the same dispute stops recurring



What we're looking for



5+ years handling chargebacks or payment disputes, ideally DTC/e-commerce

Hands-on with at least one major processor's dispute flow (Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal, Braintree)

Fluent written and spoken English — you'll write evidence narratives a bank reviewer reads, and you'll get on calls with customers and payment reps

Deadline-obsessed and organized without being chased. This role runs on a calendar.

Comfortable in spreadsheets: pivot data, spot a trend, present a number you can defend

Bonus: helpdesk platforms (Gorgias or similar), dispute-automation tools, subscription billing



Tools you'll live in: our helpdesk, Shopify, dispute prevention and recovery platforms, Slack, 
, Google Sheets



How we'll measure you (first 90 days)



30 days: every open dispute logged and current; zero missed deadlines

60 days: alert queue cleared daily; weekly report shipping on its own

90 days: win rate baselined and improving; two root-cause fixes shipped into CS process

title: Tag Manager Pixel Tracking Specialist – Pixels, Events & Attribution

(PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.)

Why This Role Exists

Ads don’t fail when creative is bad.

They fail when signals lie.



At Black Hat Strategy, we operate in restricted and volatile advertising environments where performance decisions are only as good as the data behind them. When tracking breaks, buyers react to ghosts. Budgets get pulled. Escalations happen for the wrong reasons.



We’re hiring a Tracking Specialist to ensure that what we see is real, what fires is accurate, and what we optimize against can be trusted.



This role exists so:

Media Buyers aren’t guessing

Escalation teams aren’t chasing false alarms

Leadership isn’t making decisions on bad data

This is not about “installing a pixel once.”

This is about ongoing signal integrity.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

You won’t be running ads.

You’ll be protecting the data behind them.

Set up and validate tracking across ecommerce platforms

Meta Pixel

Event prioritization & AEM

Deduplication logic

Platform diagnostics

Verify that events fire correctly across:

Browsers

Devices

Consent states

Document setups, issues, and fixes clearly inside ClickUp

Support Escalation & Recovery by validating whether issues are technical or behavioral



You are not reacting to noise.

You are confirming truth.



What This Role Owns (From the SOP)

Tracking setup and validation

Ongoing signal health monitoring

Technical audits during escalations

Confirmation that performance drops are real

Documentation of tracking logic and changes



If tracking is wrong, this role finds it.

Thinks in root causes, not surface symptoms

Documents work cleanly and precisely

Enjoys deep, technical problem-solving

This role rewards people who value accuracy while maintaining speed.



This Role Is Not for Someone Who…

Only knows “copy/paste” pixel setups

Avoids technical debugging

Gets frustrated digging through logs or diagnostics

Wants creative or strategic ownership

Dislikes documentation



How You’ll Work With the Team

Media Buyers execute campaigns… you ensure their signals are real

Respect for careful, precise work

Clear systems and SOPs

Long-term role with real importance



We don’t reward speed for speed’s sake.

title: Facebook Ads Media Buyer
description:
We’re Hiring Media Buyers Who Can Think Strategically, Learn Fast, and Execute Cleanly



We’re looking for 1 full-time Media Buyer to join our remote team directly.



This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands — but we are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and executes tasks blindly.



We’re looking for people who understand media buying at a strategic level, can think through campaign decisions, recognize patterns in performance, and know when to take action, when to hold, and when to escalate.



You should be able to follow systems carefully, communicate clearly, and execute consistently — while also bringing good judgment, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of why certain decisions are being made.



This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right people.



Position Details

Position: Media Buyer

Openings: 1

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period, paid in USD

Pay Schedule: Paid once every 2 weeks

Workload: 80 hours per 2-week period, agreed upon at hire



Team Structure:

You will work under the guidance of the Lead Media Buyer and our internal operations system. However, this is not an order-taking role. We expect you to understand the strategy behind the tasks you are executing, think critically about performance, and contribute useful observations when something needs attention.



Core Skills and Requirements



You should:

Have managed Meta ad accounts for e-commerce brands

Understand campaign structure, performance signals, pacing, testing, and optimization basics

Be able to think strategically about what the data is showing, not just make random changes

Know when to act, when to wait, and when to flag something for review

Have project management experience or have used project management tools before

Have strong attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully, including starting the application headline with BHS

Have a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Be open to feedback and treat it as an opportunity to improve

Be responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Be able to document your work clearly and consistently

Know when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Be willing to learn our internal systems while also bringing your own media buying judgment to the role



As a Media Buyer, You Will Be Responsible For:

Managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands

Launching and maintaining campaigns using predefined structures

Monitoring performance signals and campaign pacing daily

Making thoughtful changes only when the data and signals justify it

Understanding the reason behind campaign actions, not just completing tasks mechanically

Documenting actions, updates, and observations inside ClickUp

Making FTW the second word in your application headline, followed by your first name

Flagging account, campaign, or performance issues early

Escalating when something truly feels off, without overreacting to every small dip

Joining structured check-ins with the Lead Media Buyer when needed

Staying aligned with our internal systems, workflows, and campaign standards

Contributing useful observations when you notice patterns, risks, or opportunities in the accounts you manage



What to Expect When You’re Hired

You are not expected to know everything on day one. However, you are expected to learn quickly, follow the system, communicate clearly, and improve over time.

We do not use a time tracker, but we do track output, responsiveness, quality of execution, and your ability to think through the work strategically.



This role starts with a 30-day probationary period. After that, if you pass probation and show strong performance, reliability, responsiveness, and good decision-making, there will be room to discuss salary growth — especially if the campaigns you handle are performing well and you are adding real value to the team and our clients.



We are also in the process of creating an incentive system for tea
mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.



Our backend systems and internal processes are currently being improved, so some workflows may change from time to time. You will be guided through those changes, but we are looking for people who can adapt, think clearly, and keep moving forward.



How to Apply

After your initial greeting, please only include the following in the body:



Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role



Keep your recording short, clear, and relevant to your media buying experience.



To confirm availability, please close the recording by saying:

“I’m ready to start right away.”



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Dermatology Insurance Verification
description:
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Insurance Verification Specialist to join our growing dermatology practice. This position is responsible for ensuring that patients have accurate insurance information and that eligibility, benefits, authorizations, and financial responsibilities are verified prior to their appointments and procedures.



The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a medical or dermatology practice, strong knowledge of commercial insurance plans and Medicare, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.



Responsibilities

Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits prior to scheduled appointments and procedures.

Confirm active coverage, effective dates, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, and benefit limitations.

Determine whether providers and services are in-network or out-of-network.

Obtain and document referrals, pre-certifications, and prior authorizations when required.

Verify coverage requirements for dermatology services and procedures, including biopsies, excisions, destruction of benign and malignant lesions, phototherapy, injections, and other office-based procedures.

Accurately enter and update insurance information in the practice management/EHR system.

Identify incorrect, inactive, or incomplete insurance information and work to resolve discrepancies before the patient's visit.

Communicate anticipated patient financial responsibility, including deductibles, copays, and coinsurance, when appropriate.

Communicate with insurance companies through payer portals and by telephone to obtain accurate benefit information.

Work closely with clinical staff, front office staff, and billing to resolve insurance-related issues.

Identify potential coverage issues before services are rendered and communicate concerns to the appropriate team members.

Maintain thorough documentation of all verification and authorization activity.

Follow HIPAA and practice confidentiality requirements at all times.



Qualifications

Previous experience in medical insurance verification required

Dermatology practice experience strongly preferred.

Knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage plans.

Experience obtaining prior authorizations and referrals preferred.

Familiarity with CPT and ICD-10 codes and medical terminology.

Strong computer and data-entry skills.

Experience with electronic health records/practice management systems preferred.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.

Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced medical office.



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is reliable, organized, proactive, and takes ownership of their work. The successful candidate will understand that accurate insurance verification is an essential part of providing a positive patient experience and preventing billing issues for both the patient and the practice.



Dermatology and/or specialty medical practice experience is highly preferred.



Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience

Paid time off

Professional and supportive work environment

Monday–Friday schedule with no weekends

* Canva

* Etsy

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
Full-Time | Remote | 6:30 AM – 3:30 PM PST (Monday–Friday)



We're looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager to help grow our flagship Amazon brand.



In this role, you'll work directly with the founder and collaborate with our PPC Manager, Finance/Inventory VA, TikTok Affiliate Manager, and Operations team. You'll begin by learning our current systems and strategies before taking ownership of our Amazon operations.



This is a long-term opportunity with room for growth in a collaborative, performance-driven company where your ideas and initiative are valued.



What You'll Do

- Manage the day-to-day operations of our Amazon Seller Central account.

- Maintain and optimize product listings, including titles, bullets, images, A+ Content, and backend keywords.

- Monitor account health and proactively resolve issues before they become larger problems.

- Manage customer service, returns, reviews, reimbursements, and Amazon support cases.

- Create, track, and reconcile FBA shipments.

- Run Amazon promotions, coupons, and deals according to our promotional calendar.

- Analyze sales, traffic, and listing performance to identify opportunities for growth.

- Plan and execute A/B tests to improve conversion rates and listing performance.

- Monitor competitor activity and marketplace trends.

- Prepare a weekly performance report highlighting sales, account health, conversion metrics, and opportunities.

- Support new Amazon brands with listing setup and ongoing maintenance as they're launched.



We're looking for someone who has:

- At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

- Experience managing multiple SKUs and preferably multiple Amazon brands.

- Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Analytics.

- Hands-on experience creating FBA shipments, reconciling inventory, and filing reimbursement claims.

- Experience running structured Amazon listing A/B tests (Amazon Manage Your Experiments or similar).

- A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze results and continuously improve performance.

- Advanced Google Sheets or Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and complex formulas.

- A working knowledge of inventory forecasting and reorder point calculations.

- The ability to build organized weekly reports without requiring detailed templates.

- Excellent written English for customer service and Amazon case communication.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.



Nice to Have

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve workflows and reporting.

- Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon software.

- Experience with TikTok Shop Seller Central.

- Experience working with regulated or compliance-sensitive products.

- Experience working in a small, founder-led company where taking ownership is expected.



What Success Looks Like:



Weeks 1–2

Learn our current Amazon workflows by shadowing the founder.

Become familiar with our promotional calendar, listing strategy, and internal processes.



By Week 3

Deliver your first weekly performance report.



By Week 6

Produce consistent weekly reports.

Launch your first structured A/B test with documented results and recommendations.



By Day 90

Independently manage the flagship Amazon account.

Proactively identify and resolve issues before they become escalations.

Successfully support newly launched brands alongside flagship operations.



What This Role Doesn't Include?

- Managing PPC campaigns (handled by our dedicated PPC Manager).

- Negotiating with suppliers.

- Placing purchase orders.

- Making final pricing or product development decisions.



Why Join Us?

- Work directly with the founder and make a meaningful impact.

- Long-term position with opportunities for professional growth.

- Supportive, collaborative remote team.

- A company that values ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



Application Questions



To help us better understand your experience, please answer the following questions when you apply:

1. Can you commit to working full-time, 6:30 AM–3:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday?

2. Describe your internet speed and reliability. What backup plan do you have if your power or internet goes down during work hours?

3. How many ASINs or SKUs have you managed simultaneously, and across how many Amazon brands or Seller Central accounts?

4. List the Amazon Seller Central tasks you've personally handled. Please be as specific as possible.

5. Have you managed Amazon Brand Registry and A+ Content? Please describe one example.

6. Have you filed Amazon FBA reimbursement claims? Approximately how many, and what were the results?

7. Describe an A/B test you've run on an Amazon listing. What was your hypothesis, and what did you learn?

8. Rate your experience (1–10) in the following areas:

    - Google Sheets / Excel

    - Amazon Seller Central

    - Amazon Brand Analytics

    - Amazon A+ Content

    - Amazon Manage Your Experiments (or similar)

    - Canva, Photoshop, or similar design tools



9. Share three examples that demonstrate your attention to detail in Amazon-related work.

10. Tell us about a time you identified and solved an issue before anyone else noticed it.

11. How long were you in your most recent relevant role, and why did you leave?

12. What's the biggest challenge you've faced managing an Amazon account, and how did you overcome it?

13. What are your long-term career goals?

14. A customer leaves a 1-star review saying their item arrived damaged. Please write the exact response you would post.

title: TikTok Marketplace Officer
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand expanding aggressively on TikTok Shop. We operate multiple product categories and brand shops, and we're looking for one sharp, hands-on TikTok Shop Marketplace Manager who can own the entire channel — from product listings and promotions to affiliate relationships and creator campaigns. If you know TikTok Shop inside and out and want real ownership of a growing program, this role is for you.



Role Overview

This is a single, end-to-end ownership role. You will be responsible for two interconnected pillars:



1. TikTok Shop Operations  —  Product listings, shop management, promotions, GMV Max campaigns, and shop growth.

2. Affiliate & Creator Management  —  Finding, onboarding, managing, and growing affiliates and creator partnerships that drive real GMV.



You will report directly to the founder and run both pillars independently with ongoing guidance. This is not a task-taker role — we need someone proactive and commercial who takes ownership of results.



Key Responsibilities

Pillar 1: TikTok Shop Operations

• Upload and optimize product listings across all brand shops — titles, descriptions, images, and product content optimized for conversion.

• Organize products correctly across different shops and brand accounts.

• Create and manage company posts and promotional content on TikTok accounts.

• Build and execute posting plans for brand TikTok accounts.

• Set up, launch, and monitor GMV Max campaigns to drive product visibility and sales.

• Monitor shop performance (traffic, conversion, sales) and proactively recommend improvements.

• Manage promotions, discounts, and TikTok Shop growth tools.

• Provide regular reporting, updates, and growth recommendations to the founder.



Pillar 2: Affiliate & Creator Management

• Review and vet affiliate applications for free product samples; assess audience fit, content quality, and performance history.

• Handle outreach and communication with affiliates and creators via
 tools (Euka) and DMs — set up global messages, segment by niche or performance tier, and keep affiliates engaged.

• Identify high-potential creators and negotiate monthly retainers ($300–$1,500) for 8–12 videos/month plus commission on sales.

• Draft offers, track deliverables, and optimise retainer arrangements for ROI.

• Manage our affiliate community (50+ members), run monthly contests rewarding top GMV generators and video posters with prizes.

• Use tools like Refunnel to track submissions, attribute sales, and maintain leaderboards.

• Coordinate sample shipments and track creator and affiliate activity end-to-end.

• Monitor creator performance, affiliate GMV, and engagement metrics — report weekly insights.

• Support expansion of affiliates onto Amazon attribution and Refersion for multi-channel growth.



Tools You'll Use

Comfort with the following tools is expected or quickly learnable:



• TikTok Shop Seller Center (listings, campaigns, GMV Max)

• Euka —
 automation and affiliate communications

• Refunnel — UGC tracking, sales attribution, leaderboards

• Canva — content briefs and basic creative assets

• Google Sheets — reporting, GMV tracking, performance dashboards

• Community management platform (
 or similar) for affiliate community



What We're Looking For

Required Experience

• Proven, hands-on experience managing live TikTok Shop accounts — not theoretical knowledge.

• Experience listing products into TikTok Shop and managing shop operations end-to-end.

• Track record in affiliate marketing, influencer management, or creator partnerships — with real GMV results to show.

• Good understanding of GMV Max and TikTok Shop growth levers.

• Strong e-commerce background — you understand conversion, not just content.



Skills & Traits

• Excellent written English for
s, DMs, and community management.

• Strong negotiation skills for creator retainers and partnership terms.

• Analytical mindset — comfortable with GMV, engagement rates, conversion metrics, and ROI.

• Highly organized with sharp attention to detail across multiple shops, brands, and creator relationships simultaneously.

• Proactive and commercial — you find ways to move things forward without being told.

• People person who builds genuine relationships with creators and affiliates.

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced remote environment.



Practical Requirements

• Full-time availability during US Pacific Time hours (6:30AM – 3:30 PM PST, Monday–Friday).

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace.

• Based in the Philippines or Pakistan (preferred for time zone alignment and platform familiarity).

• Available to start immediately following a short-paid test task.



How to Apply

Start your application with the phrase TIKTOK GROWTH at the top so we know you've read this carefully.



Then answer all of the following questions in your application:



1. What TikTok Shop accounts or brands have you worked on?

2. What exactly did you do for those accounts? (Be specific — operations, affiliates, content, campaigns?)

3. Have you listed products into TikTok Shop yourself? Walk us through your process.

4. What affiliate campaigns have you run that drove real sales? What were the results?

5. What experience do you have with creators and influencers? How do you find the right ones?

6. Have you used GMV Max before? If yes, explain how and what results you achieved.

7. Have you worked with multiple shops or multiple brands simultaneously? How did you manage it?

8. How would you approach growing a new or underdeveloped TikTok Shop account from scratch?

9. Please send examples, screenshots, or case studies of your past TikTok Shop work.

10. What is your availability per week, and when can you start?





We're building something big. If you can own TikTok Shop end-to-end, we want to hear from you.

title: Mortgage Inside Sales Agent (ISA) & Appointment Setter | Washington State | Full-Time Remote
description:
We are a Washington State mortgage team looking for an experienced Inside Sales Agent (ISA) & Appointment Setter to handle outbound calling, lead qualification, appointment setting, and follow-up.



This is a phone-heavy role. You will be contacting homeowners who may benefit from a refinance program designed to help qualified borrowers lower their interest rate or monthly payment without additional closing costs out of pocket. Your job is to move leads from initial contact through the point where a meeting actually occurs.



You will not simply make calls and pass leads along. You will be responsible for:



Making consistent outbound cold calls

Explaining the refinance opportunity clearly and confidently

Identifying which leads are not a fit

Developing interested leads into qualified opportunities

Scheduling appointments for the mortgage team

Confirming appointments and reducing no-shows

Following up with leads who miss meetings

Rescheduling qualified prospects until the meeting occurs

Completing promised callbacks and follow-up at the agreed time

Keeping accurate notes and lead statuses inside the team’s custom dashboard

Learning the team’s sales flow and becoming less dependent on scripts over time

Providing feedback on objections, lead responses, and conversational patterns



We are looking for someone who is confident on the phone, articulate, quick-thinking, organized, and persistent.



You should be comfortable having natural conversations rather than reading word-for-word from a script. Strong English, clear pronunciation, and the ability to explain ideas professionally are extremely important.



The right candidate should also be highly disciplined with follow-up. If you tell a lead you will call them at a certain time, you are expected to follow through.



What We Are Looking For

Previous ISA, cold calling, appointment setting, mortgage, real estate, or phone-sales experience strongly preferred

Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

Strong verbal communication and conversational ability

Confident and comfortable speaking with prospects throughout the day

Strong appointment-setting and follow-up skills

Ability to think quickly and handle objections naturally

Strong organization and pipeline-management skills

Comfortable using CRM or lead-management systems

Persistent without being overly aggressive

Coachable and willing to improve based on feedback

Strong work ethic and personal accountability

Comfortable being measured on appointments, show rates, follow-up, and results

Performance Expectations



Within the first 30 days, you should be confident making outbound calls, learning the sales process, and scheduling approximately 3 to 5 meetings per week with a no-show rate below 25%.



By 60 days, you should be more conversational, less reliant on the script, able to provide useful feedback on the sales flow, and scheduling approximately 5 to 10 meetings per week with a no-show rate below 20%.



By 90 days, you should be fluent in the sales process, following up on 100% of your commitments, and scheduling approximately 10 to 15 meetings per week with a no-show rate below 15%.



This is a full-time remote position. Candidates may not maintain other active jobs, freelance clients, or outside professional commitments. Responsibilities may not be outsourced or delegated.



Pay: $9 to $11 per hour, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time

Location: Remote, supporting a Washington State mortgage team

Growth: Opportunity for increased responsibility and advancement based on performance and ability

title: Entry Level Admin Assistant
description:
Entry-Level Scheduling & Admin Assistant

Real Estate Media Company | Part-Time to Full-Time | Remote (Philippines)

Company Type Pay Hours Growth First Class Media LLC — New Hampshire, USA

Independent contractor, starting part-time (20 hrs/week) with room to grow to full-time

$1–3 USD/hour to start, based on experience; reviewed after 90 days

Monday–Friday, overlapping US Eastern morning (see Schedule)

This role is designed to grow — see Where This Leads

About Us

First Class Media is a real estate media company serving agents, brokerages, builders, and property

managers across New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island. We shoot listing photography,

video, FAA-licensed drone footage, and 360 tours with a team of field photographers and remote editors.

We're hiring our first admin assistant. Right now the owner handles every booking, confirmation, and

invoice personally, and that's the bottleneck. We're looking for someone organized and dependable to take

the routine, repeatable parts off his plate. You don't need years of experience — you need to be reliable,

detail-oriented, and willing to learn our systems properly.

What You'll Do

These are defined, repeatable tasks with written instructions. You won't be making judgment calls on your

own at the start.

Scheduling support

• Enter incoming shoot requests from our form and
 into Airtable, with address, services, and

requested date

• Send day-before confirmation messages to clients and photographers from our templates

• Update the calendar when jobs are moved or cancelled

• Flag scheduling conflicts and unusual requests to the owner rather than d
 yourself

Delivery tracking

• Check daily that photographers have uploaded footage to Dropbox after each shoot

• Send a reminder message when an upload is missing

• Track each job's status (shot → uploaded → editing → delivered) in Airtable

• Alert the owner when a job is at risk of missing its turnaround

Invoicing & records

• Create invoices from our price sheet after each delivery

• Send unpaid-invoice reminders on a set schedule

• File receipts and documents in the right Dropbox folders using our naming convention

• Keep the client contact list accurate and up to date

General admin

• Basic
 inbox sorting and labeling

• Simple data entry and list building in spreadsheets

• Send a short end-of-day summary of what you completed and anything outstanding

Who We're Looking For

Required

• Good written English — you'll be sending messages to American clients from templates

• Genuinely detail-oriented; you notice when a date, address, or number doesn't look right

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and able to learn Airtable and Dropbox (we'll train you)

• Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace

• Available consistently on the same schedule every weekday

• Willing to follow written procedures exactly and ask when something isn't covered

Helpful but not required

• Any previous VA, customer service, or BPO experience

• Exposure to real estate, photography, or scheduling work

• Basic invoicing experience

Not required: a degree, or years of experience. This is a genuine entry-level opening and we expect to

train you.

Schedule

Starting at 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday, with at least 4 hours overlapping 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM

US Eastern (9:00 PM – 1:00 AM Philippine time). That overlap is when clients and photographers need

answers. Hours can increase as you take on more.

Pay & Terms

• $1–3 USD/hour to start, set by experience; paid biweekly via Wise or Payoneer

• Paid 30-day trial with check-ins at week 2 and week 4

• Pay reviewed at 90 days and annually after that, based on what you're able to own independently

• 13th-month bonus in December once you've been with us six months

• Independent contractor arrangement; you're responsible for your own taxes and equipment

• You'll sign a simple confidentiality agreement — you'll be handling client information

Where This Leads

We're being straightforward: this starts at an entry-level rate because it starts as entry-level work, and we'd

rather grow one person than churn through many. As you prove you can run these tasks without

supervision, the role expands into managing photographer dispatch, handling client quotes, maintaining

our payroll tracker, and owning our filing calendar — with pay moving up to match. The person who does

this well becomes the operations manager for the business. If you're looking for a role you can stay in and

grow into, that's exactly what we want.

How to Apply

Send a message with:

1 Your hourly rate expectation and the hours you can work in US Eastern time

2 A short description of any work, study, or project where being organized and accurate mattered

3 What tools you've used (spreadsheets, CRMs, anything else)

4 Your internet speed and whether you have backup power

5 Put the word "Winnipesaukee" in the first line of your message so we know you read the whole

posting

Applications without all five items won't be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will get a short paid test task

— real data entry and a sample confirmation message — and a video interview.

title: Contractor Bookkeeper / Job Costing Specialist
description:
About Us



Vantage Financial is a financial-operations company built specifically for contractors and construction businesses. Most bookkeepers treat every industry the same — general categorization, a P&L at year-end, and not much else. We don't. We work exclusively with residential and commercial contractors, helping them get their books fully organized, understand exactly which jobs are actually making them money, and position themselves to access real business capital — 0% business credit cards, lines of credit, and equipment financing — without guessing or applying blind.



We're a growing company, and this role is a foundational hire on our operations team. As we bring on more contractor clients, this position has real room to grow — from managing a handful of accounts today to eventually leading and training a team of bookkeepers as we scale.



About the Role



This role starts part-time, with a clear path to full-time as we bring on more contractor clients. This isn't just an entry-level seat — the person who does well here is being considered as a future team lead, someone who'll help train and oversee additional bookkeepers as we grow, not just manage their own accounts long-term.



This is a hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping and job costing role, not a data-entry position. You'll be the person actually responsible for making sure our contractor clients' books are clean, accurate, and — most importantly — broken down job by job, so every client can see exactly what each project actually cost them and what it actually made them.



Day to day, that means managing bank and credit card feeds inside QuickBooks Online, reconciling accounts monthly, and using the Projects feature to tag every transaction — materials, labor, subcontractor costs — to the correct job. You'll be working across multiple contractor accounts at once, so strong organization and attention to detail matter as much as bookkeeping accuracy itself. You'll also need to understand contractor-specific accounting realities most bookkeepers never deal with — job costing, work-in-progress, retainage, and separating owner draws from real business expenses.



This role sits at the center of what we deliver to clients, so accuracy and consistency matter — a mistagged transaction or a missed reconciliation directly affects the numbers a client is making real business decisions on.



What You'll Do

Connect and manage bank/credit card feeds inside QuickBooks Online

Categorize and reconcile transactions monthly

Job cost every active and new project using QuickBooks Online Projects — tagging materials, labor, and other costs to the correct job

Properly track owner draws separate from business expenses

Communicate clearly on any transactions that need clarification

As we grow, help onboard and train additional bookkeepers joining the team

Requirements

Minimum 3+ years of bookkeeping experience with a construction industry background — general bookkeeping experience alone will not be considered. Must have direct experience with contractors or construction businesses specifically.

QuickBooks Online certification required

Must know how to use QuickBooks Online Projects — this is required, not optional

Must be comfortable building out a QuickBooks file completely from scratch for a contractor client — setting up the Chart of Accounts, categorization rules, and full Projects structure from the ground up, not just maintaining an already-organized file

Must be fully competent across the entire bookkeeping cycle — not just data entry or categorization, but true full-charge bookkeeping: reconciliations, financial statements, and clean month-end close, done independently

Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, including the Projects/job costing feature

Solid understanding of construction/contractor-specific accounting (job costing, WIP, materials vs. labor allocation, retainage, etc.)

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple client accounts

Strong written English communication skills

Reliable internet connection and availability for regular working hours

Experience working with US-based contractor or construction clients specifically

Hours & Compensation

Starting part-time — [X hours/week, fill in your target]

Real opportunity to move to full-time as our client base grows

Rate: [fill in — worth checking a few comparable active QuickBooks/contractor bookkeeping postings on onlinejobs.ph first to anchor a competitive number]

To Apply

 your certifications to

title: Appointment Setter for US Vacation Rental Company (Phone and Text, Must Sound Great on the Phone)
description:
JOB TITLE

Appointment Setter for US Vacation Rental Company (Phone and Text, Must Sound Great on the Phone)



SALARY

Open, based on experience. Tell us your number.



HOURS

Full time, 40 hours per week, and this has to be your only job.



Most of those hours are at your computer. We set your core schedule together and the start and end times can move.



Read this part before you apply. Owner leads come in at all hours. If one lands at nine at night and you are still awake, we want a text or a quick call from you inside a few minutes. Most of those calls run three or four minutes. Automations cover the hours you are asleep. We stay flexible on your schedule. In return we hold you to the calls getting made.



TYPE

Full time, long term



ABOUT US



Getaway and Stay manages more than 40 vacation rental homes across Wisconsin, Tennessee, North Carolina, Alabama and Wyoming. Property owners find us through
 ads, our website and Airbnb.



We have run a remote team for years. Five of our people work remotely right now. We found every one of them ourselves, we hired them ourselves, and we trained them ourselves. Nobody here is new to working with a VA, and nobody here is new to talking about pay. Ask us whatever you want about the role or the money.



THE JOB



We get about 25 new owner leads a month and we are too slow to call them. That is the problem you solve.



A lead comes in. You call and you text within minutes. Your only goal is to book that owner onto the calendar with Becky or Tom. You do not sell. You do not quote fees. You get the appointment.



If they do not answer, you keep going. Our standard is one call and one text, twice a day, for fourteen days. That is up to 28 touches before a lead gets closed out. Most people quit after three. We do not.



Every call and text gets logged in GoHighLevel with a short note. We will train you on it.



YOUR DAY



About half your day is calling, texting and logging. The other half is studying. You will learn our markets, our fees, what makes a good rental property and how owners talk about their problems. We hand you the material. We expect you to use it.



WHAT WE NEED



You sound great on the phone. Warm, awake, confident. A US property owner should not have to work to understand you.

You have sold something over the phone before. Appointment setting, inside sales, outbound, collections, any of it counts.

You take a no without losing your energy.

You write text messages that sound like a person, not a template.

Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

You can work US Central business hours.



NICE TO HAVE



GoHighLevel, HubSpot or a similar CRM.

Real estate, vacation rental or hospitality background.

Anything else you are already good at that we could use. SEO, CRM buildouts, reporting, ad management.



WHERE THIS GOES



This starts as a calling and texting role. It does not have to stay one. Once appointments are steady there is room in CRM management, website SEO, reporting and market research. We will train you. If you already have a strength, we will use it.



PAY



Hourly or monthly, your choice, plus a bonus for every appointment that gets held. Rates depend on experience. Tell us what you want and why you are worth it.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not reply here with a resume. We only read applications that come through this form:







It takes about ten minutes and it includes a short video you record on your phone. Applications without the video do not get reviewed.



The first question asks for a word. The word is BAILEYS.

title: Marketing Operations Manager / Implementation Lead
description:
Marketing Operations Manager / Implementation Lead

We’re looking for a highly capable Marketing Operations Manager who can take marketing projects from idea to fully implemented — without needing the business owner to project-manage every step.

This is not a traditional VA role and not a position for someone who needs a detailed task list every day.

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership.

If we say:

“We want this new Meta campaign live by Friday.”

You should be able to determine what needs to happen, organize the work, coordinate with the appropriate people, troubleshoot problems, QA everything, and get the campaign live.

What You’ll Own

You’ll be responsible for managing the implementation side of our marketing, including:

GoHighLevel (GHL) funnels, forms, calendars and automations

Landing pages and funnel implementation

Meta Ads setup and campaign implementation

Pixels, tracking and basic conversion troubleshooting

Domains, DNS, SSL certificates and hosting coordination

 and SMS automations

Website and landing-page troubleshooting

Coordinating video editors and other marketing contractors

Making sure creative assets, copy and campaigns move through production

Testing funnels before campaigns launch

Identifying bottlenecks and getting them resolved

Keeping projects organized and moving quickly

Reporting progress, results and blockers to the owner

You do not need to personally be the world's best expert at every one of these things.

You do need to understand how the pieces work together, know how to troubleshoot problems, and know when to solve something yourself versus bring in the right specialist.

What We’re Looking For

Ideally, you have previous experience working for a digital marketing agency or managing marketing operations for a small business.

Strong candidates will have hands-on experience with several of the following:

GoHighLevel

Meta Ads Manager

Landing pages/funnels

CRM automations

Meta Pixel and conversion tracking

Domains/DNS

Website hosting

Basic page-speed optimization

Zapier or similar automation tools

Project management systems

Managing freelancers or VAs

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is a major plus.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

The most important quality we're looking for is ownership.

What Ownership Means to Us

If something isn't working, we don't want you to simply report:

“The landing page is slow.”

We want you to investigate why it's slow, determine possible solutions, implement what you can, involve a specialist when necessary, follow up until it's resolved, and then report back with the outcome.

We want someone who naturally thinks:

“How do I get this across the finish line?”

rather than:

“What should I do next?”

You should be comfortable making reasonable decisions independently and escalating to the owner when an actual strategic or business decision is required.

What Success Looks Like

The goal of this role is simple:

Ideas should move from decision → implementation → live as quickly and reliably as possible.

The owner should not need to chase contractors, troubleshoot routine technical problems, check whether every task was completed, or personally connect all the moving pieces.

You become the person responsible for making sure things actually get done.

You May Be a Great Fit If...

You are organized, resourceful and technically capable.

You enjoy figuring things out.

You notice problems before someone points them out.

You follow through without being chased.

You communicate clearly when something is blocked.

You can manage multiple people and moving pieces without losing track of the end goal.

You care about outcomes, not just completed tasks.

And when you encounter something you don't know how to do, your instinct is to research it, troubleshoot it, find the right person, or otherwise figure out how to move the project forward.

How to Apply

Please start your application with the words “I own the outcome” so we know you read the entire post.

Then answer these questions:

1. Tell us about your experience with GoHighLevel. What have you personally built or managed inside GHL?

2. Tell us about your experience with Meta Ads. Have you personally set up campaigns, pixels, tracking, lead forms or conversion events?

3. Imagine this scenario: We are running Meta Ads to a GoHighLevel landing page containing a VSL. The page is taking approximately four seconds to load. The owner tells you, “We need this page loading faster.” Walk us through exactly what you would do.

4. Scenario #2: On Monday, the owner says, “I have the videos recorded. I want this new campaign live by Friday.” Walk us through everything you would do between Monday and Friday to make that happen.

5. Tell us about a time something went wrong in a marketing project and you took responsibility for getting it fixed.

6. Have you ever managed other VAs, freelancers, video editors, media buyers or developers? Tell us about that experience.

7. What hours are you normally available to work, and how much overlap can you provide with California/Pacific Time business hours?

Please be specific in your answers. We're much more interested in how you think and solve problems than in receiving a perfectly polished application.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
We're looking for video editors who can make viral content on Instagram and TikTok. This isn't your classic form of selling. Knowing marketing fundamentals is very important here, and we want you to be able to sell our product — but our organic strategy hinges far more on going viral and creating brand awareness than on selling at a very high rate.



WHAT WE OFFER



Our offer isn't just a steady base to help you get started — it comes with strong upside: we pay 25% commission on the sales you drive. We've been running this creator program for a while, with an army of 60+ creators making talking-head UGC, and the ceiling is real: our top creator has driven over $60,000 in sales in a single month. At our 25% rate, driving numbers like that means more than $15,000 in commission — in a single month, on top of base. That's our top performer, not the average, but the upside is uncapped and it's yours the moment your videos perform.



TOOLS & SCHEDULE



Whether you want to bring your own tools and already know how to edit, or you want to learn, we've got you — we can provide CapCut and media so it's as easy as possible to just get started and start editing. The schedule is very flexible: work as little or as much as you like.



HOW WE'LL WORK TOGETHER



What we care about is that you're improving and building toward being able to go viral consistently. Organic social media isn't a science — it's more of an art, and art can take time. We want to see that you have a talent for driving engagement. When you're getting started we'll set a minimum number of videos so you build reps, but we judge you on how your videos perform, not how many you post. We'd rather you put out content you're proud of than post just to post.



TO APPLY



Send us one short-form video centered around a supplement product that is genuinely funny or would go viral and tell us in a sentence or two why it works. We read every one.

title: Real Estate Operations Specialist — Own Our CRM and Support a 200-Deal-a-Year U.S. Team
description:
About us



We are the Jim Black Group, a residential real estate team in Auburn, Massachusetts, brokered by Real Broker LLC. We have ten agents and we close roughly 200 transactions a year. Our promise to clients is that we will never sacrifice a relationship for a commission, and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally: we are clear about expectations, we train people properly, and we treat our team well.



The role



You will be the backend of our operations — the second set of hands behind our Transaction Coordinator and our Listing Coordinator, and the sole owner of our CRM. Two mornings a week are blocked on your calendar for database work and nothing else, because we take that half of the job seriously enough to protect it.



Your daily responsibilities would include:



Send a short end-of-day report by
 listing what you completed and what is still in progress.

Support our Transaction Coordinator on active files: collecting documents, tracking timelines, following up with lenders, title, and inspectors.

Support our Listing Coordinator on new listings: MLS input, coordinating photographers and vendors, keeping listing status current across platforms.

Own our CRM (Sierra Interactive): source-code every new contact within 48 hours, run a monthly audit for duplicates and incomplete records, and send us a monthly database health report.

Keep our referral platforms current — HomeLight and others: profile and transaction history updated, stage updates entered on every active referral, and a weekly report to us on any referral that has not been worked.



To qualify for the position, you will need at least 2 years of experience in the following:



Real estate CRM management — Sierra Interactive, Follow Up Boss, BoomTown, or kvCORE. You have owned a CRM, not just entered data into one.

U.S. real estate transaction coordination, contract to close. You already know what a contingency deadline is and why a missed one matters.

MLS and listing management.



Our team moves fast and our standards are high. It matters to us that you are:



Able to switch between urgent support work and focused solo project work in the same day without losing either

The kind of person errors bother personally — you double-check because you want it right, not because someone is watching

A proactive communicator who sends the update before it is asked for

Willing to follow a process exactly, and to speak up when the process itself is wrong



In addition to excellent written English, you will need to be at least familiar with:



Google Workspace — Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets

Microsoft Excel

Slack

Zoom and Google Meet

Web research



Not required, but it helps if you have:



Direct Sierra Interactive experience

Sisu

DotLoop



Work schedule and holidays



This is a full-time position, Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week

At least six of those hours must overlap 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern time (9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Manila time). The rest of your hours are flexible.

You will qualify for 5 vacation days and 5 sick days after the 6-month probation period

We honor the major Philippine holidays

Start date: on or before November 2, 2026



Salary



$1,300 per month for full-time work (40 hours a week).



Perks and benefits



13th month pay, paid before December 24 every year. In your first year it is pro-rated for the months you have worked with us — you do not have to finish probation to receive it.

A performance review and a raise potential at your twelve-month mark



Training we provide



You do not need to know our exact systems on day one. We will train you on Sierra Interactive, Sisu, DotLoop, and our documented processes. Your first 30 days are built for learning — you will not be dropped onto live files in week one.



Career potential



We are growing our agent count, and our transaction volume grows with it. As it does, this role grows too — into deeper ownership of our data and lead systems, or into leading the support function as we add people to it. We would rather promote someone who already knows how we work than hire over them.



How to apply



Put "Clean Data, Closed Deals" in your subject heading so we know you read the whole post.



Then send us three things:



Your resume or CV.

A short answer to this: describe a time you found and fixed a data or systems problem nobody asked you to look at. What did you find, what did you do, and what changed as a result? A few honest paragraphs beat a polished template — we can tell the difference.

A list of the CRMs you have worked in and what you were actually responsible for inside each one.



If you have questions about the role before you apply, ask them. We would rather answer than have you guess.

title: Bookkeeping Specialist — Contractor Finance
description:
About Us



Vantage Financial is a financial-operations company built specifically for contractors and construction businesses. Most bookkeepers treat every industry the same — general categorization, a P&L at year-end, and not much else. We don't. We work exclusively with residential and commercial contractors, helping them get their books fully organized, understand exactly which jobs are actually making them money, and position themselves to access real business capital — 0% business credit cards, lines of credit, and equipment financing — without guessing or applying blind.



We're a growing company, and this role is a foundational hire on our operations team. As we bring on more contractor clients, this position has real room to grow — from managing a handful of accounts to eventually overseeing a team of bookkeepers as we scale.



About the Role



This is a hands-on, full-cycle bookkeeping and job costing role, not a data-entry position. You'll be the person actually responsible for making sure our contractor clients' books are clean, accurate, and — most importantly — broken down job by job, so every client can see exactly what each project actually cost them and what it actually made them.



Day to day, that means managing bank and credit card feeds inside QuickBooks Online, reconciling accounts monthly, and using the Projects feature to tag every transaction — materials, labor, subcontractor costs — to the correct job. You'll be working across multiple contractor accounts at once, so strong organization and attention to detail matter as much as bookkeeping accuracy itself. You'll also need to understand contractor-specific accounting realities most bookkeepers never deal with — job costing, work-in-progress, retainage, and separating owner draws from real business expenses.



This role sits at the center of what we deliver to clients, so accuracy and consistency matter — a mistagged transaction or a missed reconciliation directly affects the numbers a client is making real business decisions on.



What You'll Do



Connect and manage bank/credit card feeds inside QuickBooks Online

Categorize and reconcile transactions monthly

Job cost every active and new project using QuickBooks Online Projects — tagging materials, labor, and other costs to the correct job

Properly track owner draws separate from business expenses

Communicate clearly on any transactions that need clarification



Requirements



Minimum 3+ years of bookkeeping experience specifically with contractors or construction businesses (required — please do not apply without this)

Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online, including the Projects/job costing feature

Solid understanding of construction/contractor-specific accounting (job costing, WIP, materials vs. labor allocation, retainage, etc.)

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple client accounts

Strong written English communication skills

Reliable internet connection and availability for regular working hours

QuickBooks Online certification

Experience working with US-based contractor or construction clients specifically



To Apply



Please submit your resume and
 your certifications to 
 with the subject line "Yellow" — this lets us know you actually read the full posting.

, tiktok, instagram, youtube).



 The ideal candidate is highly experienced with **OBS Studio and Streamlabs Ultra**, understands multistreaming, and can help turn our livestreams into a polished, professional viewing experience.

title: SDR Manager - Remote
description:
The Company

This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Naperville-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies.



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide.



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development.

Position Overview



The SDR Manager will build MPHQ's outbound sales engine from the ground up — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and own the revenue it produces. This manager will recruit and ramp a high-performing team, establish the sales motion, and create the operating discipline required to scale from an initial pilot pod to a 10+ rep organization.



The ideal candidate has done this before, can bring proven talent, and can demonstrate a track record of turning outbound teams into predictable revenue engines. You are a builder, not a caretaker — someone who has launched an outbound sales function from scratch, recruited high-performing sellers, and built the operating system that turns activity into predictable revenue.



Key Responsibilities



Build the Program

●	Design and stand up the Company's outbound sales motion from zero — including ICP, targeting, messaging, cadences, qualification, objection handling, technology, QA, reporting, and operating rhythm.

●	Recommend the right team structure and pilot size, backed by data, and define the conditions for scaling to 10+ reps.

●	Build a repeatable full-cycle motion where reps prospect, qualify, handle objections, and close, with clear escalation for larger or more complex deals.

●	Partner with Technical/Data and Marketing on list quality, vertical targeting, lead generation, and sales enablement.

●	Design the SDR incentive and commission structure with HR and Finance and align it to qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and company economics.

Build the Team — Hire, Train, Retain

●	Own hiring for the team — define the rep profile, run the interview loop, and maintain a high bar for experienced sellers.

●	Recruit and ramp an initial 5-person pilot pod, then scale based on demonstrated production and unit economics.

●	Tap your own bench and network of proven SDRs, BDRs, inside sales reps, or closers who can accelerate time-to-productivity, subject to the Company's standard hiring process.

●	Build a repeatable onboarding and ramp program that shortens time-to-first-opportunity and time-to-quota.

●	Establish a rigorous coaching rhythm using live calls/recordings, with regular feedback on discovery, active listening, gatekeeper navigation, objection handling, and closing.

●	Own retention and performance management, keeping top producers engaged and accountable.



Own Revenue & Outbound Production

●	Own team targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customer acquisition, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Build and execute outbound calling cadences into US provider offices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, and other non-acute practices.

●	Ensure reps can position the Company's value on cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability, and handle price and incumbent-vendor objections.

●	Personally inspect the sales motion and intervene where activity, conversion, or close rates break down.

Pipeline, Process & Enablement

●	Create and maintain call guides, discovery frameworks, objection-handling guides, and playbooks.

●	Oversee call monitoring and QA to ensure consistent, professional, compliant customer interactions.

●	Use CRM, sales-engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-coaching, and reporting tools to drive transparency and accountability.

●	Monitor pipeline health, stage conversion, time-to-close, and bottlenecks; turn findings into specific process changes.

●	Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.



Performance, Reporting & Unit Economics

●	Track daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs — dials, connects, conversations, qualified opportunities, conversion, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Own the sales funnel from activity through revenue and establish clear baseline conversion metrics.

●	Measure and improve unit economics, including cost per qualified opportunity, cost per acquisition, revenue per rep, and payback.

●	Use performance data to determine when to adjust the people, process, proposition, or investment level before scaling.

Required Qualifications
