title: GHL + Meta Ads Marketing Generalist
description:
GHL + Meta Ads Marketing Generalist

We’re looking for a fast, technically capable marketing generalist who is excellent at implementing digital marketing tasks.

This role is primarily hands-on execution. You will be given clear projects and tasks, and we need someone who can execute them accurately and quickly without requiring extensive training or step-by-step instructions.

If you're given a task like:

“Build this landing page in GHL, connect the form to this workflow, test everything, and let me know when it's ready.”

You should be able to take it from there.

What You’ll Work On

Your work will primarily involve GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, landing pages, funnels, and marketing automations.

Typical projects may include:

Building and editing landing pages in GoHighLevel

Creating forms, surveys and calendars

Building automated workflows

Setting up
 and SMS sequences

Connecting forms, calendars, pipelines and automations

Troubleshooting GHL workflows

Setting up Meta Ads campaigns, ad sets and ads

Uploading new creatives and ad copy

Creating and connecting Meta lead forms

Duplicating and organizing campaigns

Installing and troubleshooting Meta Pixel

Setting up conversion events and basic tracking

Connecting domains and subdomains

DNS and SSL troubleshooting

Improving landing-page speed

Testing funnels before launch

Making basic website/funnel changes

Integrating tools through Zapier or similar platforms

Troubleshooting when something isn't working correctly

There will also be miscellaneous technical marketing projects as they arise.

The Person We're Looking For

We want someone who is a jockey inside these platforms.

You shouldn't need to Google how to build your first GHL workflow or where to create an ad inside Meta Ads Manager.

We're specifically looking for someone who has already spent significant time actually doing the work.

You should be able to move comfortably between GHL, Meta, domains, landing pages, automations and tracking without being intimidated by technical problems.

You don't need to be a marketing strategist.

You do need to be extremely good at implementation.

You May Be a Great Fit If...

You:

Have strong hands-on GoHighLevel experience

Are comfortable inside Meta Ads Manager

Can build landing pages quickly

Understand workflows, triggers and automations

Have experience with domains, DNS and SSL

Understand basic Meta Pixel and conversion tracking

Are good at troubleshooting

Learn new software quickly

Work fast without sacrificing accuracy

Follow instructions carefully

Test your own work before calling something finished

Communicate immediately when you're genuinely blocked

Don't need to be chased for updates

Are comfortable working independently

We especially value people who can be given a specific outcome rather than a 20-step SOP.

For example:

“When someone submits this form, tag them as a Meta lead, create the opportunity, send this SMS, start this nurture workflow, and notify our team.”

We expect you to know how to translate that into a functioning system.

Attention to Detail Matters

A project isn't complete simply because it has been built.

Before handing something back, you should QA your own work.

If you build a landing page, check it on desktop and mobile.

If you build an automation, submit a test lead and make sure it fires correctly.

If you create an ad, verify the creative, copy, destination, tracking and lead form.

We want someone whose default mindset is:

Build it → test it → fix it → deliver it.

Not:

Build it → send it to the owner to find the problems.

How to Apply

Please begin your application with the words “BUILD TEST DONE” so we know you've read the entire job post.

Then answer the following:

1. How many years have you worked with GoHighLevel? Tell us what you regularly build inside it.

2. How experienced are you with Meta Ads Manager? What tasks can you confidently complete without assistance?

3. You're given copy and a reference page and asked to recreate the landing page in GHL. How long would you expect this to take?

4. You've built a GHL workflow, but the SMS isn't sending when a test lead submits the form. What would you check first?

5. Have you worked with domains, DNS, SSL certificates, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking? Please describe your experience.

6. Send examples or screenshots of landing pages, funnels, workflows, Meta campaigns, or other relevant work you've personally built.

7. What hours are you available, and how much overlap can you provide with California/Pacific Time?

We're looking for someone who can become our go-to implementation person: we give you the task, you execute it quickly, test it thoroughly, and get it across the finish line.

title: Legal Coordinator
description:

Legal Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)

Energy and proactivity, taking initiative without being told twice

Benefits



Competitive salary

Paid US holidays

Paid wellness days

Health and wellness allowance

Monthly profit sharing

Long-term placement with real growth

Continuous upskilling in AI and legal operations

Dedicated success coaching and support



How to Apply



To apply, message me directly with:



Your full name

An updated
 where I can reach you

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Amazon Catalog Manager / Account Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day health of our Amazon account. This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who has genuinely run a real Amazon seller account before, not just watched tutorials or done small side tasks.



If you love digging into data, catching problems before they become expensive, and keeping a messy catalog clean and organized, this is your kind of job.



Must-Have Requirements

- 3+ years of hands-on experience managing an Amazon seller account with 100+ SKUs. This is non-negotiable. We want someone who has already lived through the chaos of listing suppressions, lost inventory, hijackers, and reimbursement claims, not someone learning it for the first time on our account.

- Advanced Excel skills: VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables. You should be comfortable building and maintaining tracking sheets, not just filling in templates.

-Sharp attention to detail. This role is built on catching small things before they become big problems.

-Clear written English for case logs, reports, and Amazon support tickets.



What You'll Be Doing



1. Catalog Management

Monitor listing suppressions and stranded ASINs

Check for unauthorized changes to titles, bullets, backend copy, images, and category/browse nodes

Track variation issues, ASIN merges/splits, and duplicate listings

Verify UPC/GTIN accuracy

Maintain SKU-to-ASIN mapping files and catalog issue logs



2. Listing & Account Monitoring

Daily listing health checks

Buy Box and unauthorized/rogue seller monitoring

Pricing issue alerts and content change reports

Documenting hijackers and policy warnings

Flagging restricted listings



3. Inventory & Shipment Monitoring

FBA shipment reconciliation and discrepancy tracking

Missing shipment investigations and FC transfer monitoring

Lost inventory and damage claim documentation

Overstock and low inventory alerts

Subscribe & Save risk reports



4. Photo & Documentation Support

Organizing shipment and product photos for NetSuite and Amazon dispute escalations

Maintaining an image library (labels, UPCs, Amazon images)

Building evidence packets for disputes



5. Reporting & Analytics

Best Seller Rank and category rank tracking

Weekly sales summaries and inventory health reports

Competitor pricing and Buy Box ownership reports

Traffic, session, and conversion trend reports



6. Case Management

Opening, following up on, and escalating Amazon support cases

Maintaining a case log and tracking reimbursements owed

Organizing evidence for appeals



7. Brand Protection

Monitoring for unauthorized sellers, counterfeits, and hijackers

Trademark/IP complaint tracking

Capturing screenshots as evidence



8. Advertising Support

Pulling ad reports, search term exports, and ACOS/TACOS reports

Implementing bid changes and cleaning up campaign naming

Weekly spend summaries and keyword indexing checks



9. Competitor Intelligence

Tracking competitor pricing, reviews, ratings, and new product launches

Monitoring competitor content, promotions, and coupons



10. Customer Feedback Monitoring

Review and Q&A monitoring

Categorizing complaints and tracking packaging feedback



11. Operations Support

Maintaining the master SKU sheet and UPC database

Updating product attribute databases

Tracking open projects and maintaining the SOP library

Meeting notes and action logs



12. Reimbursement & Money Recovery

Lost/damaged inventory claims

Customer return audits

Fee error, storage fee, and removal order audits

Shipment shortage investigations



How to Apply



The first step in our process is a short Excel skills test. Please include the following in your application message:



Your
 address, stating clearly that you'd like to take the Excel test

A brief summary of the Amazon account(s) you've managed (SKU count, how long, what platforms/tools you used)

A specific example of a catalog or reimbursement issue you caught and resolved

Your comfort level with Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables)



We'll send the Excel test to the
 address you provide once we've reviewed your application.



Applications without direct Amazon account management experience will not be considered.



Note on pay: Starting rate is $8/hour, with the potential to increase based on performance and the value you bring to reimbursement recovery, catalog health, and reporting accuracy.

title: High-Ticket B2B Sales Closer - Contractor Marketing
description:
ABOUT



Spark runs Meta ads for residential contractors across the US and produces all video in-house. We work with remodelers, roofers, landscapers, pool builders, and contractors who actually swing hammers. Our clients get real results: E&G General Builder turned $13,500 into $1.2M. Cardona Supreme turned $2,770 into $435,000 in three months. There is no fake pitch needed on these calls.



We need a sales professional who knows their numbers cold and treats closing as a serious profession.



THE ROLE



You take complete ownership of four things:



* Scaling Calls on your calendar. We place 25+ qualified, booked calls a week in front of you. Setters and marketing fill the pipeline, so you never cold dial.

* The pipeline. No-shows, unclosed calls, and reactivations. The highest earners in this seat win on the follow-ups others ignore.

* CRM hygiene. Every call logged in GoHighLevel, every follow-up dated and scheduled. Clean records are non-negotiable.

* Ruthless qualification. You disqualify bad fits on the call instead of selling bad accounts to the delivery team.



Self-sourced deals are optional and pay 15% instead of 10%.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Run one-call closes on Zoom with trade business owners who have often been burned by past agencies.

* Diagnose their current advertising spend and metrics during the call, then present a clear path forward.

* Collect payment on the call. The standard initial agreement ranges between $6k and $12k for three months.

* Manage and work your pipeline in GoHighLevel daily, tracking follow-ups and reviving cold deals.

* Protect client quality. Disqualify prospects who lack budget, capacity, or realistic expectations.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* 2+ years closing high-ticket B2B over phone and Zoom (not retail, door-to-door, or direct consumer sales).

* $500,000+ in provable lifetime closed revenue with verified references.

* Proven experience selling to contractors or trades businesses. You understand why they are skeptical of monthly agency retainers.

* Experience selling intangible services like marketing or software where prospects carry past negative experiences.

* Total command of your sales data. You must know your exact close rate from last quarter without guessing.

* Financial runway for a 90-day ramp. Month one pays roughly one-third of closed volume because commissions pay on cash collected, not contract signatures.

* Flexibility for Saturday calls, as weekend mornings are often the only time contractors can step away from job sites.

* A former manager or business owner willing to verify your performance numbers on a quick call.



NICE TO HAVE



* An existing network or warm relationships with residential contractors.

* Habitual pipeline tracking and CRM maintenance without management oversight.

* Coachability. Top closers audit their recordings, identify gaps, and adapt instead of blaming lead quality.



LOGISTICS



* Full-time remote contractor position (1099).

* Commission only, no base, no draw, no earnings cap. Real OTE sits between $8k and $12k per month.

* US hours (Pacific time preferred, though Eastern contractors take calls early).

* Direct reporting to Cesar, Founder and CEO.

* Payouts occur on cash collected. Standard clawbacks apply if a client requests a refund within the initial commitment.

* 90-day ramp period. By day 90, you are expected to handle calls completely solo, run a clean pipeline, and consistently hit OTE.



Note: If your pitch centers on passive income, automated freedom, or digital nomad lifestyle, this is not the role for you. We hire professionals who built their skills on real phones, know their metrics, and take accountability for closed revenue.

title: LIVE WEBINAR PRESENTER & SALES PROFESSIONAL
description:
**Remote | Gig / Part-Time | $50 USD Per Completed Webinar**



Capital Fleet Rentals is looking for an exceptional **Live Webinar Presenter & Sales Professional** to conduct live online presentations for prospective business partners.



**This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone with outstanding spoken English, strong executive presence, confidence, energy, professionalism, and the ability to engage and influence a live audience.



If you can enter a virtual room, establish credibility quickly, keep people engaged, answer questions confidently, and guide an audience toward a clear next step, we would like to hear from you.



## THE ROLE



You will conduct live Zoom webinars for Capital Fleet Rentals.



We anticipate beginning with approximately **one webinar per week**, with the potential to increase to approximately **two webinars per week as registration volume grows**.



Each webinar is expected to last approximately **30–60 minutes**, including audience questions.



You will receive presentation materials, information about our business, training, and guidance before conducting webinars independently.



Responsibilities include:



* Conducting professional live Zoom presentations

* Presenting information naturally rather than simply reading slides

* Explaining business concepts clearly and conversationally

* Maintaining audience attention and engagement

* Communicating with confidence, energy, and credibility

* Answering audience questions professionally

* Responding effectively when conversations move beyond the presentation

* Handling reasonable questions and objections with professionalism

* Helping attendees understand the information being presented

* Guiding interested attendees toward the appropriate next step

* Professionally representing Capital Fleet Rentals



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Relevant experience may include:



* Live webinar presenting

* Consultative sales

* Business development

* Public speaking

* Training or facilitation

* On-camera presenting

* Professional hosting

* Business presentations

* Customer-facing sales presentations



Previous vehicle-rental experience is **not required**.



We can teach you our business.



What is much harder to teach is **presence, confidence, communication, persuasion, judgment, and the ability to command a live audience.**



Those qualities are extremely important to us.



## COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



**Compensation: $50 USD per completed webinar**



This is a specialized gig position rather than a traditional hourly role.



We expect to begin with approximately **one webinar per week** and may increase to approximately **two webinars per week depending on registration volume and business needs**.



A specific number of weekly webinars is not guaranteed.



Webinars will generally be scheduled during hours suitable for a U.S. Eastern Time audience.



Anticipated start: **Late September / Early October 2026**



## SELECTION PROCESS



We are intentionally taking our time to identify the right presenter rather than simply filling the position quickly.



### Step 1 — Application Video



Please submit a **2–3 minute video presentation on a professional topic of your choice**.



You may:



* Explain a business concept

* Present a product or service

* Teach something

* Tell a compelling professional story

* Discuss another professional topic you know well



We will **not provide a script for this first video**.



Imagine that you have a live audience in front of you and your objective is to capture and maintain their attention.



Professional video production is not required. Please do not heavily edit your submission.



We want to evaluate your natural:



* Spoken English

* Communication ability

* Confidence

* Executive presence

* Energy and personality

* Persuasiveness

* Professionalism

* Camera presence

* Ability to hold an audience's attention



### Step 2 — Live Presentation Audition



Candidates who advance will receive information about Capital Fleet Rentals and a short presentation assignment before their interview.



You will have time to prepare.



During the interview, you will deliver a short live presentation as though we are attendees at one of your webinars.



Expect questions.



We want to see how well you prepare, understand unfamiliar information, communicate naturally, respond to questions, think on your feet, and engage a live audience.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief introduction.

2. Your relevant experience in webinars, sales, public speaking, presentations, training, hosting, or business development.

3. Your **2–3 minute presentation video**.

4. Your current location and time zone.

5. Confirmation that you are comfortable conducting webinars during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time hours.

6. Confirmation that you understand compensation is **$50 USD per completed webinar**.

7. Your answer to this question:



**“What separates an average presenter from someone who can truly command and influence a live audience?”**



Please do not submit a generic application.



This individual will represent Capital Fleet Rentals in front of prospective business partners, so communication ability, professionalism, credibility, and presence are very important to us.



We are looking for someone who can walk into a virtual room with confidence, earn people's attention, establish trust, communicate clearly, and make the audience want to hear what comes next.
